Job Description – Full Stack Developer**The Growing Graph**

**Position:** Full Stack Developer  
**Department:** Web Development  
**Experience:** 6 Months – 1 Year  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-Site  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Working Hours:** 10:30 AM – 7:30 PM  
**Location:** Sector 81, Faridabad

About The Growing Graph

The Growing Graph is a performance\-driven digital marketing and business growth company working with businesses across different industries. We build and manage websites, digital marketing systems, branding, and online growth solutions for our clients.

We are looking for a **hands\-on Full Stack Developer** who can take ownership of website development, WordPress implementation, deployment, maintenance, and technical troubleshooting.

This is an execution\-focused role. We need someone who can **build, customize, deploy, troubleshoot, maintain, and take websites live on our server**.

Key Responsibility

The primary responsibility of this role will be to **develop, deploy, and manage client websites on The Growing Graph's server infrastructure**.

A major part of the role will involve **WordPress website development and deployment**, along with working on custom websites and other web technologies.

You will work closely with the SEO, design, content, and project management teams to ensure websites are properly developed, configured, optimized, deployed, and maintained.

Roles \& Responsibilities1\. WordPress Development \& Management

WordPress will be an important part of this role.

You will be responsible for:

* Developing and customizing WordPress websites.
* Installing and configuring WordPress.
* Working with WordPress themes and page builders.
* Customizing existing themes and templates.
* Creating and editing website pages.
* Managing WordPress plugins and configurations.
* Installing, configuring, updating, and troubleshooting plugins.
* Managing WordPress databases.
* Fixing common WordPress errors and conflicts.
* Customizing basic HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript where required.
* Implementing forms, integrations, tracking codes, and other website functionality.
* Performing WordPress migrations between servers/hosting environments.
* Taking WordPress websites from staging to live production.
* Maintaining and updating existing client websites.
* Ensuring WordPress websites remain secure, functional, and updated.

**Experience with Elementor, WPBakery, Gutenberg, WooCommerce, or similar WordPress tools will be an advantage.**

2\. Website Deployment

* Deploy websites on the company's server.
* Configure domains, subdomains, DNS, SSL, hosting, and related settings.
* Upload and configure website files and databases.
* Connect websites with the appropriate domains.
* Ensure websites are properly accessible after deployment.
* Troubleshoot deployment\-related errors.
* Manage staging and production environments.
* Take websites from development/staging to live production.

3\. Server Management

* Work with the company's hosting/server environment.
* Manage website directories, databases, permissions, and configurations.
* Monitor basic server performance and website uptime.
* Identify and resolve common server and hosting issues.
* Perform website backups and restoration when required.
* Maintain organized server structures for multiple client websites.
* Follow proper security practices while accessing and managing the server.

4\. Full Stack Development

The candidate should have a working understanding of:

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* PHP
* MySQL
* APIs and basic integrations
* Git/GitHub
* WordPress
* Basic frontend and backend troubleshooting

Experience with modern frameworks such as **React, Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, or similar technologies** will be an advantage.

5\. Website Maintenance \& Troubleshooting

* Fix website bugs and technical issues.
* Make frontend and backend changes when required.
* Update plugins, themes, libraries, and dependencies.
* Troubleshoot broken pages, forms, integrations, and database issues.
* Resolve WordPress plugin and theme conflicts.
* Maintain website functionality after deployment.
* Assist in improving website speed and technical performance.
* Identify and resolve hosting\-related issues.

6\. Domain, DNS \& SSL Management

The candidate should be comfortable working with:

* Domain pointing
* DNS records
* A Records
* CNAME Records
* Nameservers
* SSL installation and renewal
* Subdomains
* Website redirects
* Basic hosting configurations

7\. Website Migration

The candidate should be capable of handling website migrations, including:

* WordPress\-to\-WordPress migrations.
* Hosting\-to\-hosting migrations.
* Server\-to\-server website transfers.
* Database migration.
* Domain changes.
* SSL configuration after migration.
* Resolving broken links and configuration issues after migration.
* Testing the website after migration.

8\. Client Website Deployment

For every website project, you will be responsible for ensuring that:

* The final website is received from the development/design team.
* The website is properly tested before deployment.
* The domain is correctly connected.
* SSL is configured.
* Forms and important functionality are working.
* Mobile and desktop versions are checked.
* Website errors are resolved before going live.
* Basic technical SEO requirements are implemented.
* The live website is handed over to the concerned internal team.

9\. Coordination With Internal Teams

You will work closely with:

* **SEO Team** – for technical SEO requirements, indexing, redirects, sitemap, robots.txt, website speed, etc.
* **Project Managers** – for deployment timelines and project status.
* **Design Team** – for design implementation and technical feasibility.
* **Content Team** – for content implementation and website updates.
* **Management** – for server, infrastructure, and technical requirements.

Required SkillsEssential Technical Skills

* **Strong working knowledge of WordPress.**
* Ability to independently develop and deploy WordPress websites.
* Experience with WordPress themes and plugins.
* Knowledge of Elementor or other major WordPress page builders.
* Good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Working knowledge of PHP.
* Basic knowledge of MySQL/database management.
* Understanding of hosting and server environments.
* Understanding of domains, DNS, SSL, and website deployment.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub.
* Ability to troubleshoot website and server issues.

Additional Skills

Knowledge of any of the following will be an advantage:

* Elementor
* WooCommerce
* cPanel
* VPS
* Linux server
* Apache/Nginx
* Cloudflare
* Git/GitHub
* React
* Next.js
* Node.js
* Laravel
* REST APIs

What We Are Looking For

We are not looking only for someone with certificates or theoretical knowledge.

We need a **hands\-on developer** who:

* Can independently build WordPress websites.
* Can deploy websites on our server.
* Understands domains, DNS, hosting, and SSL.
* Can migrate websites from one server to another.
* Can troubleshoot WordPress issues.
* Can fix plugin/theme conflicts.
* Can make basic code\-level changes when required.
* Can troubleshoot frontend and backend issues.
* Is comfortable working with servers.
* Can learn new technologies quickly.
* Takes complete ownership of assigned websites.
* Can work under project deadlines.

Experience

**Required Experience:** 6 Months – 1 Year

Candidates must have practical experience working with **WordPress and website deployment**.

Freshers may be considered only if they have strong practical project experience and can demonstrate their ability to independently develop and deploy websites.

Experience working with multiple client websites, digital agencies, hosting environments, or server deployments will be an advantage.

Performance Expectations

The developer will be expected to:

* Develop and deploy websites within assigned deadlines.
* Maintain high\-quality WordPress implementations.
* Minimize deployment errors and downtime.
* Resolve technical issues quickly.
* Maintain clean and organized server structures.
* Keep websites secure and updated.
* Maintain proper backups where required.
* Communicate technical issues clearly to the project manager.
* Take complete ownership of assigned technical tasks.

Professional Expectations

* Maintain punctuality and discipline.
* Follow internal development and deployment processes.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and client information.
* Never share server credentials or client access details.
* Do not make unauthorized changes to live websites or servers.
* Maintain proper documentation of important technical configurations.
* Communicate proactively when facing blockers.
* Take responsibility for mistakes and work towards quick resolution.
* Maintain professional communication with internal teams.

Growth Opportunity

At The Growing Graph, developers will have the opportunity to work on websites across multiple industries and gain practical exposure to:

* WordPress development
* Full\-stack development
* Server management
* Website deployment
* Hosting infrastructure
* Technical SEO
* Website security
* Performance optimization
* APIs and integrations
* Client project management

As the company grows, strong performers may progress into roles such as:

**Senior Full Stack Developer → Technical Lead → Development Manager → Head of Technology**

Why Join The Growing Graph?

* Work on real\-world client projects.
* Work with multiple businesses and industries.
* Gain practical WordPress and server deployment experience.
* Work across multiple technologies.
* Learn alongside SEO, marketing, design, and business teams.
* Take ownership of complete website projects.
* Build strong practical development and infrastructure skills.
* Grow with a rapidly developing digital business.

How to Apply

title: Product & Visual Design Intern
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly detail\-oriented **Product \& Visual Design Intern** who can work across both **UI/UX design and graphic design**.

You will help design real production products, SaaS platforms, dashboards, admin interfaces, marketing assets, presentations, brand materials, and digital communication.

This role is ideal for someone who understands that good design is not only about making something visually attractive. It is about **structure, usability, hierarchy, consistency, communication, and attention to detail**.

You should be comfortable moving between structured product interfaces and creative visual design while maintaining a consistent design language.

What We Expect

* Strong visual and layout discipline
* Excellent attention to spacing, alignment, typography, and hierarchy
* Understanding of UI/UX fundamentals
* Ability to work within established design systems
* Strong graphic design and visual communication skills
* Ability to follow brand guidelines precisely
* Ability to create polished, production\-ready designs
* Willingness to receive feedback and iterate quickly

We are looking for designers who can balance **creativity with structure**.

ResponsibilitiesProduct \& UI/UX Design

* Design dashboards, SaaS interfaces, admin panels, forms, tables, and analytics screens
* Convert wireframes and requirements into high\-fidelity interfaces
* Work with structured design systems such as the **IBM Carbon Design System** or similar systems
* Follow grid systems, spacing scales, typography systems, and predefined design tokens
* Create reusable Figma components and maintain component consistency
* Design responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile interfaces
* Improve usability and information hierarchy across product experiences

Graphic \& Visual Design

* Create social media graphics and digital campaign assets
* Design presentations, reports, brochures, posters, and communication materials
* Create illustrations and visual compositions using established brand guidelines
* Develop graphics for websites, landing pages, product launches, and marketing campaigns
* Maintain consistency across digital and print visual communication
* Prepare production\-ready design files and assets

Brand Design

* Work within established brand identities
* Maintain consistency in typography, colour, imagery, iconography, and visual language
* Help develop reusable visual templates and brand assets
* Ensure every visual touchpoint feels like part of the same brand ecosystem

Collaboration

* Work closely with frontend developers during product implementation
* Ensure designs are translated accurately into production interfaces
* Collaborate with product, marketing, management, and content teams
* Accept design feedback professionally and iterate quickly
* Maintain organised Figma files and design documentation

Research \& Iteration

* Study enterprise software products and contemporary digital design practices
* Analyse existing interfaces and identify opportunities for improvement
* Explore visual references without blindly copying existing designs
* Conduct basic usability validation and design reviews
* Continuously improve design quality through structured iteration

Skills Required

* Strong proficiency in **Figma**
* Good understanding of UI/UX fundamentals
* Strong graphic design abilities
* Understanding of grid systems and spacing systems
* Good typography and visual hierarchy skills
* Strong alignment and composition discipline
* Understanding of colour, layout, branding, and visual communication
* Ability to create reusable components and structured Figma libraries
* Ability to work within strict design guidelines
* Strong attention to pixel\-level details

Knowledge of tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, Blender, or similar creative tools is an advantage but not mandatory.

Portfolio Expectations

Your portfolio should ideally demonstrate a combination of:

* Product or dashboard UI
* Mobile or web interface design
* Graphic design
* Brand or visual communication work
* Typography and layout
* Structured design\-system usage

We value **quality, thinking, and attention to detail** more than the number of projects in your portfolio.

Qualifications

No specific degree is required.

Students, freshers, and self\-taught designers are welcome to apply.

Your portfolio, design thinking, visual discipline, and ability to execute matter more than formal qualifications.

**Additional preference will be given to candidates who have completed IBM Design, Enterprise Design Thinking, UI/UX, Carbon Design System, or other relevant IBM design courses and certifications.**

Relevant certifications from recognised design platforms are also considered an advantage when supported by strong practical work.

What You Will Learn

* Enterprise\-level UI/UX design
* Structured design\-system workflows
* Production\-ready SaaS product design
* Graphic and visual communication
* Brand\-system implementation
* Collaboration between designers and frontend engineers
* Building reusable components and scalable design systems
* Designing for real\-world products rather than conceptual portfolio projects

Internship Details

* Duration: **2 to 6 months**
* Hands\-on work on real products and brands
* Fast\-paced learning environment
* Exposure to both product and visual design
* Performance\-based opportunity for a full\-time role

Who This Role Is Best For

This role is especially suitable for someone who does not want to restrict themselves to only UI screens or only graphic design.

You should enjoy designing a structured enterprise dashboard one day and working on a presentation, campaign graphic, brand asset, or visual communication piece the next.

We are looking for a designer who can think in **systems when structure is required and creatively when communication is required.**

Pay: Up to ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Chennai, Chennai District)

Job Summary

The Operations \& Admin Executive will be responsible for the smooth day\-to\-day administration and operational functioning of GiftAbled Foundation’s centers and programs in Uttar Pradesh. The role involves facility management, procurement, vendor coordination, travel and logistics, inventory, documentation, staff support, and coordination with program teams.

The ideal candidate should be organized, proactive, comfortable working in field locations, and capable of independently handling multiple administrative and operational activities.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Center \& Facility Management**

* Manage office infrastructure, furniture, equipment, electricity, internet, housekeeping, security, and maintenance.
* Coordinate repairs, servicing, and preventive maintenance.
* Maintain proper records of assets and facilities.
* Ensure cleanliness, safety, accessibility, and basic compliance at the center.

**2\. Procurement \& Vendor Management**

* Obtain quotations and coordinate procurement as per organizational procedures.
* Coordinate with vendors for supplies, services, repairs, and maintenance.
* Maintain vendor records, quotations, purchase documents, invoices, and payment\-related documents.
* Track pending orders and ensure timely delivery of materials.

**3\. Inventory \& Asset Management**

* Maintain records of office supplies, equipment, furniture, and other organizational assets.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of inventory and assets.
* Maintain stock registers and issue/return records.
* Report damaged, missing, or obsolete assets to the reporting manager.
* Ensure proper tagging and documentation of organizational assets.

**4\. Travel \& Logistics**

* Coordinate travel, accommodation, local transportation, and logistics for staff and visitors.
* Support field visits, meetings, training programs, workshops, and organizational events.
* Coordinate guest house/hotel bookings and maintain related records.
* Support vehicle management, including servicing, fuel records, insurance, documentation, and logbooks.

**5\. Administrative Coordination**

* Maintain administrative files, registers, agreements, bills, and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, Program, and other departments for operational requirements.
* Support onboarding arrangements for new employees and interns, including workspace, equipment, ID cards, and other requirements.
* Coordinate routine office communications and follow\-ups.

**6\. Finance \& Documentation Support**

* Collect and verify vendor invoices and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with the Finance team for timely processing of approved bills and payments.
* Maintain records of advances, petty cash, expenses, and administrative purchases as applicable.
* Ensure all administrative expenses are supported by appropriate documentation.

**7\. Events \& Program Support**

* Provide operational support for training programs, community events, workshops, meetings, and awareness activities.
* Arrange venues, seating, equipment, refreshments, transportation, printing, and other logistics.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external service providers to ensure smooth execution.

**8\. Compliance \& Safety**

* Ensure basic administrative and safety procedures are followed at the center.
* Maintain records related to licenses, AMC/service agreements, insurance, fire safety, equipment servicing, and other operational requirements.
* Escalate safety, security, infrastructure, or compliance issues promptly.

**9\. Field \& Center Coordination**

* Coordinate regularly with UP centers and field teams regarding operational requirements.
* Conduct periodic visits to centers to assess administrative and facility requirements.
* Follow up on pending operational issues and ensure timely closure.
* Support the State/Program Lead in implementing operational systems and processes.

* Documentation \& Record Keeping
* Basic Budget \& Expense Tracking

Preferred Candidate Profile

title: Business HR Associate
description:
**Business HR Associate**

**Department:** Human Resources (Business HR)  
**Designation:** Business HR Associate  
**Reporting To:** Head HR/ Senior Manager – HR / Business Head  
**Location:** Odisha

**Role Summary**

The Business HR Associate will function as a strategic HR business partner responsible for **recruiting, managing, monitoring and driving the productivity of a business team of approximately 20 employees**, including Counsellors, PREs, Marketing Executives and Marketing Interns. The role is highly performance\-oriented and requires continuous field and operational monitoring, employee productivity management, admission and revenue support, and execution of day\-to\-day HR operations.

The position demands **high dedication, strong leadership, discipline, accountability and the ability to work closely with Zonal Heads and business teams** to ensure that employees achieve their assigned targets and contribute directly towards organisational growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Team Management \& Productivity**

* Manage and supervise a team of approximately **20 employees**.
* Ensure daily attendance, discipline, punctuality and work accountability of all mapped employees.
* Monitor employee productivity on an **hourly basis** and maintain real\-time performance tracking.
* Conduct continuous follow\-ups with team members to ensure achievement of daily and weekly targets.
* Identify non\-performing employees and implement corrective actions, counselling and productivity improvement initiatives.
* Ensure strict adherence to reporting timelines and operational discipline.

**2\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning**

* Recruit Counsellors, PREs, Marketing Executives, Marketing Interns and other business support staff as per manpower requirements.
* Conduct sourcing, screening, interviews, coordination and onboarding of new employees.
* Maintain a continuous talent pipeline to support business expansion across all verticals.
* Ensure timely closure of vacancies and workforce availability.

**3\. Business HR \& Revenue Generation**

* Work closely with the assigned **Zonal Head** and business team to drive admissions and revenue generation.

HR Services Department India, Chennai, India
   

  

 Our Graduate Programme in Chennai, India offers a unique opportunity to begin your professional journey while gaining practical experience in a collaborative and fast\-paced HR environment. If you've just completed your degree and are eager to develop your skills and build a strong foundation for your career, our Graduate Programme is the ideal opportunity for you.
   

  

 We offer our graduates rewarding career opportunities within our HR Services team, where they can learn, grow, and contribute to a performance\-driven culture. The Graduate Programme provides graduates with the opportunity to gain exposure to key HR processes and support functions, helping them build a solid understanding of HR operations and shared services.
   

  

 Working alongside experienced professionals, graduates will develop practical skills while taking on meaningful responsibilities that contribute to day\-to\-day HR operations. Additionally, participants will have access to training programmes covering essential HR processes, business communication, professional etiquette, collaboration, and other core workplace skills.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Purchase Manager** to manage procurement activities for our interior and turnkey projects. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **project procurement, BOQ, rate analysis, vendor management, material planning, cost control and negotiations**.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the timely availability of quality materials at the best possible prices while maintaining strict control over project\-wise purchase costs, wastage and documentation.

Key Responsibilities1\. Project Material Procurement

* Receive and review material requisitions from the Project/Site Team.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials to project sites.
* Coordinate closely with Project Managers and site teams to understand material requirements and timelines.
* Manage procurement requirements for multiple projects simultaneously.

2\. Vendor Management \& Negotiation

* Identify and develop reliable vendors, suppliers and manufacturers.
* Negotiate the best possible prices, discounts, payment terms and delivery schedules.
* Visit manufacturers and vendor locations as required for material selection, quality verification and commercial negotiations.
* Continuously develop new vendor sources to improve pricing and quality.

3\. BOQ \& Purchase Planning

* Study the **BOQ of every new project** in detail.
* Identify all materials falling under the company's purchase scope.
* Prepare and implement project\-wise purchase plans in coordination with the Project Manager.
* Research new or specialized materials in advance to ensure timely procurement at competitive prices.
* Monitor long\-lead items and ensure advance purchasing wherever required.

4\. Rate Analysis \& Cost Control

* Conduct detailed **rate analysis** for materials and compare market/vendor rates.
* Maintain item\-wise cost benchmarks and monitor material cut\-off costs.
* Negotiate continuously to reduce procurement costs without compromising quality.
* Highlight significant cost variations to management and Project Managers.
* Conduct regular market research to identify better pricing, quality and alternate sources.

5\. Purchase Records \& MIS

* Maintain real\-time records of project\-wise purchases through Excel/software.
* Track purchase orders, quotations, material deliveries, invoices and related documents.
* Prepare project\-wise purchase reports and provide insights on procurement performance.
* Maintain accurate records of material costs for each project.

6\. Material Return \& Wastage Control

* Maintain records of materials returned from project sites.
* Monitor excess ordering, wastage and unnecessary purchases.
* Identify and report material wastage or discrepancies by project teams.
* Escalate irregularities to management immediately.

7\. Purchase Bill Verification

* Strictly verify cash purchase bills submitted by the Project/Site Team.
* Check quantities, rates, material details and supporting documents.
* Ensure bills are genuine, accurate and in accordance with approved purchases.
* Identify discrepancies or irregularities and report them to management.

8\. Continuous Market Research

* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of market prices for regularly purchased materials.
* Regularly explore new vendors, manufacturers and alternative materials.
* Identify opportunities to improve material quality while reducing costs.
* Continuously benchmark existing purchase rates against current market rates.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Purchase \& Procurement**
* **BOQ understanding and analysis**
* **Rate Analysis**
* Vendor Development \& Vendor Management
* Strong **Negotiation Skills**
* Project Procurement
* Material Planning \& Cost Control
* Knowledge of Interior/Construction Materials
* **Advanced Microsoft Excel**
* Microsoft Word
* Professional Email Writing
* Basic **AutoCAD** knowledge / ability to understand drawings
* Purchase MIS \& Documentation
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Strong attention to detail and commercial understanding

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in the following industries will be preferred:

* Interior Design / Interior Fit\-Out
* Turnkey Projects
* Construction
* Real Estate Projects
* Commercial \& Residential Interior Projects
* Project Procurement

Candidate Profile

Education

* Convert the production plan into effective line\-wise and operation\-wise execution plans.
* Monitor production against planned quantities and take immediate corrective action for shortfalls.
* Ensure smooth flow of materials from cutting to sewing, finishing, packing and dispatch.
* Coordinate with PPC, IE, Cutting, Quality, Maintenance, Stores and Finishing departments.
* Ensure production priorities are followed according to shipment requirements.
* Monitor WIP at different stages and avoid excess accumulation or line starvation.

B. Line Management \& Capacity Utilization

* Plan and allocate styles/orders to appropriate production lines based on capacity and skill requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilization of sewing lines, machines, manpower and working hours.
* Review line loading and capacity on a daily basis.
* Ensure effective line balancing to achieve required output and efficiency.
* Identify bottleneck operations and take corrective action.
* Ensure smooth style changeover and minimize changeover losses.
* Improve line productivity through effective manpower and machine utilization.

C. Manpower Management

* Ensure optimum deployment of tailors, helpers, checkers, supervisors and other production manpower.
* Monitor daily manpower availability, absenteeism and manpower productivity.
* Work with HR and Training Centre to address manpower shortages.
* Identify skill gaps and arrange appropriate training/retraining.
* Ensure newly trained operators are deployed based on skill level and production requirements.
* Develop and retain competent line supervisors and senior operators.
* Maintain appropriate **Tailor : Non\-Tailor ratio** and continuously improve manpower productivity.

D. Productivity \& Efficiency

* Achieve targeted line efficiency and productivity.
* Monitor hourly production and identify deviations from targets.
* Review operator\-wise and line\-wise productivity.
* Improve machine utilization and reduce idle time.
* Drive productivity improvement initiatives through line balancing, method improvement and operator skill enhancement.
* Work closely with Industrial Engineering to implement SAM/SMV\-based productivity improvements.
* Monitor and reduce production losses, downtime and non\-value\-added activities.

E. Quality Control

* Ensure production is carried out in accordance with approved quality standards and specifications.
* Coordinate closely with Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams.
* Ensure quality issues are identified and corrected at source.
* Minimize DHU, rework, rejection and alteration.
* Ensure operators follow approved methods and quality checkpoints.
* Take corrective action for recurring quality problems.
* Ensure first\-piece approval and style\-wise quality requirements are followed.

F. Delivery \& Shipment

* Ensure production is completed according to the committed shipment schedule.
* Closely monitor critical orders and production status.
* Escalate potential delivery risks immediately to Unit Head/PPC/Management.
* Prioritize production based on shipment urgency and customer requirements.
* Coordinate with finishing and packing teams to ensure timely order completion.

G. Production Performance Monitoring

* Review daily production reports and production KPIs.
* Monitor:
* Planned vs. actual production
* Line efficiency
* Productivity
* DHU/rework
* Absenteeism
* Manpower utilization
* Machine utilization
* WIP
* Rejection
* Downtime
* Changeover time
* On\-time production/delivery
* Conduct daily production review meetings with Line Supervisors and relevant departments.
* Analyse production losses and implement corrective actions.

H. Cost Control

* Control production\-related manpower and operational costs.
* Minimize overtime, rework, rejection, excess manpower and idle time.
* Improve productivity without compromising quality.
* Monitor consumption of production resources and reduce unnecessary wastage.
* Support management in achieving cost\-per\-garment targets.

I. Coordination with Other Departments

Maintain effective coordination with:

* **PPC** – Production planning and order priorities
* **Industrial Engineering** – Capacity, SMV, line balancing and productivity
* **Quality** – Quality standards, DHU, defects and corrective actions
* **Cutting** – Input availability and cutting plan
* **Finishing \& Packing** – Output flow and shipment readiness
* **Maintenance** – Machine breakdowns and preventive maintenance
* **Stores** – Material availability
* **HR** – Manpower planning, attendance, discipline and recruitment
* **Training Centre** – Skill development and operator conversion
* **Commercial/Merchandising** – Order and shipment requirements

Daily Responsibilities

* Review previous day's production performance.
* Review today's production plan and line loading.
* Check manpower availability and absenteeism.
* Review line\-wise targets and hourly production.
* Identify bottlenecks and take immediate action.
* Monitor quality and rework issues.
* Monitor machine breakdowns and downtime.
* Review WIP and material availability.
* Conduct production review with supervisors.
* Ensure critical orders receive appropriate priority.
* Report production status and major issues to Unit Head/DUH.

Weekly / Monthly Responsibilities

* Review production achievement against monthly plan.
* Analyse line\-wise efficiency and productivity.
* Review manpower requirement and deployment.
* Review absenteeism and manpower productivity.
* Analyse quality losses and rework.
* Review machine utilization and downtime.
* Identify productivity improvement opportunities.
* Prepare action plans for underperforming lines.
* Review performance of Production Supervisors and Line Supervisors.
* Support manpower and capacity planning for upcoming orders.
* Participate in monthly business and production review meetings.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Production Manager should be measured on:

* **Production Plan Achievement – %**
* **Line Efficiency – %**
* **Labour Productivity**
* **Output per Tailor / Operator**
* **DHU / Defect Rate**
* **Rework \& Alteration %**
* **Rejection %**
* **On\-Time Production / Shipment Achievement**
* **Manpower Utilization – %**
* **Absenteeism – %**
* **Machine Utilization – %**
* **Downtime – %**
* **WIP Level**
* **Overtime Control**
* **Cost per Garment**
* **Style Changeover Time**
* **Production Loss / Idle Time**

Required Qualifications

* Relevant certification in garment production/operations will be an added advantage.

Experience

* **8–12 years of relevant experience** in garment manufacturing.
* Minimum **3–5 years in a supervisory/managerial production role**.
* Experience in handling multiple sewing lines and large production teams preferred.

description:

* Investigate security findings, assess their severity, exploitability, and potential business impact.
* Document vulnerabilities with clear reproduction steps, impact analysis, and remediation recommendations.
* Retest vulnerabilities after fixes are implemented to verify successful remediation.
* Maintain security checklists, vulnerability reports, and internal security documentation.
* Support preparation for external Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) and other security assessments.

* Cold calling and outreach.
* Client communication and negotiation.
* CRM and sales pipeline management.
* Event industry operations.
* Ticketing and event management technology.
* Digital marketing and social media outreach.

* New leads generated
* Organizers contacted
* Qualified conversations
* Meetings/demos scheduled
* Events onboarded

This is a performance\-oriented internship where your contribution directly impacts the growth of BookMyBeats.

* Work directly with a growing startup.
* Get hands\-on experience in the event\-tech industry.
* Work on real customers and real events.
* Learn sales, marketing and business development from the ground up.
* Build a professional network within the event industry.
* Performance\-based incentives may be provided in addition to the internship stipend.

This role involves **active outreach and sales**.

You should be comfortable making phone calls, sending messages, approaching new organizers and following up regularly.

If you enjoy meeting people, finding opportunities and converting conversations into business, we’d love to have you on the team.

Apply through Indeed with your updated resume.

**“Why are you interested in Business Development and BookMyBeats?”**

title: Warehouse Assistant
description:
**Job Description**

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of the warehouse by ensuring the **accurate receipt, storage, identification, handling, picking, packing and dispatch of materials and products**.

The role requires maintaining proper inventory records, ensuring warehouse cleanliness and safety, supporting stock verification activities, and coordinating with the Warehouse, Purchase, Sales, Accounts and Logistics teams to ensure smooth material movement.

The ideal candidate should be **physically fit, organized, responsible, detail\-oriented and willing to work in a fast\-paced warehouse environment**.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Receiving \& Unloading**

* Receive materials, products and equipment delivered to the warehouse.
* Assist in unloading and safely moving materials to designated storage areas.
* Verify received quantities against invoices, delivery challans, purchase orders or other relevant documents.
* Check materials for visible damage, shortages or discrepancies.
* Immediately report damaged, missing or incorrect materials to the Warehouse Supervisor.
* Ensure received materials are properly identified and tagged before storage.

**B. Storage \& Material Handling**

* Arrange materials systematically in their designated locations.
* Follow the warehouse's storage and stacking procedures.
* Ensure proper labeling and identification of materials.
* Maintain proper segregation of different product categories and materials.
* Handle products carefully to prevent damage, breakage or loss.
* Follow appropriate FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable.
* Ensure aisles, emergency exits and movement areas remain clear.

**C. Picking \& Packing**

* Pick materials accurately against approved material requisitions, sales orders or dispatch instructions.
* Verify product codes, descriptions and quantities before dispatch.
* Pack materials securely according to their nature and handling requirements.
* Assist in preparing materials for delivery or dispatch.
* Ensure the correct materials are handed over to the logistics/delivery team.
* Support loading activities while following safe material\-handling practices.

**D. Inventory Management**

* Assist in maintaining accurate physical stock.
* Update stock movement records as instructed.
* Conduct regular physical stock counting.
* Support monthly, periodic and annual stock verification.
* Identify and report stock shortages, excess stock, damaged goods or discrepancies.
* Assist in investigating differences between physical stock and system records.
* Maintain proper documentation for inward and outward movements.

**E. Warehouse Documentation**

* Maintain inward and outward material records.
* Assist with maintaining Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), delivery challans, stock transfer records and other warehouse documents.
* Ensure documents are properly filed and readily available when required.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments regarding pending documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of material movement.

**F. Warehouse Cleanliness \& Organization**

* Maintain cleanliness and proper housekeeping within the warehouse.
* Ensure materials are stored in an organized and accessible manner.
* Follow 5S principles and maintain workplace discipline.
* Remove unnecessary packaging materials and waste from operational areas.
* Ensure products are protected from moisture, dust, heat and other potential sources of damage, wherever applicable.

**G. Safety \& Compliance**

* Follow all warehouse safety procedures and company policies.
* Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
* Follow safe lifting and material\-handling practices.
* Report unsafe conditions, damaged equipment or potential hazards immediately.
* Ensure fire exits, emergency equipment and access routes remain unobstructed.
* Follow company procedures for handling electrical, electronic, energy\-related or other specialized products, wherever applicable.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct within the warehouse.

**H. Internal Coordination**

Coordinate effectively with:

* Warehouse Supervisor / Manager
* Purchase Department
* Sales Department
* Accounts Department
* Logistics / Delivery Team
* Service / Operations Team
* Other departments as required

**3\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Performance Expectation**

**Inventory Accuracy**

Maintain high accuracy between physical and recorded stock

**Picking Accuracy**

Ensure correct product, quantity and specification during picking

**Receiving Accuracy**

Verify incoming materials accurately against documents

**Dispatch Accuracy**

Ensure materials dispatched match approved requirements

**Stock Verification**

Complete assigned stock counts accurately and on time

**Material Handling**

Minimize product damage, loss and mishandling

**Warehouse Organization**

Maintain proper storage, labeling and housekeeping

**Documentation**

Maintain accurate and timely warehouse records

**Safety Compliance**

Follow all applicable warehouse safety procedures

**Timeliness**

Complete assigned warehouse activities within required timelines

**4\. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONMinimum Qualification**

* SSLC / Plus Two / ITI / Diploma or equivalent/ Graduation in any discipline
* Candidates with relevant warehouse experience will be preferred.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Diploma/ITI in Logistics, Supply Chain, Electrical, Mechanical or a related field.
* Certification in warehouse, inventory or logistics operations will be an advantage.

**5\. EXPERIENCE**

**Required Experience:** 0–1 years

Freshers with a positive attitude and willingness to learn may be considered.

Candidates with experience in:

* Warehouse operations
* Inventory management
* Logistics
* Distribution
* Electronics / electrical products
* Solar / energy products
* Consumer durables
* FMCG / retail distribution

will be an added advantage.

**6\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIESFunctional Skills**

* Basic knowledge of warehouse operations
* Basic inventory management knowledge
* Material handling
* Stock counting and verification
* Picking and packing
* Basic documentation
* Basic computer knowledge
* Ability to read and understand product codes and quantities

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Attention to detail
* Accountability
* Physical fitness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time management
* Reliability
* Willingness to learn
* Ability to follow instructions
* Problem\-solving ability
* Good communication skills
* Positive work attitude

**7\. COMPUTER SKILLS**

The candidate should have basic knowledge of:

* MS Excel
* MS Word
* Email communication
* Basic inventory/ERP software

Experience with warehouse management software, ERP systems or inventory applications will be an advantage.

**8\. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES – DAILY ACTIVITIES**

The Warehouse Assistant may be expected to:

**Start of Day**

* Check warehouse readiness and housekeeping.
* Review pending inward/outward activities.
* Coordinate with the Warehouse Supervisor regarding daily priorities.

**During Operations**

* Receive and verify incoming materials.
* Arrange and label stock.
* Pick materials against approved requirements.
* Pack and prepare materials for dispatch.
* Update relevant records.
* Support stock counting.
* Coordinate with logistics/delivery personnel.

**End of Day**

* Verify pending material movements.
* Ensure materials are properly stored.
* Maintain warehouse cleanliness.
* Secure warehouse areas and materials.
* Report discrepancies or pending activities to the supervisor.

**9\. PHYSICAL \& WORKING REQUIREMENTS**

The position involves an active warehouse environment and may require:

* Standing and walking for extended periods.
* Handling and moving materials.
* Lifting materials within safe and permitted limits.
* Working in indoor and warehouse environments.
* Occasional support during loading and unloading activities.
* Following safety procedures while handling materials.

**Note:** Manual handling should always be performed within applicable safety procedures and the individual's safe lifting capacity.

**10\. REPORTING \& COORDINATIONReports To**

**Warehouse Supervisor / Warehouse Manager**

**Internal Coordination**

* Purchase
* Sales
* Accounts
* Logistics
* Service
* Operations
* Administration

**External Coordination**

* Transporters
* Delivery personnel
* Suppliers/vendors, when assigned
* Customers/authorized representatives, when required

**11\. AUTHORITY \& RESPONSIBILITY**

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for:

* Safeguarding materials under their assigned responsibility.
* Reporting stock discrepancies immediately.
* Reporting damaged materials immediately.
* Following authorized material movement procedures.
* Maintaining confidentiality of warehouse and company information.
* Not releasing materials without proper authorization/documentation.
* Following company policies, procedures and safety requirements.

**12\. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

We are looking for a candidate who is:

**Reliable \| Physically Active \| Organized \| Responsible \| Detail\-Oriented \| Team\-Oriented \| Safety\-Conscious**

The candidate should demonstrate a willingness to take ownership of assigned warehouse activities and maintain accuracy even during periods of high workload.

**13\. CAREER GROWTH**

A potential career progression for this role may be:

**Warehouse Assistant**↓**Senior Warehouse Assistant**↓**Warehouse Executive**↓**Warehouse Supervisor**↓**Warehouse Manager**

Career progression will depend on performance, experience, skill development and organizational requirements.

**14\. EMPLOYEE VALUE PROPOSITION**

At Aldous Glare Tech \& Energy, employees can expect:

* Professional and structured work environment
* Opportunities to learn warehouse and logistics operations
* Exposure to inventory and supply\-chain processes
* Performance\-based career development
* Team\-oriented working environment
* Opportunities for increased responsibility based on performance

**15\. APPLICATION DETAILS**

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience:** 0–1 Years

**Salary:** ₹18000**\-**20000 per month

Establishes in 1995, for the past 31 years, Aldous Glare Tech \& Energy **(AGTE)** has successfully stood the test of time, establishing itself as a brand synonymous with trust and quality. In the ever\-evolving landscape of technology, we operate with the primary goal of increasing accessibility and awareness of the latest tech gadgets and appliances. We create opportunities for our channel partners through aggressive market development and continuous improvements achieved through agility.

Aldous Glare Tech and Energy **(AGTE)** is a technology product distribution company headquartered in Cochin, with branches in Trivandrum, Thrissur, and Calicut. Aldous Glare is India's leading distributor for smartphones, Android TVs, Google TVs, Smart ACs, Washing machines, solar products, and cloud services.

* Immediately report damaged, missing or incorrect materials to the Warehouse Supervisor.
* Ensure received materials are properly identified and tagged before storage.

**B. Storage \& Material Handling**

* Arrange materials systematically in their designated locations.
* Follow the warehouse's storage and stacking procedures.
* Ensure proper labeling and identification of materials.
* Maintain proper segregation of different product categories and materials.
* Handle products carefully to prevent damage, breakage or loss.
* Follow appropriate FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable.
* Ensure aisles, emergency exits and movement areas remain clear.

**C. Picking \& Packing**

* Pick materials accurately against approved material requisitions, sales orders or dispatch instructions.
* Verify product codes, descriptions and quantities before dispatch.
* Pack materials securely according to their nature and handling requirements.
* Assist in preparing materials for delivery or dispatch.
* Ensure the correct materials are handed over to the logistics/delivery team.
* Support loading activities while following safe material\-handling practices.

**D. Inventory Management**

* Assist in maintaining accurate physical stock.
* Update stock movement records as instructed.
* Conduct regular physical stock counting.
* Support monthly, periodic and annual stock verification.
* Identify and report stock shortages, excess stock, damaged goods or discrepancies.
* Assist in investigating differences between physical stock and system records.
* Maintain proper documentation for inward and outward movements.

**E. Warehouse Documentation**

* Maintain inward and outward material records.
* Assist with maintaining Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), delivery challans, stock transfer records and other warehouse documents.
* Ensure documents are properly filed and readily available when required.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments regarding pending documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of material movement.

**F. Warehouse Cleanliness \& Organization**

* Maintain cleanliness and proper housekeeping within the warehouse.
* Ensure materials are stored in an organized and accessible manner.
* Follow 5S principles and maintain workplace discipline.
* Remove unnecessary packaging materials and waste from operational areas.
* Ensure products are protected from moisture, dust, heat and other potential sources of damage, wherever applicable.

**G. Safety \& Compliance**

* Follow all warehouse safety procedures and company policies.
* Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
* Follow safe lifting and material\-handling practices.
* Report unsafe conditions, damaged equipment or potential hazards immediately.
* Ensure fire exits, emergency equipment and access routes remain unobstructed.
* Follow company procedures for handling electrical, electronic, energy\-related or other specialized products, wherever applicable.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct within the warehouse.

**H. Internal Coordination**

Coordinate effectively with:

* Warehouse Supervisor / Manager
* Purchase Department
* Sales Department
* Accounts Department
* Logistics / Delivery Team
* Service / Operations Team
* Other departments as required

**3\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Performance Expectation**

**Inventory Accuracy**

Maintain high accuracy between physical and recorded stock

**Preferred Qualification**

**8\. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES – DAILY ACTIVITIES**

title: Influencer Marketing Operation Executive
description:
About Lakyou Beauty

Lakyou Beauty is a growing beauty and personal care brand focused on creating high\-quality, trend\-driven makeup and beauty products for the modern Indian consumer.

We are looking for a **highly organized and detail\-oriented Influencer Marketing Operations Executive** to manage the backend and operational execution of our influencer marketing activities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys **coordination, documentation, Excel/Google Sheets, shipping, invoices, follow\-ups and keeping campaigns organized**.

Role Overview

The Influencer Marketing Operations Executive will be responsible for ensuring that influencer campaigns run smoothly from an operational perspective.

The candidate will work closely with the **Influencer Marketing, Finance, Warehouse, Marketing and Logistics teams** to ensure products are dispatched on time, campaign documentation is accurate, invoices are properly maintained, and influencer deliverables and payments are tracked.

**This is primarily an execution and backend operations role, not a creative/content creation role.**

Key Responsibilities1\. Influencer Campaign Operations

* Maintain and update the influencer campaign database.
* Record influencer details, campaign status, product allocation, deliverables and payment information.
* Create and maintain campaign trackers in **Google Sheets / MS Excel**.
* Track every influencer from onboarding to campaign completion.
* Maintain records of:
* Influencer name
* Contact details
* Instagram/YouTube profile
* Product sent
* Shipment details
* Campaign type
* Deliverables
* Posting date
* Payment status
* Invoice status
* Campaign status

2\. Shiprocket \& Product Dispatch

* Handle day\-to\-day **Shiprocket operations** for influencer shipments.
* Create shipping orders for influencers.
* Enter and verify influencer shipping addresses.
* Select the appropriate product/SKU and shipment details.
* Generate shipping labels and AWBs.
* Coordinate with the warehouse/team for product dispatch.
* Track shipments and delivery status.
* Follow up on delayed, failed or returned shipments.
* Maintain a record of all influencer shipments.
* Coordinate re\-shipping wherever required.
* Ensure products reach influencers within the campaign timeline.

3\. Influencer Invoices \& Payment Coordination

* Collect invoices from influencers/creators.
* Verify invoice details before submitting them for payment.
* Maintain an **Influencer Invoice Tracker**.
* Check influencer name, PAN, bank details, invoice amount, invoice number and campaign details.
* Coordinate with the Finance team for payment processing.
* Track pending, submitted and paid invoices.
* Follow up internally on pending payments.
* Maintain proper documentation for every influencer payment.
* Match invoices with approved campaign commercials and deliverables.
* Flag discrepancies in invoice amounts or payment details.

4\. Campaign Documentation

* Maintain complete documentation for every influencer collaboration.
* Organize campaign briefs, approvals, invoices, shipping details and payment records.
* Maintain proper Google Drive folders and campaign files.
* Ensure all campaign\-related documents are updated and easily accessible.
* Maintain proper naming conventions and documentation standards.

5\. Influencer Follow\-Ups

* Follow up with influencers for:
* Address details
* Product requirements
* Content submissions
* Posting dates
* Invoice submission
* Bank details
* Pending deliverables
* Send reminders to influencers regarding pending campaign requirements.
* Escalate delayed deliverables to the Influencer Marketing Manager.

6\. Campaign Deliverable Tracking

* Maintain a daily tracker of influencer deliverables.
* Track whether content has been:
* Briefed
* Product delivered
* Content received
* Approved
* Posted
* Link/report submitted
* Maintain screenshots/links of published content where required.
* Ensure no influencer campaign is left pending without follow\-up.

7\. Reporting \& MIS

Prepare regular reports and trackers covering:

* Total influencers onboarded
* Products dispatched
* Products delivered
* Pending shipments
* Pending content
* Content published
* Pending invoices
* Payments processed
* Pending payments
* Campaign\-wise spending
* Influencer\-wise spending
* Product\-wise gifting
* Monthly campaign status

Provide daily/weekly updates to the Influencer Marketing Manager.

8\. Coordination With Internal Teams

Coordinate closely with:

**Influencer Marketing Team**  
For campaign requirements, influencer details and deliverables.

**Warehouse Team**  
For product availability, packing and dispatch.

**Finance Team**  
For invoices, payments and documentation.

**Marketing Team**  
For campaign timelines and reporting.

**Logistics Team**  
For shipment\-related issues and returns.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets**
* Good understanding of basic formulas, filters, sorting and data management
* Experience using **Shiprocket or other shipping/logistics platforms**
* Good understanding of invoices and basic payment documentation
* Excellent follow\-up skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Good written and verbal communication
* Ability to manage multiple influencers and campaigns simultaneously
* Good organizational and time\-management skills
* Comfortable working with large spreadsheets and repetitive operational tasks
* Ability to identify errors in data, invoices and campaign information
* Good email and WhatsApp communication skills

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* Influencer marketing
* Creator management
* D2C brands
* Beauty / cosmetics / skincare / fashion
* E\-commerce operations
* Marketing operations
* Campaign coordination
* Logistics operations
* Shiprocket
* Invoice management
* Finance coordination

Experience with **Tally, Zoho Books, Shopify, Google Drive and other e\-commerce tools** will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly organized**
* Extremely detail\-oriented
* Good with numbers and documentation
* Comfortable doing backend operational work
* Strong at follow\-ups
* Responsible with deadlines
* Good at Excel/Google Sheets
* Quick at learning new software
* Comfortable coordinating with multiple teams
* Proactive rather than waiting for instructions
* Able to manage repetitive tasks without losing accuracy

Important:

**This role requires strong execution and operational discipline.**

The candidate should enjoy working with **trackers, spreadsheets, invoices, shipping portals, documentation and follow\-ups** rather than looking primarily for a creative/social\-media role.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on:

* Accuracy of influencer database
* Timely creation of Shiprocket shipments
* Shipment delivery success rate
* Accuracy of influencer addresses
* Timely invoice collection
* Accuracy of invoice documentation
* Timely payment coordination
* Percentage of campaigns completed on schedule
* Number of pending influencer deliverables
* Response/follow\-up efficiency
* Accuracy of daily and weekly reports
* Overall campaign operational efficiency

Qualification

* Graduate in B.Com, BBA, Marketing, Business Administration or any relevant field.
* **1–3 years of relevant experience preferred.**
* Freshers with strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and excellent organizational ability may also be considered.

**Telecaller – Franchise Acquisition / Telesales**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an energetic, confident, and target\-oriented telecaller **– franchise acquisition –** to support the expansion of our franchise network.

The successful candidate will connect with prospective franchise partners, understand their business interests and investment capacity, explain the franchise opportunity, qualify leads, manage follow\-ups, and schedule meetings with the Franchise Sales or Business Development team.

This role is suitable for freshers and professionals with experience in telecalling, telesales, real estate, business development, education sales, financial products, or franchise acquisition. The position combines lead generation, consultative communication, CRM management, and appointment setting—core activities commonly associated with telecalling and franchise\-sales roles.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make outbound calls to prospective franchise investors, entrepreneurs, business owners, and assigned leads.
* Introduce the company, brand proposition, franchise model, products or services, and expansion opportunity.
* Understand the prospect’s location preference, business interests, investment budget, experience, and expected timeline.
* Qualify prospects based on predefined criteria such as investment capacity, preferred territory, business background, and readiness to proceed.
* Explain approved information regarding franchise fees, setup requirements, support services, infrastructure, the onboarding process, and next steps.
* Handle basic queries and objections professionally, escalating commercial, legal, financial, or operational questions to the relevant team.
* Conduct systematic follow\-ups through calls, WhatsApp, email, and other approved communication channels.
* Share brochures, presentations, application forms, Expression of Interest forms, or other approved franchise information.
* Schedule qualified meetings, video calls, office visits, discovery sessions, and discussions with the Franchise Sales or Business Development team.
* Maintain complete and accurate records of calls, conversations, lead status, follow\-up dates, requirements, and outcomes in the CRM or lead\-management system.
* Coordinate with the team to ensure timely movement of prospects through the franchise acquisition funnel.
* Track pending follow\-ups and ensure that no qualified lead is neglected.
* Collect relevant prospect information and share qualified leads with the concerned manager or department.
* Provide regular updates on lead quality, prospect feedback, objections, and market response.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly targets related to calls, meaningful conversations, qualified leads, appointments, and conversions.
* Follow company\-approved communication scripts, data\-protection practices, calling guidelines, and franchise\-disclosure policies.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a candidate who is:

* Excellent in verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confident and comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.
* Persuasive, enthusiastic, patient, and results\-orientated.
* Capable of building rapport with business owners and potential investors.
* Good at identifying customer needs and handling basic objections.
* Comfortable working with sales targets, performance metrics, and incentives.
* Organised and consistent with follow\-ups.
* Able to record information accurately in CRM or lead\-management systems.
* Comfortable using MS Office, WhatsApp, email, Google Sheets, and basic CRM tools.
* Fluent in Hindi and English; knowledge of regional languages will be an advantage.
* Professional, ethical, and careful while communicating commercial or investment\-related information.

**Educational Qualification and Experience**

* Minimum qualification: graduation in any discipline; an experienced one in the same domain will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication, persuasion, and customer\-handling skills may apply.
* Preferred experience: 1–3 years in telecalling, telesales, franchise sales, real estate, education sales, insurance, banking, business development, or lead generation.
* Experience in CRM\-based calling, appointment setting, or B2B/B2C sales will be an added advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be evaluated through a balanced combination of activity, quality, and conversion metrics:

* Number of outbound calls made.
* Meaningful conversations completed.
* Qualified franchise leads generated.
* Lead qualification accuracy.
* Follow\-up completion rate.
* Meetings or appointments scheduled.
* Lead\-to\-meeting conversion rate.
* Meeting attendance rate.
* Lead\-to\-opportunity conversion.
* Franchise acquisition or sales contribution.
* CRM data accuracy and timely updates.
* Monthly and quarterly target achievement.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed salary plus performance\-based incentives.
* Attractive earning potential linked to measurable performance.
* Structured training on the company, franchise model, products, and sales process.
* Calling scripts, lead\-management support, and sales enablement resources.
* Opportunity to work with the Franchise Sales and Business Development team.
* Career growth opportunities in telesales, franchise sales, business development, and relationship management.
* Recognition and rewards for high\-performing employees.
* Positive, professional, and performance\-driven work environment.

**Why Join Us?**

Join a growing organisation where your communication and sales skills can directly contribute to business expansion. This role offers practical experience in franchise acquisition, lead qualification, relationship management, telesales, and business development.

If you enjoy speaking with people, identifying business opportunities, and working toward sales targets, apply now and build your career.

title: People Services Manager
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 The People Services Manager role will be the key lead in developing efficient people services to support our People Function for the country that enhances the overall employee experience.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
 People Services Delivery and Transformation
   

  

* Establish a high\-performing People Services team with a healthy balance between globalized and localized activities
* Implement the globally defined processes and procedures for people service delivery, and ensure they are compliant with local labor law
* Ensure at a country level there is clarity around roles, responsibilities, points of escalation \& workflows for country People Services and interaction with other parts of the operating model (ie COEs and BPs)
* Ensure country people services policy and procedures are aligned with global policy and procedures. Help drive process alignment that supports a consistent and efficient People Services function and employee experience
* Support the local implementation of global People policies and processes, ensuring alignment with Arcadis’ strategic direction and compliance with local regulations.
* Work with People Business Partners and COEs to deliver initiatives that enhance employee engagement, wellbeing, and the overall employee experience.
* Manage the delivery of core People processes, including Payroll administration and coordination with Finance to ensure accurate and timely payments.
* Supporting annual compensation and benefits processes (e.g., merit reviews, recognition programs).
* Coordinating with Talent Acquisition to facilitate recruitment and onboarding.
* Act as a point of contact for employees and managers regarding People Services queries, escalating complex issues as appropriate.
* Engage with country stakeholders for ongoing feedback on people services delivery
* Participate in any internal and external audits to enhance service delivery


 Service Delivery \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Ensure the HCM system in Oracle or relevant system of record is accurate and up to date in line with data privacy and security requirements.
* Ensure People system access is managed in line with the company access management policy
* Help establish and maintain efficient People Services processes, leveraging global best practices and local needs.
* Monitor service delivery metrics and participate in initiatives to continuously improve People Services and employee satisfaction.
* Support the implementation of digital tools and employee/manager self\-service platforms.


 Stakeholder Engagement
   

  

* Build strong working relationships with local business leaders and People team colleagues.
* Represent People Services at local meetings, supporting People\-related communications and reporting requirements.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement within the People team.


 Compliance \& Risk
   

  

* Ensure all People Services activities comply with local employment laws, data privacy regulations, and Arcadis policies.
* Support external audits and reporting requirements as needed.


 Country People Function Management
   

  

* Manage the country People Services team to ensure processes align to global ways of working and overall P\&C strategy.
* In conjunction with country People Business Partners and COE specialists, lead the delivery of initiatives ensuring an aligned and consistent approach and is adopted across the people function and wider business within country
* Co\-ordinate across People Services, COEs and People Business Partners to implement the blueprint for the functions target Operating Model in the country and in alignment with other enabling functions
* Develop relationships with and supporting senior leadership teams and other key stakeholders to ensure the alignment of the People services delivery with the business strategy.
* Contact point for local / country crisis management response


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* The candidate should have an academic degree (preferably in human resources) and progressive human resource experience and relevant experience in a complex international matrix setting. He/She should have broad experience and understand the complexity of implementing people activities and particularly in HR operations. Familiarity with payroll, benefits administration, and HRIS systems (e.g., Oracle or similar).

* Further the candidate should have thorough knowledge of professional services business and driving change and harmonization (including leading, motivating and developing teams).


 Other required experience and competencies for this role:
   

  

* Demonstrated management skills and ability to coach and guide a team of HR professionals
* Having a broad knowledge of all major components of People related functions, employee/labor relations, payroll, management of change, diversity, compensation, benefits and talent development.
* Experience in implementing payroll systems and improvements.
* Experience in implementing HRIS and interaction with connected systems.
* Business Fluency with financial acumen and operations knowledge.
* Strong customer service mindset
* Stakeholder management and the maturity to deal with local management at all levels
* High level communication skills (English proficiency at last C1\) strong consulting, coaching and presentation skills.


 Why Arcadis?
   

  

 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
   

  

 You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

* Hands\-on experience in payroll processing, attendance management, and statutory compliance.
* Experience using
 **HRMS, payroll software, and ATS (Applicant Tracking System)** 
 .
* Knowledge of PF, ESI, PT, labor laws, and employee lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and HR reporting.
* Strong communication, organizational, and multitasking skills.



**Key Skills:** 
 Payroll, HR Operations, Attendance Management, Statutory Compliance, HRMS, ATS, Employee Lifecycle Management, Full \& Final Settlement, HR MIS, Recruitment Coordination, Excel.
