title: Business Analyst
description:
**Introduction**
 Welcome to Gallagher \- a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right.
   

  

 We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive.
   

  

 At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.
   

  

 Founded in 2006, the Gallagher Center of Excellence (GCoE) upholds the values of quality, innovation, and teamwork. With 10,000\+ professionals across five India locations, GCoE is where knowledge\-driven individuals make a significant impact and build rewarding, long\-term careers.
   

  

**Overview**
 Working closely with clients and colleagues, the Business Analyst Health and Welfare plays a key role in the examination of business and functional/ system requirements to ensure the Health and Welfare system implementation and maintenance activities meet the established standards of quality as well as reliability, usability and performance. You will be responsible to ensure that the system solution in place reflects client’s benefits.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Be aware of projects and their particularities, develop test scenarios, perform various quality assurance tests and ensure that systems respond effectively
* Ensure the quality, the follow\-up and the respect of the phases of test schedules, of the various tests
* Carry on with post\-implementation follow\-ups to ensure stability and if need, collaborate with the stakeholders to prioritize and to follow\-ups on the patches
* Identify situations that may significantly affect the quality of deliverables, provide feedback to stakeholders and ensure that appropriate corrective actions are taken
* Participate in the planning, organization and follow\-up of projects deliveries so that the various quality assurance, implementation and experimentation tests respect the commitments
* Identify opportunities to purchase, propose and recommend solutions to optimize and evolve processes and work methods
* Review Business Requirements \& System Specifications of client’s proposed solution Health and Welfare plan configuration, web set up, data conversion, payroll interface, carrier feeds, premium Billing etc.)
* Execute configuration of the system through parameters
* Develop and review test plans and expected results
* Test system functionality and document results
* Attend, participate and contribute to team meeting and client meeting
* Work closely with the H\&W Team Lead on communicating project progress and delivery


**About You**
* Post\-secondary education, bachelor’s degree in Information Systems or Computer Science is preferred
* Industry specific certifications
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience in a similar role
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Mathematics, Finance, Statistics, Technology
* Knowledge of Health and Welfare plans
* Knowledge of automated testing tool (implement and use) and Project and Test Management Tools
* Knowledge of tools, concepts and methodologies of QA
* Facility to handle and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* Ability to commit to deadlines and deliver on a timely manner
* Capability to take ownership and be accountable for assigned tasks
* Excel working in a fast\-paced, deadline\-oriented project team environment
* Demonstrate high problem solving and analytical skills
* Excellent oral and written communication skills to share concepts and information to teammates and clients
* Client satisfaction focus along with team\-oriented work style
* Enjoy system analysis/implementation/documentation/testing/programming
* Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Access
* Knowledge of SQL, VB


**Additional Information**
**Compensation and benefits**
 On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits.
   

  

 Below are the
 **minimum core benefits** 
 you’ll get, depending on your job level, these benefits may improve:
   

  

* Medical Insurance and Parental Medical Insurance
* Accidental Insurance and Life Insurance
* Retirals \- Employee Gratuity, Future Service Gratuity benefit \- Group Term Life, Employee Provident Fund, National Pension Scheme
* Flexi Benefits Plan – Tax Savings Plans
* Annual Leave/ Maternity \& Paternity Leave/ Additional paid ML, Mental Health Day


**Other** 
**benefits include:**
* Employee Wellness Programs
* Training programs
* And more..


**We value inclusion and diversity**
 Inclusion and diversity (I\&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.
   

  

 Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.
   

  

 Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer\-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination.

title: Business Analyst 1-Ops
description:
**Job Description**
 The Partner Transaction Center (PTC) team is designed to be the primary team working directly with our partners to assist in standard and non\-standard channel deals. They are responsible for understanding and orchestrating Oracle's Channel workflow and deal processes, as well as being the direct link between our distributors, partners and the channel sales team. This team is an extremely valuable asset to the Channel organisation to ensure a clear and concise linkage for pricing, contracts and bookings.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Provides programs to improve operational efficiency, consistency, and compliance in support of the organisation's financial and tactical business objectives. Provides business practices and processes. Develops, communicates, and trains the organisation on business practices and processes.
   

  

 Serve as a liaison with other divisions such as Finance, Contracts, HR, Legal, Shared Services, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, and Risk Management in an effort to ensure accurate and timely transaction processing. Collect, input, verify, correct, and analyse data to measure key performance indicator actual versus business objectives. Provide updates to management regarding budget to actual, informing them of deviations and opportunities. Provide management with economic impact and compliance issues surrounding key business decisions and/or deals. Communicate Oracle Business Practices to the organisation and monitor process and approvals for full compliance. Drive implementation of new processes and procedures.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC1
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Product Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Product Analyst supports the Product Team and their client business processes and operations by maintaining and enhancing existing products and creating new ones. This role requires a strong analytical mindset and technical expertise to work with large datasets, derive insights, and deliver value to stakeholders as well as product management and development experience. The Product Analyst combines operational, technical, and analytic skills with problem\-solving and communication abilities. You will collaborate with and work closely with Senior Data Analyst and/or Product Owner(s) to ensure successful project execution.
   

  

**Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**
* Operational Execution:
+ Understand and communicate client business needs and issues, operating rules, data structures, and standard operating procedures.
+ Execute and suggest improvements to pre\-defined operational procedures.
+ Implement process improvement in operational workflows, working with Senior Data Analysts and Product Owners.
+ Assist Product Owners to streamline the ideas to development processes, and the technical requirements processes.

* Product Development:
+ Enhance and maintain data products by understanding the data, product(s)/offering(s), client needs, and business goals.
+ Collaborate with stakeholders regarding business objectives.
+ Support product management with product development, and execution.
+ Partner with Product management to create, maintain and update roadmap documentation
+ Assist teams towards common objectives and document the solutions/decisions made.
+ Create technical requirements, user stories and test plans as part of an Agile methodological approach.

* Data Analysis:
+ Compare datasets / various inputs to ensure data quality and derive actionable insights.
+ Apply quality checks and validations to the product delivery, reporting results and elaborative summary for internal team and important stakeholders.

* Stakeholder collaboration:
+ Coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones to ensure smooth working within timelines.
+ Assist engineering teams with knowledge transfer and testing of new operational procedures and enhancements.
+ Facilitate knowledge transfer and overall product knowledge for engineering, Engagement and other teams.
+ Partner with stakeholders e.g. Engagement and Product Owners to understand client business needs and pain points with the intention to write user stories that address those needs.
+ Work closely with product team: Owners, developers and testers to ensure that written requirements are clearly stated, and comprehensive.

* Knowledge development:
+ Build subject matter expertise in operational processes, data tools, content, and necessary technology, and Scrum / Agile methodologies
+ Remain updated on tools, techniques, and working models to enhance processes.
+ Develop functional understanding of the product offering via the technology and deployment stack, to facilitate writing effective user stories, requirements and user acceptance criteria.

* Project Management:
+ Work on multiple client tasks simultaneously, strengthening analytical, task management, and communication skills.
+ Keep track of unplanned internal and clients’ tasks arising from any developments to existing or new products.
+ Maximize time management skills to balance workload in order to complete multiple deadline driven projects with a minimum of supervisory input.

* Coordinate meetings and prepare status update documentation / meetings for ongoing projects Research and Problem\-Solving
+ Conduct secondary research e.g. marketplace conditions, competitive environment, best practices to keep the product quality best\-in class while being able to address clients’ questions related to the same.
+ Coordinate and co lead design sessions to document feature requirements and guide stakeholders towards decision\-making.
+ Investigate issues and recommend solutions to improve processes.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Required \-**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electronics/Communication, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
* 1 – 2 years of experience using data mining languages/tools like SQL (for analysts), Excel. Exposure to stored procedures is a plus.
* Detail orientation with a strong focus on quality, analytics, and operations.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals, Managed Markets Consulting or Analytics Consulting with broad based experience in, managed care, and/or analytics will be an advantage.
* Proven ability to work with global teams across different time\-zones.


**Preferred**
* Masters in these disciplines OR MBA/PGDM/Equivalent
* Experience in product development, management, or operations.
* Strong knowledge of US Healthcare, payer/provider datasets, and managed care analytics.
* Familiarity with tools like Retool, Power BI and Power Query.


**Competencies**
* Operational Outlook:
+ Translate macro tasks into actionable steps and document, execute, and track them efficiently.
+ Seek opportunities for automation and process improvements while transferring knowledge to team members.

* Analytical Skills:
+ Thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
+ Strong problem\-solving and critical\-thinking capabilities.

* Communication Skills: Written, Verbal, and Presentation.
+ Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to simplify complex processes for diverse audiences and respond promptly to inquiries.

* Collaboration and Teamwork:
+ Work effectively across teams and cultures, sharing constructive feedback to achieve team goals.

title: Data Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a
 **Data Engineer** 
 to help build and run the data platform that powers analytics, operational reporting, and AI\-enabled products.
 



  





 This is fundamentally a
 **data engineering and systems\-thinking role** 
 . We care less about fluency in a particular framework and more about your ability to reason across the full data lifecycle—from ingestion and raw storage through transformation, modelling, serving, and production operations. You should understand how decisions at one stage of a pipeline affect correctness, reliability, performance, cost, and usability downstream.
 



  





**What you’ll work on** 



* Build and operate production data pipelines that remain reliable under high\-frequency and high\-volume workloads—not just in development or notebooks.
* Design lakehouse and warehouse architectures, data models, and Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines that keep operational and analytical systems in sync without compromising correctness.
* Develop ingestion frameworks for structured and unstructured data, with careful consideration for schema evolution, data quality, storage formats, partitioning, and downstream usability.
* Design the movement of data across ingestion, raw, transformation, curated, and serving layers, making deliberate trade\-offs around latency, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
* Build the data foundations that support AI and GenAI workloads. This includes preparing reliable, usable structured and unstructured data—and recognising when a simpler, non\-AI solution is more appropriate.
* Partner with analytics, product, and engineering teams to turn data into trusted monitoring, operational intelligence, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Improve platform reliability through monitoring, alerting, failure recovery, backfills, performance tuning, and systematic debugging.



  





**What we’re looking for** 



* 2\+ years of experience in data engineering or platform engineering, including ownership of systems that have operated under real production workloads.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, along with practical experience building maintainable data pipelines and processing structured or unstructured data.
* End\-to\-end data engineering judgment. You can reason through how data is ingested, represented in the raw layer, transformed, modelled, stored, and served—and explain the trade\-offs at each stage.
* Experience with analytical data modelling and an understanding of operational data models. You know when to normalize or denormalize, how to model around real query patterns, and how designs behave as data volume and traffic grow.
* An understanding of lakehouse or warehouse architecture, CDC, schema evolution, data quality, and the correctness challenges involved in keeping systems synchronized.
* Production ownership across the data lifecycle: ingestion, transformation, storage, modelling, and serving, as well as monitoring, alerting, debugging, backfills, and incident recovery.
* The ability to identify bottlenecks and failure modes, reason about what will break first under load, and make architectural decisions based on evidence rather than convention.
* Evidence of how you approach engineering problems—not just which tools you have used. This could be a system you built, operated, debugged, scaled, or redesigned and the reasoning behind your decisions.



  





**Critical Skills** 




 We value depth in data engineering over familiarity with a long list of tools. That depth includes understanding the entire path data takes through a system. We want someone who can explain where correctness can be lost, where bottlenecks emerge, why a particular storage or modelling approach fits the problem, and how the system will behave as scale and requirements change.
 



  





 If you can walk through a data platform end to end—explain its design choices, identify its risks, and describe how you would keep it reliable in production—we’d like to talk to you.

Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will be based out of our Gurugram office and will work with our Risk Analytics team, part of our Global Risk \& Resilience practice and will help clients on topics at the intersection of risk and analytics more specifically, credit risk, market and trading risk, non\-financial risk and ERM and model risk management.

From core regulatory capital and risk models to business decision analytics and model risk management, we create value by improving performance across broad spectrum of topics.

description:

 Role Summary
   

  

 As an
 **AI Engineer** 
 at OneMagnify, you’ll focus on making machine learning and generative AI systems reliable, scalable, and production‑ready for real client use. You’ll sit within our AI team and work closely with data scientists, engineers, and delivery partners to operationalize models across digital, analytics, and marketing platforms.  The Impact You’ll Have
   

  

 You’ll play a critical role in helping clients move AI from proof‑of‑concept to production. Your work will ensure machine learning and generative AI models are deployable, observable, and continuously improving—so clients can depend on them to inform decisions, power applications, and enhance customer experiences.

 Build and Maintain Production ML/AI Pipelines

**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
 While the current market sees more than 15 non\-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalized service provider (6\) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start\-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
   

  

 Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio\-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as extensions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
   

  

**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
 Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016\.
   

  

 ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6 th entrant in a category with well\-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
   

  

 ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes \-
   

  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper\-less approach right from identifying to on\-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers \& employees.


**Challenges**
* Changing Customer’s perception of value proposition \- Our CVP such as Incentivized wellness and chronic care management program requires continuous communication and engagement with our customers and distributors.
* Distribution scale\-up: Distribution Readiness: Considering the comprehensiveness of our offerings, Distribution engagement and sales training across channels is required to be more rigorous.
* Distribution Costs: Third party distribution costs have also been higher than estimated originally which may impact economics due to intense competition in bancassurance segment.
* Traditional ecosystem – The current Health Insurance Industry ecosystem incl. hospitals and diagnostic centers are taking time for being fully oriented to our model. We are addressing this with continued engagement. Extensive partnerships with the new age tech based providers for digitized delivery model are being explored
* Driving profitability–various segments / lines of business
* Opportunities –
* Health Insurance sector offers tremendous potential due to inadequate penetration as only 3% of the retail population is covered. As awareness levels increase, it would simulate demand for insurance products. This would provide significant opportunity to create multi\-distributions channels and diversifying product mix. Balancing growth and profitability will be key going forward as the industry continues to grow at a higher rate/


**Role Holders Knowhow \& Expertise**
* Excellent analytical and communication skills is one of the key imperative for the role.
* Ability to strategize, conceptualize and present /communicate to various stakeholders will be the key.
* Data warehousing concept and data model concept
* Financial modelling and valuation and business model and macroeconomics and industry understanding
* Knowledge of BI tool and financial systems
* Network skills for competitor intelligence

* Build a sustainable, scalable as well as realistic Business plan in view of the dynamic \& changing business environment.

* To Automate the financial model and planning process to improve flexibility, data integrity and reduce timelines, the data input framework need to be aligned such that analytics can be run on the valid data that goes into the system. Currently there is no such monitoring technique available.

title: Business Data Analyst - Central Route Planning
description:
**About CleanHarbors**
 Clean Harbors is North America’s leading provider of environmental and industrial services. The Company serves a diverse customer base, including a majority of Fortune 500 companies. Its customer base spans a number of industries, including chemical and manufacturing, as well as numerous government agencies. These customers rely on Clean Harbours to deliver a broad range of services such as end\-to\-end hazardous waste management, emergency spill response, industrial cleaning and maintenance, and recycling services. Through its Safety\-Kleen subsidiary, Clean Harbors Descriptionis North America’s largest re\-refiner and recycler of used oil and a leading provider of parts washers and environmental services to commercial, industrial and automotive customers. Founded in 1980 and based in Massachusetts, Clean Harbors operates throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and Puerto Rico.
   

  

 Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Centre (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech\-savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions, including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
   

  

 Clean Harbors / Safety\-Kleen is seeking a mid\-level Data Analyst to join our BPS Division's Route Analytics \& Optimization team, based in our Hyderabad office. This role partners directly with the Norwell based Strategic Initiatives team to support data\-driven decision\-making across operations reporting, route analytics, customer analytics, and executive\-level business reviews. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in SQL and Power BI, comfortable working across multiple databases and business domains, and capable of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, write, and optimize T\-SQL queries across multiple SQL Server databases (including operational, reporting, and CRM replica databases) to support recurring and ad hoc reporting needs.
* Build, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards and reports that support SVP\-level Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), operations leadership, and field management teams.
* Support route analytics and optimization workflows, including analysis of driver performance, on\-time performance (OTP/OTA), and other route planning data.
* Analyze customer service data, including service frequency, account activity, and territory\-level trends, to support strategic planning and operational decision\-making.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of automated reporting pipelines using SQL, Excel, and Power BI.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders across customer service, operations, and sales teams to gather requirements and deliver reporting solutions.
* Perform data validation, quality checks, and root cause analysis to ensure accuracy and reliability of reporting outputs.
* Document data models, query logic, and reporting processes to support knowledge transfer and team continuity.


**Qualifications**
* 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in a data analyst or business intelligence role.
* Advanced proficiency in T\-SQL / SQL Server, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions (ROW\_NUMBER, PARTITION BY), and query optimization.
* Strong experience building Power BI dashboards and reports, including DAX measure development and data model design.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, and structured reporting layouts.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple databases and data sources to produce integrated reporting outputs.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, surface anomalies, and communicate findings clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in an operations\-focused or logistics/services business environment is strongly preferred.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Python for data processing, automation, or report generation (pandas, openpyxl, python\-pptx, or similar libraries).
* Familiarity with Alteryx or similar ETL/workflow automation tools.
* Exposure to Salesforce data structures or CRM analytics.
* Experience supporting route planning, field services, or logistics operations analytics.
* Knowledge of Power BI Service (workspace management, scheduled refresh, row\-level security).
* Experience writing or maintaining VBA macros in Excel.

title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
About the Role
 



 We're building a secure, multi\-tenant SaaS platform on
 **Next.js (App Router)** 
 and
 **Node.js** 
 , deployed natively on the
 **Cloudflare Edge ecosystem** 
 (Workers, Pages, D1, R2, KV). We're looking for a QA Tester who is equally comfortable
 **breaking the product by hand** 
 and
 **codifying that judgment into automated tests that run in CI** 
 .
 



 This is not a generic manual\-testing or basic\-Selenium role. We need someone who understands
 *why* 
 edge\-deployed, serverless applications fail differently than traditional server\-based apps — and who can catch those failures both exploratively and automatically, before they reach production.
 



 What You'll Own
 



 1\. CI/CD \& Test Automation (GitHub Actions)
 


* Write and maintain
 **GitHub Actions workflows** 
 (.github/workflows) that trigger automated test suites (Playwright, Vitest) on every Pull Request.
* Manage environment secrets securely and configure staging/preview environments per branch.
* Build quality gates that
 **block bad builds from deploying** 
 to Cloudflare Pages/Workers.



 2\. Cloudflare Edge Testing \& Emulation
 


* Write automated integration tests for our serverless environment using
 **Wrangler** 
 and
 **Miniflare** 
 .
* Test Next.js App Router routes,
 **tRPC** 
 endpoints, and Cloudflare\-native services —
 **D1 (SQL)** 
 ,
 **R2 (object storage)** 
 , and
 **KV** 
 — in local/edge\-emulated conditions.
* Validate behavior differences between local dev, staging, and true edge runtime.



 3\. Manual \& Exploratory Testing (Multi\-Tenant SaaS)
 


* Manually validate complex user workflows and edge cases across a multi\-tenant environment.
* Deeply test authentication flows (
 **Clerk** 
 or
 **Better Auth** 
 ), including session edge cases, token expiry, and permission boundaries.
* Validate
 **rate\-limiting behavior (ArcJet)** 
 and confirm graceful degradation under throttling.
* Verify
 **multi\-tenant account isolation** 
 — data, permissions, and billing boundaries between tenants must never leak.
* Cross\-browser and responsive UI testing across real\-world device/browser combinations.



 4\. API \& Contract Testing
 


* Manually test APIs using
 **Postman** 
 or
 **Insomnia** 
 — auth flows, error handling, schema validation.
* Build automated contract/e2e test coverage using
 **Playwright** 
 ,
 **Cypress** 
 , or
 **Bruno** 
 .
* Validate data flow integrity through our
 **end\-to\-end type\-safe (tRPC)** 
 system, from client call to database write.



 Must\-Have Skills
 


* Hands\-on experience authoring and maintaining
 **GitHub Actions** 
 workflows (not just "used CI/CD" — you've written the YAML yourself)
* Working knowledge of
 **Wrangler** 
 and/or
 **Miniflare** 
 for local edge simulation
* Automated testing experience in
 **Playwright** 
 ,
 **Cypress** 
 , or
 **Vitest**
* API testing fluency:
 **Postman/Insomnia** 
 (manual) \+ at least one automated contract\-testing tool
* Strong
 **manual/exploratory testing** 
 methodology — not just scripted test\-case execution
* Comfort with
 **Next.js** 
 ,
 **Node.js** 
 , and modern JS/TS tooling
* Understanding of
 **SaaS multi\-tenancy** 
 concepts (tenant isolation, RBAC, subscription boundaries)



 Nice to Have
 


* Experience with
 **tRPC** 
 (as a tester or developer)
* Familiarity with
 **Clerk** 
 ,
 **Better Auth** 
 , or similar modern auth providers
* Exposure to
 **ArcJet** 
 or other rate\-limiting/bot\-protection tooling
* Experience with
 **D1** 
 ,
 **R2** 
 , or
 **KV** 
 specifically
* ISTQB certification or equivalent formal QA training



 What We're
 *Not* 
 Looking For
 


* Pure manual testers with no automation/CI exposure
* "Selenium \+ Jenkins only" profiles with no exposure to modern JS\-based test frameworks or GitHub\-native CI/CD
* Candidates who list tools without project\-level evidence of using them (we will ask for specifics)



 Email directly \- gunjan.saxena@grapesworldwide.com

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Job Details
   

  

**Description**
**About Archer**
 A new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage.
   

  

 Mandates like the EU AI Act and the SEC cybersecurity disclosure rules are driving the most significant GRC buying cycle we have seen in years. That demand is why we are growing this team.
   

  

 This is hard work that matters. Our customers span energy, utilities, financial services, pharmaceuticals, and the public institutions communities depend on. People choose Archer because they get to partner with the most trusted brands in the world, on work that protects the customers and communities those brands serve.
   

  

 If that sounds like your kind of work, let's chat.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a Quality Engineer who is passionate about building quality into software throughout the development lifecycle. In this role, you will help deliver reliable, secure, and scalable products by combining strong testing skills, automation expertise, and a proactive approach to problem solving. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and global teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, and ensure customers receive high\-quality experiences. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands\-on technical work while continuously learning modern quality engineering practices, cloud technologies, and AI\-powered tools
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Quality Engineering \& Risk Assessment**
* Review product requirements, user stories, and code changes to identify potential quality risks.
* Design and execute effective test strategies that provide meaningful coverage for new features and enhancements.
* Investigate defects, perform root cause analysis, and partner with developers to drive resolution.


**Test Automation**
* Build and maintain automated tests across UI, API, and integration layers.
* Expand automation coverage by identifying repetitive and high\-value test scenarios.
* Contribute to automation framework improvements that increase reliability and efficiency.
* Good knowledge in Playwright


**CI/CD \& Continuous Testing**
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback on code changes.
* Support release validation activities and ensure quality checkpoints are met before deployment.
* Monitor test results and collaborate with engineering teams to address quality issues quickly.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**
* Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and global stakeholders to deliver quality outcomes.
* Contribute ideas that improve quality processes, tooling, and engineering efficiency.
* Demonstrate ownership and urgency in resolving quality issues and supporting successful releases


**What You Bring**
* Experience in software testing, quality engineering, or test automation in an Agile development environment.
* Hands\-on experience with test automation tools, frameworks, and scripting/programming languages.
* Ability to analyze code changes, understand feature impact, and determine appropriate test coverage.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated ownership, proactiveness, and commitment to delivering quality outcomes.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and globally distributed teams


**Even Better If You Have**
* Experience with AWS services and cloud\-based applications.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as K6, JMeter or similar platforms.
* Exposure to security testing, vulnerability assessment, or secure development practices.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered testing tools, test generation, or developer productivity solutions.
* Experience working with observability and monitoring platforms such as Coralogix, Grafana, Datadog or similar tools
* Execute performance, load, and reliability tests to validate application behavior under expected workloads.
* Participate in security validation activities, vulnerability reviews, and secure testing practices to help reduce risk.

 The Senior Associate Information Security \- Encryption Agility Analyst will support Amgen's enterprise Encryption Agility Service for Post\-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Readiness Preparation. This role supports the Senior Manager Information Security \- Encryption Agility Service Lead, the Senior Specialist Information Security \- Encryption Agility Team Architect, and Global Career Framework level 5 (L5\) engineers by helping collect, validate, document, and report cryptographic inventory and remediation data across Amgen. The role contributes to the Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM), discovery workflows, data quality controls, ticket tracking, dashboards, and operational documentation that enable Amgen to manage encryption, cryptography, crypto agility, and post\-quantum readiness across applications, cloud, infrastructure, identity, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificates, Key Management Services (KMS), secrets, data protection, Software as a Service (SaaS), and third\-party ecosystems.
   

  

 This position is hands\-on and detail\-oriented. The analyst will review tool outputs, support evidence collection, maintain inventory records, assist with false\-positive triage, prepare reporting views, document remediation status, and coordinate with service owners. The role will work with Digital Identity Access Service (DIAS), PKI and certificate service owners, Application Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security, Enterprise Architecture, cloud, infrastructure, platform, Risk and Compliance, Procurement, Legal, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), Operational Technology (OT), and vendor teams while escalating complex cryptographic design or exception decisions to the L5 engineer, Principal Architect, or Senior Manager.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Support Encryption Agility Service operations, including intake processing, work tracking, dashboard updates, meeting notes, service documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) maintenance, reporting inputs, and service improvement actions.
* Collect and validate cryptographic inventory data from source code, binaries, cloud key services, endpoints, file systems, network traffic, PKI and certificates, KMS and secrets, vendor attestations, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) inputs, and Subject Matter Expert (SME) interviews.

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The OT Cybersecurity Specialist is responsible for supporting the implementation, monitoring, and management of cybersecurity measures for the organization’s Operational Technology (OT) systems. This role involves securing industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA systems, and other OT assets from cyber threats, conducting vulnerability assessments, monitoring networks for anomalies, and responding to security incidents. The OT Cybersecurity Specialist will work closely with other IT and cybersecurity teams to ensure a robust and secure OT environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**OT Cybersecurity Specialist**
**OT Cybersecurity Monitoring And Incident Response**
 Monitor and analyze the security of OT systems, networks, and industrial control devices for potential threats and vulnerabilities.
   

  

 Assist in investigating and responding to OT cybersecurity incidents, including identifying, containing, and remediating incidents.
   

  

 Help with the development and implementation of incident response plans specific to OT environments.
   

  

**Vulnerability Management**
 Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and scans of OT systems to identify potential security risks.
   

  

 Work with the OT and IT teams to implement necessary patches, updates, and mitigation strategies to reduce risk exposure.
   

  

 Perform penetration testing and risk assessments on OT systems and assist in securing system configurations.
   

  

**Security Controls Implementation**
 Implement and maintain security measures such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS), and access controls within OT environments.
   

  

 Assist with network segmentation, secure remote access, and other security controls specific to OT infrastructure.
   

  

 Ensure that security tools and controls are properly configured and continuously monitored.
   

  

**Collaboration With IT And Operational Teams**
 Collaborate with the IT security team to integrate OT systems into the broader enterprise security strategy.
   

  

 Work with OT operations teams to ensure cybersecurity measures are aligned with operational requirements and do not disrupt production.
   

  

 Coordinate with engineering teams to ensure that new OT devices or systems meet cybersecurity standards before deployment.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement**
 Stay up to date with the latest cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, and technologies related to OT systems.
   

  

 Recommend improvements to OT security policies, procedures, and technologies based on industry trends and best practices.
   

  

 Assist in the evaluation of new cybersecurity tools, technologies, and processes to enhance the OT security posture.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 OT Operations Team
   

  

 System Administrators and Operations
   

  

 Facilities Management
   

  

 Internal Auditors
   

  

 IT Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 External Auditors
   

  

 Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs)
   

  

 Consultants
   

  

 Incident Response Service Providers
   

  

 Third\-Party OT Solution Providers
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
   

  

 Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
   

  

**Certification**
 Relevant certifications such as GIAC GICSP, Certified SCADA Security Architect, or other cybersecurity certifications are preferred.
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 5\+ years of overall experience , with at least 2 years focused on OT or industrial control systems security.

 .

Expertise is expected in all areas of Application and API security, Cloud Infrastructure (AWS and Azure), and Containerized Environments, including Kubernetes (EKS and AKS).

* Develop and present executive\-level reports and technical findings, ensuring clear and impactful communication to both senior non\-technical leadership and deep\-technical teams.

description:

**Responsibilities**
 Integrate and manage frontier AI models and LLMbased security tools to perform continuous autonomous redteaming of production and development environments
   

  

 Design and maintain automated pipelines that trigger immediate defensive actionssuch as virtual patching microsegmentation or credential rotationupon the discovery of valid exploit paths
   

  

 Develop infrastructure templates TerraformAnsible that allow for the rapid hardening of the environment in response to newly discovered classes of algorithmic attacks
   

  

 Analyze how frontier models chain minor vulnerabilities into complex exploits and use those insights to redesign architectural guardrails
   

  

 Build APIdriven connections between autonomous discovery engines and the broader security stack WAF SIEM and CICD pipelines
   

  

**Candidate Experience Requirements**
 58 years in Cybersecurity with at least 3 years in DevSecOps Cloud Security Engineering or Security Automation
   

  

 Strong background in penetration testing or vulnerability research with a focus on logicbased exploits rather than just signaturebased flaws
   

  

 Advanced proficiency in Python Go or similar languages specifically for building automated workflows and interacting with LLM APIs
   

  

 Deep expertise in cloudnative security architectures AWSAzureGCP and container orchestration Kubernetes
   

  

* Participate in incident response activities related to cloud based payment systems by providing expert insights into pipeline configurations automation scripts and access controls that may influence containment and recovery steps.

* Review code and configuration changes associated with cards and payments platforms to validate adherence to secure coding practices encryption requirements and segregation of duties models before production promotion.

 This role requires strong hands\-on technical knowledge of firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, SIEM, endpoint security, and cloud networking, along with the ability to design, implement, and manage security controls aligned with industry best practices and compliance requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Network Operations \& Administration:
* Manage, monitor, and optimize enterprise LAN/WAN, firewalls, VPNs, load balancers, and routers/switches.
* Oversee daily network operations, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Implement and maintain network segmentation, redundancy, and high availability.
* Security Operations:
* Configure and manage firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, and threat intelligence tools.
* Monitor security logs, SIEM alerts, and network traffic for anomalies and potential threats.
* Lead incident response for security breaches, including root cause analysis and remediation.
* Access \& Identity Management:
* Administer user access controls, VPN authentication, and privileged account security.
* Collaborate with IAM/IDP solutions (e.g., Okta, Azure AD) for secure access.
* Cloud \& Hybrid Security:
* Secure cloud workloads in Azure/AWS with network and security best practices.
* Implement security controls across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.
* Compliance \& Governance:
* Ensure security controls align with ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, GDPR, and enterprise policies.
* Maintain documentation of network diagrams, SOPs, and security standards.
* Collaboration:
* Work closely with IT, SOC, and application teams to integrate security into all operations.
* Assist in evaluating new technologies, tools, and processes for network and security enhancements.


**Qualifications**
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
   

  

 Experience: 5\+ years in enterprise network operations and security engineering roles.
   

  

**Certifications (Preferred)**
* Networking: CCNP, CCNA, CompTIA Network\+
* Security: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, or equivalent
* Cloud Security: Azure Security Engineer Associate, AWS Security Specialty


**Technical Skills**
* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLANs, QoS
* Security: Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, SonicWall, Cisco ASA), IDS/IPS, WAF, DLP
* SIEM \& Monitoring: Splunk, Falcon LogScale, QRadar, Sentinel, Darktrace
* Endpoint \& Identity: CrowdStrike, Okta, CyberArk, Netskope
* Cloud Security: AWS VPC, Azure NSGs, IAM policies, VPN gateways
* Scripting/Automation: PowerShell, Python, Ansible (preferred)

* Excellent communication and documentation skills.

* Collaborative mindset with cross\-functional teams.

title: Staff Security Engineer II
description:
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real\-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.
   

  

 It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.
   

  

 One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Staff Application Security Engineer at Confluent, you will join a team of security architects and engineers responsible for shaping and advancing the application security strategy across our on\-premises products and cloud services. In this role, you will go beyond implementation to define the long\-term security posture of our ecosystem, spanning high\-scale distributed systems, on\-prem deployments, and globally operated cloud platforms.
   

  

 You will lead the design and evolution of application security architecture, ensuring security is embedded throughout the product lifecycle—from early design decisions to cloud deployment and ongoing operations. Acting as a strategic partner to Engineering and Product leadership, you will influence architectural direction and proactively mitigate systemic and emerging security risks.
   

  

 This role plays a key part in building and sustaining a strong security culture across Engineering, Product, and the broader organization. You will architect and oversee security automation and tooling that scales security operations and enables consistent, high\-quality outcomes. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise and sound security judgment, with a proven ability to eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities through architecture, automation, and cross\-functional leadership.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Platform teams to identify security risks early, influence architectural decisions, and drive adoption of secure\-by\-design practices across the organization.
* Define and standardize threat modeling frameworks and security design standards, and lead security design reviews for complex, distributed systems, providing actionable architectural guidance to engineers and product managers.
* Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for product security implementation reviews, overseeing security code reviews and API security testing while providing definitive remediation guidance.
* Architect and drive the roadmap for security automation, building scalable software security tooling to transform product security operations and vulnerability management practices.
* Design and lead the deployment of automation and orchestration frameworks that integrate security seamlessly into the cloud\-native deployment pipeline.
* Proactively identify new vulnerability classes, lead research initiatives and orchestrate complex table\-top exercises to keep the organization ahead of the evolving threat landscape.
* Strategically identify and deploy advanced technology controls to maximize observability and harden key attack surfaces across the ecosystem.


**What You Will Bring**
* 10–12 years of hands\-on Application Security experience, who can drive measurable security improvements across large\-scale, distributed systems and global engineering organizations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of security fundamentals as applied to modern web applications and cloud\-native platforms including secure software design and architecture, secure coding practices, common vulnerability classes.
* Ability to partner as a trusted peer with Engineering and Product leadership to embed security into the core architecture of the organization.
* Ability to lead technical investigation and response to application security incidents while driving preventive improvements through architecture and automation.
* Proven experience evolving the software development lifecycle to embed security by default, from securing CI/CD pipelines and build systems to implementing automated security guardrails in cloud\-native deployment workflows. Passionate about applying AI and LLMs to automate complex security workflows, reduce manual toil, and drive measurable improvements in security outcomes.
* Experience in Go, Python, or Java, with the ability to design and build scalable security automation frameworks.
* Experience in leading cross\-functional initiatives in distributed environments, translating security requirements into clear, executable technical roadmaps.
* A data\-driven decision\-maker who can balance security requirements with business velocity and engineering trade\-offs to deliver outcomes.
* Ability to raise the organization’s security bar through architectural reviews, advanced technical guidance, and the development of engineers across all levels.


**Ready to build what's next? Let’s get in motion.**
**Come As You Are**
 Belonging isn’t a perk here. It’s the baseline. We work across time zones and backgrounds, knowing the best ideas come from different perspectives. And we make space for everyone to lead, grow, and challenge what’s possible.
   

  

 We’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment decisions are based on job\-related criteria, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by law.
   

  

**Privacy Statement**
 Confluent is an IBM subsidiary which has been acquired by IBM and will be integrated into the IBM organization. By proceeding with this application, you understand that Confluent will share your personal information with other IBM affiliates involved in your recruitment process, wherever these are located. More Information on how IBM protects your personal information, including the safeguards in case of cross\-border data transfer, are available here.

title: Technical Support Representative
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
   

  

 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
   

  

 PTC is seeking a dynamic and client\-focused Associate Technical Support Representative to join the Support Services organization located in Pune (India \- Night Shift) and supporting customers across North Americas. This role is responsible for providing a seamless PTC experience to achieve our customer’s desired outcomes and accelerate customers’ success to go further than they thought possible.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Technical Support Representative (TSR) team is responsible for delivering high\-quality customer support and managing various internal administrative tasks. As professional service representatives, TSRs ensure efficient case resolution for PTC customers while fostering a positive and collaborative work environment within the Technical Support (TS) organization.
   

  

 TSRs play a vital role in helping PTC achieve operational excellence by aligning with corporate support standards. They handle customer service requests, internal coordination, and community moderation under management's guidance.
   

  

 In addition to supporting daily customer interactions, TSRs also serve as online Community Moderators—helping to implement PTC’s Community Moderation Strategy by monitoring and managing user\-generated content in coordination with the Technical Support and Internal Community Management teams.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Customer Case Processing \& Routing**
* Open support cases in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system for issues reported via phone, voicemail, or email.
* Route incoming customer calls to the appropriate technical support team or department.
* Escalate critical or urgent issues to Technical Support Management.
* Monitor and route ISO\-related cases following low\-rated customer satisfaction surveys.


**Community Moderation**
* Act as an online PTC Community Moderator, enforcing moderation guidelines and contributing to PTC’s online support strategy.


**Case Handling \& Support Tools**
* Handle basic user issues related to PTC customer\-facing tools (e.g., eSupport portal).
* Manage case routing and monitor support queues in line with ISO and internal processes.
* Analyze customer feedback submitted through the eSupport portal and CRM system.


 Coach/Mentor Help develop new hires on tools and processes related to Customer Service through Coaching or Mentoring Help Managers to prepare development plans and execute them.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* 0–2 year of experience in customer support or a related field (preferred)
* Proficiency in Windows at the user level, with basic administrative knowledge
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for handling customer issues via phone and email
* Strong troubleshooting abilities, including configuration, duplication, and root\-cause analysis of technical issues
* Solid technical writing skills, with the ability to document and share knowledge through article publishing


 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
   

  

 If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
   

  

 We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

title: Remote Support Engineer

* Develop and maintain SOPs, knowledge base articles, and technical documentation.

* Support the implementation of best practices, standards, and IT governance processes.

**Experience** 



* 4\-6 years of experience in an enterprise IT Help Desk or Service Desk environment.

**Professional Skills**

 Apply right away!

 We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast\-moving digital transformation market.
   

  

 Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full\-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real\-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.
   

  

 Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Team:**
 Hitachi, Ltd. is seeking a talented Network Engineer to design, implement, and maintain secure and reliable network infrastructure. This role is crucial for ensuring seamless connectivity and optimal performance across our global operations.
   

  

**The Role**
* Design, configure, and deploy network devices including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
* Monitor network performance, identify issues, and implement proactive solutions to ensure high availability and reliability.
* Troubleshoot complex network problems, including connectivity, performance, and security\-related incidents.
* Implement and maintain network security policies and procedures, including access control lists, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems.
* Perform regular network audits and assessments to ensure compliance with industry standards and internal policies.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with other IT teams and business units to understand requirements and provide network solutions.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for network support and incident response.
* Evaluate and recommend new network technologies and solutions to improve efficiency and security.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3\-5 years of experience as a Network Engineer in an enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, MPLS, etc.) and network services (DNS, DHCP).
* Proficiency with Cisco networking equipment (routers, switches, firewalls) is essential.
* Experience with network security best practices and technologies (e.g., VPNs, firewalls, IDS/IPS).

 And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.
   

  

 Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!
   

  

**About G2 \- Our People**
 At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (
 *P*

We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.
   

  

 You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals \- each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people\-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.
   

  

**About The Role**
 G2 is looking for a Network Engineer, IT Operations and is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining network infrastructure across the company’s APAC offices with primary ownership of a new Gurgaon office build\-out and ongoing support of the existing Bengaluru site. This role spends roughly 70% of its time on network engineering (firewalls, switches, wireless, VPN, segmentation, and high availability) and 30% on hands\-on L2 IT support for on\-site equipment such as conference room AV, printers, access control panels, employee laptops and surveillance systems. The role partners closely with InfoSec on global network security posture, supports start\-of\-day coverage for both APAC and EMEA, and serves as a force multiplier for IT support teams based in the region.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Network Engineering \& Infrastructure (70%)
+ Design, deploy, and maintain dual\-firewall (high\-availability) network architectures across APAC office locations, including failover, redundant ISP configuration, and segmentation between corporate and guest networks.
+ Own configuration and lifecycle management of enterprise switches, wireless access points, and firewalls across APAC sites; maintain accurate, current network architecture diagrams and IP/VLAN documentation.
+ Lead the new APAC site network build, including migration of spare network hardware from existing locations, coordination with building\-provided ISPs and managed\-office partners, and weekend cutovers to avoid impact to working hours.


**Network Security, On\-Site IT Support \& APAC/EMEA Coverage (20%)**
* Partner with InfoSec on global network security posture — firewall policy review, segmentation, VPN/ZTNA, and SOC2\-relevant controls — and own audit\-ready documentation for network changes.
* Provide hands\-on L2 IT support at the local office for conference room AV, printers, badge/access control panels, employee devices and surveillance cameras; partner with regional IT support staff to absorb tickets and onboard/offboard locally based employees.
* Provide first\-half\-of\-day support coverage for EMEA employees and serve as backup APAC coverage for the regional IT support team.


**Documentation, Standards \& Cross\-Site Coordination (10%)**
* Maintain a central knowledge base covering network architecture, runbooks, vendor contacts, and standard operating procedures for all APAC sites.
* Coordinate cross\-timezone with US\- and EMEA\-based IT teammates during major outages or change windows impacting APAC infrastructure; participate in on\-call rotation for critical network incidents.
* Contribute to IT roadmap planning, vendor evaluations, and quarterly OKR delivery for the Infrastructure team.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.
   

  

* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience in network engineering for a mid\-to\-large enterprise, including firewall administration (Palo Alto, Fortinet, or Cisco ASA), enterprise switching, VLAN/STP/DHCP/DNS, and site\-to\-site / remote\-access VPN.
* Demonstrated experience deploying or operating high\-availability network designs (active/passive or active/active firewalls, dual\-ISP failover).
* Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts (AWS VPC, Azure VNet, or GCP), wireless infrastructure, and modern identity/SSO integrations with network equipment.
* Comfortable providing hands\-on L2 IT support for end\-user infrastructure — conference room AV, video conferencing endpoints, printers, badge readers, employee devices — and willing to own this work as part of the role.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; able to operate independently across a globally distributed team and present clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Willing to work occasional weekend or off\-hours change windows for site cutovers and major maintenance.
* CCNA required; CCNP or vendor equivalent (Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Fortinet NSE) strongly preferred.
* Prior experience supporting a North America–headquartered company from an India location, including comfort with overlapping EMEA/US working windows.
* Familiarity with modern enterprise IT tooling: video conferencing platforms, MDM, SSO/IdP, productivity suites, and ITSM ticketing systems.
* Experience supporting a SOC2\-audited environment and producing artifacts for compliance reviews.
* Exposure to scripting or automation (Python, Bash, or vendor APIs) for network configuration backup, change validation, or reporting.
* Ability to identify and implement automation opportunities for repeatable tasks.


**Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity**
 At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status. Learn more about our commitments here.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Tier 3 Network Engineer will serve as a senior technical resource within our engineering team, responsible for the design, implementation, and advanced troubleshooting of complex network solutions. This individual must have extensive hands\-on experience with Fortinet, Palo Alto, and Cisco/Meraki technologies, and be comfortable interfacing directly with both technical teams and executive leadership (including C\-level stakeholders).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient network solutions using Fortinet, Palo Alto, and Cisco Meraki platforms.
* Act as an escalation point for complex network issues escalated from Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 Support.
* Provide expert troubleshooting for a wide range of network environments including firewalls, VPNs, SD\-WAN, switching, and wireless networks.
* Perform network assessments, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Develop and document network architecture and detailed implementation plans.
* Collaborate with project managers and client stakeholders, including presenting technical solutions to C\-Suite executives in a clear, business\-oriented manner.
* Participate in on\-call rotation and respond to critical incidents as needed.
* Mentor junior engineers and assist in internal knowledge sharing.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of experience in network engineering roles, preferably in an MSP or service provider environment.
* Strong expertise in Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer), Palo Alto Networks (NGFW, Panorama, Prisma, Strata), and Cisco/Meraki (ASA, ASR, MX, MR, MS).
* Experience designing and deploying secure network solutions for SMBs and mid\-market enterprises.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP), VLANs, VPNs, NAT, and firewalls.
* Experience with SD\-WAN, cloud networking (Azure/AWS), and multi\-site deployments.
* Proven ability to diagnose and resolve high\-impact network issues efficiently.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to translate technical jargon for business audiences.
* Comfortable presenting technical solutions and strategy to C\-level executives.
* Relevant certifications are strongly preferred (e.g., Fortinet NSE4\+, PCNSE, CCNP, Meraki CMNA/ECMS).

 More about

 .
   

  

 Wise is one the fastest growing companies in Europe and we’re on a mission: to make money without borders the new normal. We’ve got 10 million customers across the globe and we’re growing. Fast.
   

  

 Current banking systems don’t let us send, spend or receive money across borders easily. Or quickly. Or cheaply.
   

  

 So, we’re building a new one.
   

  

 And we’re looking for a Network Engineer to join our growing User Tech team in Hyderabad. * Share knowledge with the team and mentor juniors to help them grow
* Communicate with various stakeholders throughout Wise, plan roadmaps with your team, and work through challenges to determine scope and realistic delivery

 Multicast, BGP, Juniper (JUNOS), Arista, Data center architectures, Routing policy, traffic‑generation tools, debugging skills (CLI), OSPF, EVPN

**Job Purpose**

This role supports our strategically architected labs, which drive enterprise infrastructure initiatives through validation, optimization, and innovation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, configuring, testing, and validating complex network environments that will be used to support end‑to‑end production deployments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain multi‑vendor network environments including Juniper, Arista, and other enterprise networking platforms.
* Configure, test, and validate Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols including Multicast, BGP, OSPF/IS‑IS, MPLS, EVPN/VXLAN, and related technologies.
* Create detailed network test plans, document test results, methodologies, and test cases.
* Execute functional, performance, scale, interoperability testing of network features and solutions.
* Use industry‑standard traffic‑generation and validation tools such as Ixia/Keysight for load, latency testing and benchmarking.
* Automate network configuration and test workflows using Python and/or Ansible.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues using packet captures, logs, and protocol analysis tools.
* Participate in lab equipment maintenance including OS upgrades, firmware updates, and hardware lifecycle activities.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering teams to support development cycles, proof‑of‑concept testing, and architectural evaluations.
* Stay up‑to‑date with emerging networking standards, vendor roadmaps, and automation workflows relevant to R\&D testing environments.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* 5\+ years of hands‑on experience supporting, configuring, and troubleshooting enterprise or service provider networks.
* Strong knowledge and practical experience with:
+ Multicast(PIM, MSDP, IGMP, OISM), BGP, MP\-BGP, ECMP, PBR, OSPF/IS‑IS, MPLS, RSVP\-TE, NGMVPN, LDP, EVPN/VXLAN, SDWAN
+ Data center leaf‑spine architectures
+ Routing policy, traffic engineering, and L2/L3 feature validation

* Experience with Juniper (JUNOS), Arista (EOS), and at least one additional major network vendor (Cisco, Nokia, etc.).
* Hands‑on experience using Ixia/Keysight, Spirent, or similar traffic‑generation tools.
* Practical Python and/or Ansible experience for automation, validation, or tooling.
* Ability to execute and develop automated or semi‑automated network test workflows.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills using CLI, packet captures, and telemetry.
* Ability to manage multiple lab projects, configurations, and test cycles simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or equivalent technical field preferred.
* Relevant industry certifications such as JNCIP/JNCIE, CCNP/CCIE, Arista ACE are advantageous.


**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**
* Experience building CI/CD‑like workflows for network testing or automation.
* Familiarity with network virtualization, containers, or cloud networking models.
* Understanding of zero‑trust architecture principles and network security frameworks.
* Exposure to AI/ML infrastructure requirements and GPU‑optimized networking.
* Experience with edge computing deployments and distributed infrastructure.
* Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and shifting project requirements.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage lab resources effectively.
* Team‑oriented mindset with a willingness to collaborate across engineering groups.
* Demonstrated ability to improve operational processes and automation efficiency. Certifications : JNCIP/JNCIE OR Arista ACE
