title: Software Engineer — Full-Stack (Healthcare Platform)
description:
**zMed Health Tech · Bengaluru · Full\-time · Work From Office · 0–3 years · Multiple positions** 




**Build software that runs inside real hospitals.** 




  





 zMed is a healthcare technology platform live in hospitals today — powering ICUs, operating rooms, and wards with real\-time vitals from bedside monitors and ventilators, clinical charting, AI\-assisted documentation, and more. Our stack is modern SaaS: a FHIR R4 clinical data engine, multi\-tenant web architecture, micro\-frontends, and an AI\-native way of building software.
 



  





**One team, many spikes** 




**We're not hiring clones. We're assembling a team of complementary strengths. Every hire brings one clear spike** 
 — tell us which one is yours:
 


* **Product Builder** 
 — you love taking an idea from concept → design → build → a clinician actually using it at a bedside. You'll own modules end to end: UI, APIs, data.
* **Clinical Builder** 
 — you come from nursing, clinical pharmacy, biomedical engineering, or hospital operations, and you want to build the software you always wished you had. You'll specify workflows, build product with AI\-assisted tools, run validation with clinicians, and own clinical support.
* **Platform Builder** 
 — you're drawn to infrastructure: containers, deployments, networking, keeping production healthy. You'll learn our deployment platform and Docker Swarm, grow into Kubernetes for hospital deployments, and keep live clinical systems running.



 You don't need all three. You need one, done well, plus the will to learn the edges of the others.
 



  





**Two doors in** 




  





**You qualify through either** 
 of these — you don't need both:
 


* **A software engineering education** 
 (CS/IT or equivalent), or
* **Healthcare domain experience** 
 — nursing, clinical pharmacy, biomedical engineering, hospital operations/IT, or hands\-on exposure to clinical workflows



 If you bring one, we'll help you build the other.
 



  





**What everyone shares (non\-negotiable)** 



* **A verification mindset** 
 — you don't trust code (yours, ours, or AI's) until you've tested it
* **Fluency with AI\-assisted engineering tools** 
 — or genuine excitement to make them your primary way of building
* **Clear writing** 
 — specs, plans, and prompts are engineering artifacts here
* **Integrity** 
 — non\-negotiable when your software touches patient care
* **Mental grit** 
 — hospitals run 24×7; you stay sharp under pressure and finish what you start



  





**How we work** 




  





**AI\-first engineering: we build with Claude Code and modern agentic workflows, so a small team ships at unusual speed. Every new hire — every spike, every door — ships a real module to our dev environment in their first week** 
 . From there you grow along your spike through hands\-on gates: owning a micro\-frontend, joining customer support rotation, running validation with clinicians, or making your first supervised production deployment.
 



  





**Nice to have (not required)** 



* React / TypeScript / Node.js exposure
* Docker, Linux, or home\-lab tinkering (Platform spike)
* Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, or medical devices
* Anything you've built and shipped — side projects count



  





**Work mode** 




  





 Full\-time, work\-from\-office in Bengaluru. No remote / hybrid. We build together, in one room, close to the problems we're solving. Apply only if you're in Bengaluru or ready to relocate.
 



  





**Why zMed** 



* Your work goes live in real ICUs and ORs — impact you can stand next to
* Small team, high ownership, steep learning curve
* Direct access to doctors, nurses, and hospital teams
* Modern engineering culture: AI\-first tooling, fast iteration, no ticket\-factory bureaucracy



  





**How we interview** 




  





 One conversation over phone then video meeting over google meet, then a single on\-site day: a 2\-hour written aptitude test (reasoning, precision, and writing — closed book, no trick trivia), and for those who clear it, a 2\-hour hands\-on working session matched to your spike, in our office, using our AI\-powered development environment — build something small. No leetcode, no take\-homes.
 



  





**Email** 
 careers@zmed.tech with the subject
 **"Product Builder — Bengaluru — \[your spike]"** 
 and include:
 


* Your resume
* **Product/Platform spike:** 
 a link to anything you've built — side projects count more than certificates
* **Clinical spike:** 
 a short paragraph describing one hospital workflow you know deeply and what software gets wrong about it

title: Technical Lead
description:
**About Lila Games:** 




 Lila Games strives to build a world\-class engineering team (eventually) that can compete with the best in the world. We are a long way from that ambition, but we hope to find others to help us build this team from Bangalore, India. Built in India, published to the world.
 



 More information about Lila:
 
 https://tr.ee/7DD\-CnUfci
 




  





**Why This Role Exists:** 




 We are a multi\-game studio, and our biggest constraint is how fast we can ship new games. We need a Tech Lead who helps us ship new games faster, both by working directly on the games and by building the shared systems and tooling that multiple projects reuse.
 



 This is a full\-stack, full\-lifecycle role. The work spans backend and frontend, in Unity, Godot, or whatever a project uses. You should be comfortable picking up new tech stacks fast. You will not be boxed into one engine or one game.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 



* **Build shared foundations and systems:** 
 Design the systems and tooling that multiple projects reuse, so new games start from a stronger base instead of rebuilding the same things each time.
* **Build for liveops operability from day one:** 
 Every feature you ship should be operable without engineering involvement after launch. Designers should be able to adjust weapon balance, drop rates, event timing, and economy levers through config or dashboards, not by filing engineering tickets. Think about who operates what you build, not just whether it works on launch day.
* **Design scalable features:** 
 Architect features that hold up as a game grows in players and content, and that work across projects rather than being rebuilt each time.
* **Build testable systems, not just tested systems:** 
 Pure logic (economy calculations, matchmaking, config parsing, anything that does not touch the engine) should be unit tested. Gameplay systems should be designed so their logic can be validated without running the full game. You do not need TDD dogma everywhere, but you must know what to test, what not to test, and how to architect so testing is possible.
* **Own features end to end across projects:** 
 Take features from scoping to shipped, across backend and frontend, often on more than one game at a time. Translate requirements into well\-scoped engineering tasks with realistic estimates, in collaboration with product and design.
* **Lead and mentor the engineering team in Bangalore:** 
 Most engineers have not received structured technical feedback. Code review is your primary mentorship tool: specific, technical, and instructive. Your goal is to raise the floor of every engineer around you.



  





**Working With AI:** 




 You should be comfortable building with AI agents as part of your normal workflow:
 


* **Agentic coding:** 
 using AI agents to write and ship code day to day.
* **Agentic loops with guardrails:** 
 setting up workflows where agents do real work within constraints and checks you define.
* **Self\-healing agent loops:** 
 workflows that detect their own failures and correct themselves.



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 




 We care more about depth of skill and quality of thinking than years of experience. Here is what actually matters:
 


* **Strong engineering fundamentals:** 
 you understand SOLID principles and can explain why they matter in the context of a game codebase, specifically why they make live\-ops changes safer and faster, not just cleaner.
* **Full\-stack and quick with new stacks:** 
 you are comfortable across backend and frontend (Unity, React, or whatever a project uses) and you pick up unfamiliar tech stacks fast.
* **Hands\-on agentic coder:** 
 you write code day to day and use AI agents to do it. You are comfortable with agentic loops and the guardrails that keep them reliable. This is not a management\-from\-a\-distance role.
* **Liveops systems thinking:** 
 you have worked on a live game and understand what it means to build features that can be tuned, toggled, or updated without a full build. You think about config, feature flags, and content pipelines as engineering concerns, not product team problems.
* **Mentorship instinct:** 
 you give direct, specific technical feedback. You can explain not just what is wrong but why and how to fix it.
* **High agency:** 
 you identify problems and propose solutions without waiting to be asked. You own outcomes, not tasks.



 Unity proficiency is a bonus. Backend or networking experience is valuable given the multiplayer games that we work on.
 



  





**What We Are Not Looking For:** 



* Engineers who equate years of experience with expertise. We have seen too many senior engineers with bad habits and too many sharp 4\-year engineers who outperform them.
* People who profile only when performance is already broken. By then it is too late.
* Engineers who build features without thinking about who operates them post\-launch. Liveops operability is an engineering responsibility.
* People who prefer to manage from a distance. We need someone in the code.



  





**Application Process:** 




**Apply:** 
 submit your resume. We respond within 3 business days.
 



**Written Assignment:** 
 we send this first, a focused technical problem designed to surface how you think, not just what you know. You may use AI tools, but you must fully understand what you submit.
 



**First Interview:** 
 a combined screening and technical and cultural conversation with our leadership team.
 



**Final Interview:** 
 a conversation with a founder, including a walkthrough of your assignment.
 



**Offer:** 
 formal offer with compensation details.
 



 Please review our company values at
 
 https://bit.ly/3rsN1ti
 
 before applying. Cultural fit is not a formality here. It is a filter.

 This is a multidisciplinary product\-development role involving both electronics/embedded development AND mechanical design.
 



 We are specifically looking for someone who is comfortable working with microcontrollers, sensors, electronic components and programming, while also being capable of working with SolidWorks, CAD assemblies and manufacturing drawings.
 



 This is not a pure mechanical engineering, electronics or software position.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 iNSPIRE Design is looking for a hands\-on Junior Mechatronics Engineer to work on the development of new physical products, with a particular focus on medical devices and electromechanical systems.
 



  





 You will work across electronics, embedded programming, mechanical design, prototyping and testing.
 



  





 On the electronics side, you will be expected to gradually take ownership of the electronics and embedded systems used in our product\-development projects — including researching technologies, selecting components, building prototypes, programming them and troubleshooting the resulting systems.
 



  





 On the mechanical side, you will work under our senior mechanical engineering team and support projects through CAD modelling, design modifications, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, prototyping and documentation.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who enjoys building things and figuring out how they work, rather than someone interested only in theoretical engineering.
 



  





**Electronics \& Embedded Responsibilities** 




 You will work on tasks including:
 



 • Developing electronics and embedded systems for functional product prototypes.
 



 • Understanding product requirements and proposing suitable electronic architectures.
 



 • Researching and selecting microcontrollers, processors, sensors, cameras, microphones, displays, DACs/ADCs, drivers and other electronic components.
 



 • Working with platforms such as ESP32, Arduino and Raspberry Pi.
 



 • Programming embedded systems using C/C\+\+ and Python.
 



 • Interfacing sensors, actuators, motors, displays, cameras, microphones and other peripherals.
 



 • Working with communication protocols such as I²C, SPI and UART.
 



 • Reading component datasheets and understanding electrical specifications.
 



 • Building breadboard and prototype circuits.
 



 • Soldering and assembling electronic prototypes.
 



 • Using multimeters, oscilloscopes and other basic electronic test equipment.
 



 • Troubleshooting hardware, firmware and communication problems.
 



 • Preparing basic schematics, wiring diagrams and electronic BOMs.
 



 • Sourcing electronic components and evaluating suitable alternatives.
 



 • Documenting prototype architectures, connections, software and test results.
 



 • Working with specialist electronics vendors or consultants when a project requires capabilities beyond the internal team.
 



  





 You are not expected to already be an expert in advanced PCB, RF or production electronics design. However, you should have strong fundamentals and be capable of researching unfamiliar technologies and learning quickly.
 



  





**Mechanical Engineering Responsibilities** 




 You will also support our mechanical engineering team with:
 



 • 3D CAD modelling using SolidWorks.
 



 • Creating and modifying individual components and assemblies.
 



 • Preparing manufacturing and engineering drawings.
 



 • Applying basic tolerances, fits and GD\&T.
 



 • Preparing and maintaining mechanical BOMs.
 



 • Making design modifications based on prototype testing and engineering feedback.
 



 • Designing basic brackets, mounts, enclosures and supporting components.
 



 • Understanding how PCBs, sensors, motors, displays, wiring and other electronics are physically integrated into products.
 



 • Preparing models for 3D printing and other prototyping processes.
 



 • Supporting CNC machining, sheet metal, fabrication and other manufacturing activities.
 



 • Assembling and testing mechanical and electromechanical prototypes.
 



 • Coordinating with vendors where required.
 



  





 Complex mechanical architecture and major design decisions will generally be led by the senior mechanical engineering team, but you should be capable of independently executing well\-defined mechanical engineering tasks.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 We’re looking for an engineer who is naturally curious and comfortable moving between hardware, software and mechanical systems.
 



  





 You should be someone who, when given a requirement such as:
 



 “We need to acquire data from these sensors, process it, control this hardware and display the result,”
 



 can research the problem, identify possible components, read the relevant documentation, build a prototype and work through the problems that arise.
 



  





 You should be comfortable admitting when you don’t know something, but your next instinct should be to research it, experiment and figure it out.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 • Strong fundamentals in electronics and embedded systems.
 



 • Practical experience with Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi or similar platforms.
 



 • C/C\+\+ and/or Python programming experience.
 



 • Experience interfacing sensors and other electronic hardware.
 



 • Understanding of basic analog and digital electronics.
 



 • Ability to read electronic component datasheets.
 



 • Practical soldering and electronics prototyping skills.
 



 • Ability to use a multimeter and basic electronic test equipment.
 



 • SolidWorks or equivalent 3D CAD experience.
 



 • Ability to create basic mechanical parts, assemblies and engineering drawings.
 



 • Basic understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes.
 



 • Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting ability.
 



 • Good written and spoken English.
 



 • Ability to document engineering work clearly.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Bachelor’s degree in one of the following or a closely related discipline:
 



 • Mechatronics Engineering
 



 • Electronics \& Communication Engineering
 



 • Electronics Engineering
 



 • Mechanical Engineering
 



 • Instrumentation Engineering
 



 • Electrical Engineering
 



  





 Fresh graduates with strong hands\-on project experience are encouraged to apply.
 



 Candidates with approximately 0–2 years of relevant experience are preferred.
 



 Your degree matters less to us than your ability to demonstrate that you can actually build and troubleshoot working systems.
 



  





**Strongly Preferred** 




 Candidates who have personally built projects involving combinations of:
 



 • ESP32 / Arduino / Raspberry Pi
 



 • Sensors and data acquisition
 



 • Cameras or image processing
 



 • Audio acquisition or processing
 



 • Motors and motion control
 



 • Displays and user interfaces
 



 • IoT or wireless communication
 



 • Signal processing
 



 • PCB design
 



 • Battery\-powered devices
 



 • Python applications interacting with physical hardware
 



 • Electromechanical systems
 



 • Medical\-device prototypes
 



  





 Personal projects, university projects and prototypes are all acceptable, provided you can clearly explain what you personally designed, programmed, built and debugged.
 



  





**About iNSPIRE Design** 




 iNSPIRE Design is an Ahmedabad\-based product development and engineering company working with startups, businesses, researchers and healthcare professionals to develop new physical products.
 



 Our work includes medical devices, mechanical and electromechanical products, embedded prototypes, proof\-of\-concept systems, product engineering and manufacturing support.
 



 Because we develop products from the ground up, engineers are exposed to the complete development process rather than working on only one small part of a larger system.
 



  





**Who Will Do Well Here?** 




 This position will suit someone who enjoys sitting down with a collection of mechanical parts, sensors, wires, development boards and a laptop, and turning them into a working product.
 



  





 We don’t expect a junior engineer to know everything.
 



  





 We do expect you to understand engineering fundamentals, be comfortable experimenting, know how to research technical problems and be willing to get your hands dirty building and debugging prototypes.
 



 If your engineering experience has primarily been theoretical and you are not comfortable physically building and troubleshooting systems, this role is unlikely to be a good fit.
 



  





**Work Location** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site position in Ahmedabad.
 



 Candidates available to join immediately or at short notice will be preferred.
 



  





**Salary Budget** 




 ₹25000 \- ₹35,000 per month, based on skills.

title: Turn ESP8266 into Smart Dictionary That Finds Meanings, Synonyms, and Antonyms...
description:
*This Wi\-Fi\-enabled smart dictionary uses an ESP8266 NodeMCU to retrieve word meanings, synonyms, and antonyms from online APIs in real time. The project uses the Arduino IDE, Wi\-Fi, HTTP requests, and ArduinoJson to turn a low\-cost ESP8266 into an internet\-connected vocabulary tool.*
 Imagine a pocket\-sized dictionary that never runs out of words. Instead of storing thousands of definitions in memory, this ESP8266\-based smart dictionary connects to the internet and retrieves meanings, synonyms, and antonyms in real time. Besides helping users improve their vocabulary, it demonstrates how embedded systems can communicate with cloud services, making it an ideal project for learning IoT, web APIs, and JSON data processing.
   

  

 The Wi\-Fi Enabled Smart Dictionary System is an IoT\-based educational project developed using an ESP8266 NodeMCU module. provides an intelligent and efficient method for retrieving meanings, synonyms, and antonyms using internet connectivity. The project successfully combines IOT technology, cloud\-based APIs, and embedded programming to create a useful educational tool. Its simple interface, low hardware requirements, and real\-time functionality make it an excellent learning and demonstration project for students and electronics enthusiasts.
   

  

 The system enables a user to obtain the meaning, synonyms, and antonyms of any English word through an internet connection. Unlike conventional electronic dictionaries that require large memory storage, this project uses online APIs to retrieve real\-time data from the internet. The user simply enters a word in the Arduino Serial Monitor, and the ESP8266 fetches the requested information from online dictionary servers. The project demonstrates how IoT devices can interact with web\-based APIs and process JSON data for educational applications.
   

  

 With minimal hardware requirements and real\-time operation, it serves as an excellent hands\-on project for students, makers, and electronics enthusiasts who want to explore IoT applications beyond conventional sensor\-based projects.
   

  

 Principle of operation
   

  

**The Working Principle Of The Project Is Based On:**
* User input acquisition
* Wi\-Fi communication
* HTTP/HTTPS request generation
* API response handling
* JSON data parsing
* Output display on Serial Monitor


 The System Continuously Waits For User Input Through The Serial Monitor. Depending On The Symbol Entered With The Word, The ESP8266 Determines Whether The User Wants:
   

  

* Meaning
* Synonym
* Antonym


 The corresponding API request is then generated and sent through the internet.
   

  

 The user can control the type of output using simple keyboard symbols:
   

  

* No symbol → Meaning
* ‘\#’ symbol → Synonyms
* ‘\*’ symbol → Antonyms


 The system connects to a Wi\-Fi network and fetches real\-time linguistic data from online dictionary APIs and the Datamuse API. This eliminates the need for offline dictionary memory storage and enables dynamic language learning support. The project is cost\-effective, portable, and suitable for educational and learning environments.
   

  

**The Project Uses a Simple Symbol\-based Command System:**
 User Input Function Happy Meaning happy\# Synonym Happy\* Antonym
   

  

 This eliminates the need for external push buttons and makes the system easier to use directly from a laptop or computer.
   

  

 NOTE: The word happy is used here as an example.
   

  

 System overview
   

  

**The Project Mainly Consists Of:**
* ESP8266 NodeMCU module
* Wi\-Fi network connection
* Arduino IDE software
* Online dictionary APIs
* Serial Monitor interface


 The ESP8266 acts as the central controller. It connects to a Wi\-Fi network and communicates with online servers using HTTP and HTTPS protocols. When the system starts, the ESP8266 connects to the specified Wi\-Fi network using the SSID and password provided in the program.
   

  

**The Following Libraries Are Used For Connectivity:**
* ESP8266WiFi.h
* WiFiClientSecure.h
* ESP8266HTTPClient.h


 During connection, dots appear on the Serial Monitor until Wi\-Fi is successfully connected.
   

  

**Example:** 
 Connecting WiFi……
   

  

 After successful connection: WiFi Connected
   

  

 The IP address assigned by the router can also be displayed if required.
   

  

 Meaning retrieval process
   

  

 If the user enters a word without any special symbol, the system interprets the request as a meaning search.
   

  

**Example:** 
 computer
   

  

 The ESP8266 generates an HTTPS request using the Dictionary API: https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries/en/computer
   

  

**The Server Returns Data In JSON Format Containing:**
* Word
* Meaning
* Pronunciation
* Grammar information


 The ArduinoJson library parses the JSON response and extracts only the required definition. The extracted meaning is then displayed on the Serial Monitor. Example Output: Word: computer Meaning: An electronic device used for processing data.
   

  

 Synonym retrieval process
   

  

 If the user in the Serial Monitor types the ‘\#’ symbol after the word: happy i.e. happy\# and then Press Enter:\-
   

  

 The system identifies the request as a synonym search. The ESP8266 sends an HTTP request to the Datamuse API. The API returns a JSON array containing related synonym words. The ESP8266 parses the response and displays multiple synonyms.
   

  

 Example Output: SYNONYMS: joyful cheerful glad pleased
   

  

 Antonym retrieval process
   

  

 If the user in the Serial Monitor types the ‘\* ‘symbol after the word: happy,
 *i.e. happy\** 
 and then press Enter:\-
   

  

 The ESP8266 recognises it as an antonym request. The following API request is generated:
 ***https://api.datamuse.com/words?rel\_ant\=happy***
 . The Datamuse server returns opposite words in JSON format. After JSON parsing, the antonyms are displayed.
   

  

**Example Output:** 
*ANTONYMS: sad unhappy depressed*
 JSON parsing
   

  

 The APIs return data in JSON format. Since raw JSON is difficult to understand directly, the ArduinoJson library is used to decode and extract meaningful data.
   

  

**The Parsing Process Involves:**
* Receiving JSON string
* Deserialising JSON document
* Accessing required fields
* Displaying clean output


 This enables the ESP8266 to display only useful information instead of the raw JSON response.
   

  

 Role of APIs in the project
   

  

**Here, Two APIs Are Used:**
 Dictionary API
   

  

**Used For:**
* Word meanings
* Definitions
* Vocabulary information


 Datamuse API
   

  

****Used For:****
* Synonyms
* Antonyms
* Related words


 Using APIs removes the need for storing large dictionaries inside the ESP8266 memory.
   

  

 Code
   

  

 //Rakesh Jain Program FOR Wi\-Fi Enabled Smart Dictionary System \#include \#include \#include \#include const char\* ssid \= "AndroidShare\_H8"; const char\* password \= "95428748"; String input; void setup() { Serial.begin(115200\); WiFi.begin(ssid, password); Serial.print("Connecting WiFi"); while (WiFi.status() !\= WL\_CONNECTED) { delay(500\); Serial.print("."); } Serial.println(" WiFi Connected"); Serial.println("Format:"); Serial.println("word → Meaning"); Serial.println("word\# → Synonym"); Serial.println("word\* → Antonym"); Serial.println("\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-"); } void loop() { if (Serial.available()) { input \= Serial.readStringUntil(' '); input.trim(); char mode \= input.charAt(input.length() \- 1\); String word \= input; if (mode \=\= '\#' \|\| mode \=\= '\*') { word \= input.substring(0, input.length() \- 1\); } if (mode \=\= '\#') { getSynonym(word); } else if (mode \=\= '\*') { getAntonym(word); } else { getMeaning(word); } Serial.println(" Enter next word:"); } } // \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- MEANING \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- void getMeaning(String w) { WiFiClientSecure client; client.setInsecure(); HTTPClient http; String url \= "https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries/en/" \+ w; http.begin(client, url); int code \= http.GET(); if (code \> 0\) { String payload \= http.getString(); DynamicJsonDocument doc(8192\); deserializeJson(doc, payload); const char\* meaning \= doc\[0]\["meanings"]\[0]\["definitions"]\[0]\["definition"]; Serial.println(" \-\-\- MEANING \-\-\-"); Serial.println(meaning); } http.end(); } // \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- SYNONYM \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- void getSynonym(String w) { WiFiClient client; HTTPClient http; String url \= "http://api.datamuse.com/words?rel\_syn\=" \+ w; http.begin(client, url); int code \= http.GET(); if (code \> 0\) { String payload \= http.getString(); DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096\); deserializeJson(doc, payload); Serial.println(" \-\-\- SYNONYMS \-\-\-"); for (int i \= 0; i \< 5 \&\& i \< doc.size(); i\+\+) { Serial.println((const char\*)doc\[i]\["word"]); } } http.end(); } // \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- ANTONYM \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- void getAntonym(String w) { WiFiClient client; HTTPClient http; String url \= "http://api.datamuse.com/words?rel\_ant\=" \+ w; http.begin(client, url); int code \= http.GET(); if (code \> 0\) { String payload \= http.getString(); DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096\); deserializeJson(doc, payload); Serial.println(" \-\-\- ANTONYMS \-\-\-"); for (int i \= 0; i \< 5 \&\& i \< doc.size(); i\+\+) { Serial.println((const char\*)doc\[i]\["word"]); } } http.end(); }
   

  

**Example Output:**
* Type the word clean in the serial monitor and press enter key. This will give you the meaning of the word ‘clean’ as the result:\- \-\-\- MEANING \-\-\- Removal of dirt. Enter next word: 2\.Type the word clean\# in serial monitor and press enter key will give you synonyms result:\- \-\-\- SYNONYMS \-\-\- light adroit clear just complete Enter next word: 3\.Type the word clean\* in serial monitor and press enter key will give you antonyms result:\- \-\-\- ANTONYMS \-\-\- dirty soil soiled colly bemire Enter next word:


 Prototype
   

  

 Fig 1\. Code of the dictionary system on Arduino IDE
   

  

 Advantages of the Wi\-Fi Enabled Smart Dictionary project
   

  

* Simple and low\-cost design
* Real\-time internet\-based dictionary
* No external memory requirement
* Supports multiple vocabulary functions
* Easy serial\-based operation
* Demonstrates practical IoT concepts
* Useful for students and language learners


 Limitations
   

  

* Requires internet connection
* Depends on online API availability
* Serial Monitor interface is basic
* Limited by ESP8266 module’s memory capacity


 Educational importance
   

  

**This Project Can Help Students Understand:**
* IoT communication
* ESP8266 programming
* API handling
* JSON parsing
* Wi\-Fi networking
* Real\-time cloud communication

title: Manager, Robot Motion Planning
description:
Svaya Robotics works at the cutting edge of embodied\-AI robotics, with commercially deployed collaborative and bimanual humanoid robots operating alongside humans across demanding production setups. With our vertically integrated approach, spanning the entire robotics stack, we’re tackling toughest challenges in precision manipulation and safety, pioneering a new approach to automation – “your work your way” enabling flexible, scalable and resilient automation in any production setup.
   

  

 Today our mission applies to manufacturing, but it is much broader than that. We envision a future where everything that needs demanding physical work will be done by human\-centered robots with responsive autonomy capabilities operating across factories, logistics, warehouses and healthcare enhancing human potential and our team driven by unwavering passion is paving the way to that future!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Svaya Robotics is adding a
 **Manager, Robot Motion Planning** 
 , based in Hyderabad, India, you will lead development and implementation of motion planning stack across our collaborative and bimanual humanoid robots. You will drive development of efficient motion planning and control algorithms across manipulation, grasping and whole\-body control. Working alongside controls and perception teams, you will drive the team to tackle some of toughest challenges faced in deployment, making robots adapt to real world dynamic constraints, task variations and environment uncertainty with utmost reliability. You will collaborate closely with hardware and software teams to deploy motion planning stack on robot on\-board computer and drive integration with robot data and model (digital\-twin) for robust fault detection, diagnostics and recovery. You will train and mentor engineers, establish best practices and work with field engineers to address deployment challenges and continuously improve system capabilities and performance. The ideal candidate will have solid background in robot kinematics and dynamics with demonstrated experience implementing novel algorithms in production robotic systems.
   

  

**About The Work**
* Lead development and deployment of collision free motion planning algorithms for manipulation and grasping on robotic manipulators (6 \& 7 Axis) and bimanual humanoid robots
* Design and implement novel algorithms for whole body control to enable robots to adapt and recover in real\-world deployments
* Work closely with controls, perception and RL teams to develop and deploy robust autonomic stack in loco\-manipulation and grasping
* Drive robot safety to enable safe co\-working alongside humans in different environments
* Collaborate with engineers from other disciplines and communicate design and technology priorities with constructive guidance to evolve a robust and reliable robot platform
* Train and mentor team members to effectively contribute towards successful execution of product milestones and timelines


**About You**
* 6\+ years’ proven experience developing and implementing novel motion planning and trajectory optimization algorithms on robotic systems
* Deep understanding of robotics fundaments in kinematics, dynamics and controls
* Strong skills in C\+\+, multi\-threaded programming and high\-performance optimization for real\-time robotics applications
* Deep mathematical foundation in numerical optimization techniques, including convex and non\-convex problem\-solving methods
* Experience in applying model predictive control (MPC), data\-driven motion optimization and successfully implementing them in production code
* Knowledge and experience working with ROS, MoveIt is a plus
* A learning mindset with willingness to take on new challenges and solve unfamiliar problems.
* Sound technical judgement balancing innovation with development timelines and constraints, paired with clear communication across cross\-functional teams on development priorities


 Nice to Have’s
   

  

* Experience with combined planning of locomotion and manipulation
* Experience with task and motion planning under uncertainty
* Experience with perception and scene understanding as it pertains to motion planning
* Experience with floating\-base dynamics, contact/friction/constraint modeling, or sensor fusion

title: Robotics Software Test Engineer (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
At Universal Robots, part of Teradyne Inc., Our vision is to create a world where people work with robots, not like robots. And as the market leader with 75,000\+ collaborative robots (cobots) already installed worldwide, we’re well on the way to achieving it. We employ 1000\+ people in offices across North America, South America, Europe and Asia and we’re growing all the time. Our team is made up smart, creative people working at the forefront of automation. Together we find innovative solutions to some of the most important manufacturing issues facing businesses today. We dare to do what others find impossible\- working with advanced technologies to change in the way businesses operate , so if you’re looking to build your career with a ground\-breaking technology company in dynamic environment with career advancement UR is the place for you.
   

  

**Our Purpose**
 At Teradyne Robotics, including Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), our mission is simple:Automation for Anyone. Anywhere.
   

  

 Our vision is to create a world where people work with robots, not like robots. With more than 100,000 collaborative robots deployed worldwide, Universal Robots leads the global market in collaborative automation while MiR provides cutting\-edge autonomous mobile robots that transform internal logistics.
   

  

 Together we enable manufacturers of all sizes to automate, improve productivity, and empower people through robotics.
   

  

**Opportunity Overview**
 Do you want to ensure the quality and safety of software powering the world’s leading collaborative robots?
   

  

 Are you passionate about testing complex robotic systems and working closely within an international team? Then you might be our next Senior Software Test Engineer.
   

  

 We are currently looking for an experienced  Software Tester  to join our global R\&D organization, working closely with our teams in Denmark. You will become part of a growing setup in India, collaborating daily with highly skilled colleagues across locations.
   

  

**Designing the future**
 Universal Robots is the world’s market leader in collaborative robots (cobots), developing solutions that transform the way work is done across industries.
   

  

 In this role, you will contribute directly to the quality and reliability of robot platform and its core components. You would be responsible for testing the core operating system components of the Robot, including networking features, firewall features etc. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet the highest standards of performance, safety, and usability.
   

  

 We are looking for a Backend Test engineer with strong Python automation skills who enjoys working close to the product and the code. You should be comfortable combining hands\-on manual testing with Linux Based platforms using Python\-based automated testing, while also bringing a strong understanding of ROS. If you are motivated by improving product quality through robust test coverage, fast feedback loops, and close collaboration with developers, this could be the right role for you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, write, and maintain automated tests in Python for new and existing features of the operating system components of the Robot
* Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests to ensure stable and reliable releases
* Work closely with developers to understand the changes being made in the controller operating system layer or the network layer, investigate failures, and improve testability
* Contribute to and improve test frameworks
* Help define effective test strategies and quality practices across the development lifecycle in an agile setup
* Build tests that have hardware in the loop (not all flakiness comes from software)


**Qualification, Experience, Skills And Educational Background**
 To succeed in this role, we imagine you have a strong background in software test engineering and a practical mindset when it comes to combining automation with hands\-on validation. You understand how software is built, how systems fail, and how to create effective tests that increase quality and confidence.
   

  

**Skills Required**
* 4 to 6 years of experience in software backend testing, software quality engineering of OS level software components, or a similar role
* Strong experience writing and maintaining automated tests in Python for backend components using tools like pytest and FastAPI.
* Experience with Penetration testing
* Experience with API Testing
* Familiarity with GoLang and its frameworks.
* Familiarity with Containerization technique (Docker, Podman)
* Proficient with linux environment and linux commands
* Linux networking stack \+ systemd (services, journald, network namespaces)
* Network analysis tooling: Wireshark/tcpdump and nmap and traffic shaping for resilience tests.
* Hands\-on experience with manual testing of complex systems, ideally involving hardware, robotics, or integrated software\-hardware solutions
* Experience creating and maintaining unit, integration, and regression tests
* Good understanding of test frameworks, debugging, and finding root causes
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, build servers, or DevOps practices such as Jenkins or similar tools
* Ability to understand complex systems, identify risks, and design effective test coverage
* Experience working in agile or scrum environments


**It Will Be Considered An Advantage If You Have**
* Familiarity with ROS2, Industrial Communication Protocols
* Familiarity with Firewall (NF Tables/IP Tables)
* Experience building or improving test automation frameworks
* Hardware\-in\-the\-loop test frameworks such as labgrid, bench hardware, networked power for automated power\-cycling, serial console capture, etc.
* Automating through the robot's own interfaces (Dashboard Server, RTDE, the primary/secondary/real\-time client ports, URScript)
* Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, pipelines, and build servers
* Knowledge of safety standards and regulations relevant to robotics or industrial systems


**Communication Skills**
* Strong communication and collaboration skills and fluency in English
* Experience working with distributed and international teams
* Working across teams and locations
* You will be part of a setup where engineers in India and Denmark work closely together.
* This requires:
* Clear and conscientious communication
* Ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute across team boundaries

title: Technical Trainer
description:
**Company Description** 
 PR KStudy provides cutting\-edge robotics programs that empower K–12 students through hands\-on, project\-based learning. By integrating design thinking and real\-world challenges, the organization helps schools strengthen and modernize their STEM curriculum. Its learning model encourages creativity, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving in young learners. Through personalized observation and guided tinkering, PR KStudy supports each student’s natural curiosity and builds confidence in STEM subjects.
 



**Role Description** 
 The STEM Trainer will deliver robotics and STEM lessons to K–12 students in an engaging, age\-appropriate manner. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include planning and conducting interactive classes, demonstrating robotics concepts, guiding students through projects, and providing individualized support during hands\-on activities. The trainer will collaborate with school staff to align lessons with curriculum goals, manage classroom resources and equipment, and maintain a safe, inclusive learning environment. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in India, requiring regular presence at partner schools or training centers.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong STEM foundation, with knowledge in robotics, basic electronics, and programming concepts suitable for K–12 students.
* Experience in teaching, training, or mentoring children, with the ability to explain technical topics in simple, engaging ways.
* Excellent communication, classroom management, and interpersonal skills to work effectively with students, educators, and parents.
* Ability to design and deliver project\-based lessons, integrate real\-world challenges, and adapt teaching methods for different learning styles.
* Comfort with using educational technology, robotics kits, and learning platforms; willingness to learn new tools and curricula.
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Engineering, Science, or a related field preferred; relevant certifications in STEM or robotics are an advantage.
* Strong organizational skills, reliability, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving in dynamic classroom environments.
* Genuine interest in fostering creativity, curiosity, and critical thinking in young learners; commitment to inclusive and non\-discriminatory teaching practices.

description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
   

  

 Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a high\-potential
 **Product Manager Apprentice** 
 to join our Product Management team working on next\-generation
 **Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS)** 
 platforms. This role is designed for early\-career professionals who are passionate about building enterprise SaaS products and want hands\-on exposure to
 **AI\-driven customer experience technologies and modern cloud\-native architectures** 
 .
   

  

 As a Product Manager Apprentice, you will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, UX, Data Science, and GTM teams to define, build, and scale features across our CCaaS product lines — including
 **AI\-powered voice, digital, analytics, automation, workforce management and integrations platforms** 
 .
   

  

 This is a learning\-intensive role that provides real ownership, structured mentorship, and exposure to the full product lifecycle in a fast\-growing SaaS environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Discovery \& Strategy Support**
* Assist in researching customer problems across contact center domains such as Inbound, outbound campaigns, agent experience, AI automation, analytics, Quality Management, Workforce Management, and integrations
* Analyze market trends in CCaaS, AI in CX, cloud communications, and SaaS platforms
* Support product managers in defining product vision, value propositions, and roadmap priorities


**AI \& Data\-Driven Product Development**
* Work with AI/ML teams on features involving speech\-to\-text, NLP, LLMs, conversation intelligence, automation, and predictive analytics
* Help translate AI capabilities into real\-world customer use cases and measurable business outcomes
* Contribute to defining product requirements for AI\-enabled workflows and decisioning systems


**Requirements \& Delivery Execution**
* Assist in creating Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Work closely with engineering teams using Agile/Scrum methodologies to support sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release execution
* Participate in feature demos, UAT coordination, and release readiness activities


**Modern SaaS Platform Exposure**
* Gain hands\-on experience with cloud\-native, multi\-tenant SaaS architectures, APIs, microservices, security, and scalability concepts
* Support integration initiatives across CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), CPaaS providers, and enterprise ecosystems


**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Join customer calls, usability sessions, and beta programs to capture feedback and validate product direction
* Support preparation of product documentation, internal enablement, and launch materials


**What You Will Learn**
* How enterprise CCaaS platforms are built and scaled
* How AI is productized — from model capability to customer value
* How to balance customer needs, technology constraints, and business strategy
* How modern SaaS companies execute product management at scale


**Eligibility \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science (or related technical discipline)
* Strong interest in Product Management, SaaS platforms, AI technologies, and cloud computing
* Basic understanding of software development concepts, APIs, and web technologies
* Familiarity with Agile development practices is a plus


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Excellent communication and structured thinking skills
* Curiosity about AI, data platforms, and digital customer experience technologies
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, design, and business teams
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and learning


**Career Path**
 This apprenticeship is designed to develop future
 **Associate Product Owners , Associate Product Managers and Product Managers** 
 . High performers will have the opportunity to transition into a full\-time product management role with increased ownership of product areas.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
* Work on a market\-leading CCaaS platform from Five9 shaping the future of customer experience
* Get early exposure to AI\-first product development in a real enterprise environment
* Structured mentorship from experienced product leaders
* Opportunity to grow rapidly in one of the fastest\-growing technology domains


 Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.

* Product management experience in cybersecurity, cloud security.

title: Product Manager Hardware Device
description:
**Product Manager \- Hardware Devices** 




  





**Context** 




 We’re looking for a Product Manager for our Hardware Devices Team. This team produces both communications equipment that interfaces with medical equipment and produces medical equipment, like ECG machines, as well.
 



 These are electronics hardware devices that are coupled with firmware internally, software externally and algorithms.
 



  





 The successful HDPM will need to have a broad based understanding of three disparate areas:
 



 \- The first and most important is the ability to develop a good idea of customer needs from the business teams.
 



 The HDPM must be careful in parsing through a lot of secondary data from them and willing to collect data from primary sources in the field as well. The successful HDPM will need to have an opinion about customer requirements based on all these data points. This is the what and why of the product.
 



 \- Second, the HDPM should have a detailed understanding of the functionality and limitations of the technology used to build the product. Since the HD Team is building electronics, an in depth understanding of electronics and experience building them is going to be a big plus. However, we do have fantastic technical leads so as long as you have the attitude and aptitude to learn, you’ll be fine. You will be required to work with the hardware, software and algo leads to work on an architecture that should include the pros and cons of each consideration of how the market needs can be fulfilled. Again, here too, you must be opinionated on some technology choices based on what will and may not work in the market based on needs and pricing. This is the how of the product.
 



 \- Third, the HDPM will be key in understanding the standardization and certification requirements for the product for each country that we would want to market it in over a horizon of a few years. The candidate must be able to read through multiple standards and work with the regulatory team to understand the boundaries of testing for safety and efficacy of the product. The HDPM must have enough knowledge of the standards that they can explain the needs to the leads to inform technology decisions and constraints to the business teams. Through the above, the candidate must be able to build and maintain the design, development, testing and certification plan going toward product launch and post market surveillance.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 \- Create and maintain Product requirements
 



 \- By speaking with the stakeholders like business owners, sales teams, and support team regularly
 



 \- On the direction of the product owner (Hardware Devices Team Head)
 



 \- By analyzing usage, complaints and market indicators.
 



 \- Delivery of features
 



 \- By planning the feature development
 



 \- By working closely with the engineering team to align them with the requirements
 



 \- By tracking the development progress
 



 \- Good quality of the product
 



 \- By developing the verification and validation plans
 



 \- By working with the quality team to execute on the verification and validation suite
 



 \- Adherence to 13485 and 62304 standards.
 



 \- By understanding the requirements of these processes through reading and training.
 



 \- By ensuring all the correct development processes are being followed
 



 \- By creating the documentation required
 



 \- Maintaining Product roadmap
 



 \- By speaking with the stakeholders like business owners, sales teams, and support team regularly.
 



 \- By gathering market information, industry trends
 



 \- By evaluating new product ideas
 



 \- By analyzing competitors by understanding their products
 



  





**Skills** 




 \- Ability to write product requirements and other formal documents with precision and clarity.
 



 \- Background in technology. A hardware development background will be a plus.
 



 \- Project management skills to create and maintain project plans in Gantt tools.
 



 \- Personal time management skills to ensure that no tasks are lost and no threads are lost without follow up.
 



 \- Appreciation of processes and doing activities as per the process.

 Our people make all the difference in our success. **About The Role**

* Offline\-First Excellence: Building sophisticated synchronization engines that handle complex data conflict resolution silently and reliably, ensuring the technician's workflow is never interrupted by connectivity issues.
* Intelligent Assistance: Transitioning from static forms to AI\-driven workflows to reduce administrative burden and improve technician efficiency.
* UX as a Strategy: Prioritizing intuitive design that simplifies the enterprise complexity, making the mobile app an asset rather than a hurdle.


 Who you are
   

  

* You are a Product Manager with up to 5 years of industry experience, which includes 2\-4 years of experience in product management in a fast\-paced environment, preferably in a B2B SAAS company.
* You have a strong technical background and excel at analytical thinking.

 As a Product Manager at PTC, you will...

* Empower the development team by giving context, setting direction, and building alignment

 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
   

  

 If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

**Job Context**
 The primary switchgear range is a new offer central to the continued growth of the Lucy Electric business; the role is critical to the introduction of this offer in the global market. Understanding of regional legislation, markets and applications shall be used to ensure the offer is developed and marketed correctly ensuring successful product launch to the target markets and fully supporting the offer during its lifetime.

 Current Offer Management \-
   

  

 Responsible with the Global Head of Product management for the control and management of the current and any future primary application switchgear offers through its lifecycle. This shall also include working with other digital products for integration and co\-ordination of these offers into the offer. This includes being part of the current tender escalation and approval process. Maintenance control and update and issue of all sales and marketing collateral. Creation and maintenance of any standard offer decision trees and management of the implementation into Tacton / configurator tendering tool.  Update and support the global sales managers on a regular basis on any offer updates which would affect the technical offer or application. Creation of any sales specific tools as requested such as white papers, price lists or custom collateral.
   

  

 Customer Support \-
   

  

 Support global sales with direct interaction with their customers where required. This may range from attending meetings to present the offer to delivering specific training sessions to the end users. Attendance at global customer events and exhibition to present the offer shall be required as will support of new product launches.

 Identifi cation by conducting market research and customer visits to understand the precise needs, challenges and problems faced by our current and future customers. Develop and deploy the marketing strategy for their product ranges to maximise sales.

 Working collaboratively with other Lucy Group business to ensure the full width of wallet is leveraged within the customer segments.

 Higher Level qualification in Electronic Engineering or related subject held from an accredited university.

 Knowledge of primary application switchgear and associated protection schemes.

The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of the Booking Holdings brands and business units.
   

  

 At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests.  We are currently looking for a
 **Product Manager** 
 to join our Tax track. This is a high\-impact area focused on building and maintaining tax capabilities that support the global ambitions of the business.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As a Product Manager in the Tax product area, you will own a defined product scope within our global tax infrastructure. You will be responsible for shaping the problem space, defining what to build, and driving delivery within your team. You will work closely with Engineering, Tax Experts, and Finance stakeholders to ensure your product area meets compliance obligations while contributing to the longer\-term platform vision.

* Roadmap Ownership: Define and maintain an 18\-month roadmap for your product area, grounded in validated customer/business insight and clear prioritization.

* Cross\-Team Alignment: Coordinate across dependencies with other teams in the Tax track and broader FinTech org, identifying and mitigating risks early.
* Operational Excellence: Own team\-level success metrics, including platform health, data integrity, and delivery velocity. Ensure operational readiness (monitoring, alerting, rollback plans) for every release.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 4\-6 years of Product Management experience. Experience working on Platform, Infrastructure, or Regulatory compliance products is a plus.
* Technical Comfort: You can discuss API contracts, data schemas, and system dependencies with Engineers, and translate those into product decisions.
* Delivery Track Record: Experience operating in complex, legacy environments. You can manage delivery while navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities.
* Stakeholder Communication: Strong communication skills with the ability to align a stable set of stakeholders across disciplines and manage expectations clearly.
* Domain Interest: Prior exposure to FinTech, Payments, or Tax Technology is a good to have, not a requirement.
* Agency: You are hands\-on and detail\-oriented. You don't just identify problems; you drive them to resolution within your team.

title: Project Manager
description:
**U.S. GenAI Startup, Pune Office, Private Limited Company**
*Full Time Employment directly to our Private Limited Company. We are committed to an enduring and robust presence in Pune. Our goal is to enable you to have a long enduring career at Blitzy with opportunity for advancement throughout your career at the company. If you want a role you can turn into a career, read on! If you are looking for a short term arrangement, we recommend you look elsewhere!*
**About Blitzy**
 Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into production\-ready code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start\-ups.
   

  

**Location: Pune, India (HQ2 — On\-site)**
**The Role**
 Blitzy is looking for a highly organized, detail\-obsessed Project Manager to join our Pune team. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and client delivery—owning the coordination and execution that keeps complex, fast\-moving software projects on track. You won't just manage timelines; you'll be a force multiplier for the team, anticipating blockers before they happen, holding stakeholders accountable, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and earns trust through relentless follow\-through.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
* Projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with clear communication at every stage—no surprises.
* You have built a deep understanding of Blitzy's platform and processes through self\-directed learning, not hand\-holding.
* Engineering and product teams describe you as the person who makes everything run smoother.
* Stakeholders—internal and external—trust you as their single point of accountability for project status.
* Risks are identified and escalated early; blockers are resolved before they become delays.
* Your documentation, trackers, and reporting are always current, clean, and acted upon.


**Areas of Ownership**
* End\-to\-end project lifecycle management: scoping, planning, execution, tracking, and closure across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Obsessive attention to detail \- every status, dependency, and open item is tracked, documented, and acted upon. So nothing slips through the cracks
* Maintaining meticulous project plans, status dashboards, RAID logs, and milestone tracking with obsessive attention to detail.
* Takes full ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. Drives work to the finish line without being asked twice, and holds others accountable to do the same
* Facilitating cross\-functional standups, sprint reviews, and stakeholder syncs—driving clear outcomes and documented next steps.
* Proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and scope creep; escalating with proposed solutions, not just problems.
* Serving as the communication backbone between engineering, QA, product, and client\-facing teams.
* Owning resource coordination and capacity planning across sprint cycles.
* Strong async communicator \- know how to write a crisp status update, a clear Slack message, or a well\-structured escalation that gets the right people moving without a meeting
* Continuously improving project workflows, templates, and tooling to increase team efficiency.


**Required Experience**
* 3–6 years of project management or program management experience, preferably in a software development or technology environment.
* Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities.
* Hands\-on experience with project management tools such as Jira, Asana, Linear, or equivalent.
* Strong command of Agile/Scrum methodologies; experience running sprint ceremonies end\-to\-end.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to distill complex status into clear, actionable summaries.
* Demonstrated ability to learn independently—you seek out answers, read documentation, and upskill proactively.
* Strong organizational instincts: nothing slips, everything is tracked, and your systems reflect it.
* Experience working across HQ1 (US) and HQ2 (India) time zones \- comfortable bridging communication gaps and ensuring nothing falls through between shifts


**What Makes You Stand Out**
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, CSM, or equivalent certification.
* Experience working in a high\-growth startup or AI/software development company.
* Familiarity with SDLC concepts and the ability to hold technical conversations with engineering teams.
* Experience managing external client relationships alongside internal delivery.
* You have built project management systems from scratch—not just inherited them.


**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most PM roles ask you to manage processes that already exist. At Blitzy, you'll be building them. You'll work directly with a world\-class engineering team pushing the frontier of autonomous software development—which means your projects won't look like anyone else's. The pace is fast, the stakes are high, and the room to grow is real. If you've been looking for a role where your organizational superpower actually matters, this is it.
   

  

**Our Culture**
**Who We Are**
 Led by two pioneering co\-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500\.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company's and our clients' most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
   

  

 Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in\-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
   

  

 Passion for Invention: We're pushing the frontier of what's possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
   

  

 We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.
   

  

 We believe in being 'everyday athletes'—taking care of ourselves so we can bring our best minds to work. We promote great sleep, movement, and restorative activities for optimal mental performance. It makes for a happier and more productive team.
   

  

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger.*

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Associate Project Manager will play a key role in supporting the Director of Payment Lifecycle by managing and maintaining the operational structure of ongoing improvement initiatives. This role involves organizing, tracking, and communicating the status of various projects, ensuring clarity and consistency across the initiative portfolio.
   

  

**Initiative Management**
* Maintain a centralized inventory of all active and planned initiatives.
* Ensure initiatives are correctly labeled and categorized according to scope, priority, and impact.
* Update initiative status weekly, reflecting progress, blockers, and changes.
* Add new initiatives and relevant documentation as needed.


**Information Governance**
* Ensure initiative records are complete, accurate, and up to date.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather information or clarify project details.
* Support version control and historical tracking of initiative changes.


**Reporting \& Communication**
* Prepare weekly summaries and dashboards for leadership review.
* Highlight key updates, risks, and dependencies across initiatives.
* Assist in preparing materials for cross\-functional meetings and reviews.


**Process Support**
* Identify opportunities to improve initiative tracking and reporting workflows.
* Support the Director in identifying and implementing process enhancements across the payment lifecycle.
* Document and standardize best practices for initiative management.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 2–4 years of experience in project coordination or project management.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Experience in payment operations or financial services is a plus.


**Preferred Attributes**
* Detail\-oriented with a proactive mindset.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative and able to engage with cross\-functional teams.
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

**Title : Program Manager.**

 **Networked Solutions Program Manager**

* Drive cross\-functional alignment and ensure milestone adherence across phase gates, DVT, EVT, prototype builds, etc.

* Communicate progress to all levels of the business regularly.

* Experience aligning internal and external stakeholders on system decisions and trade\-offs.
* Strong leadership skills with excellent communication, organizational and people skills, and the ability to work with cross\-functional groups spread globally including diverse cultures and backgrounds.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Company Description**
 Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
 **Good Health Can’t Wait** 
 .
   

  

 We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
   

  

 For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
