title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
Ascentt is building cutting\-edge data analytics \& AI/ML solutions for global automotive and manufacturing leaders. We turn enterprise data into real\-time decisions using advanced machine learning and GenAI. Our team solves hard engineering problems at scale, with real\-world industry impact. We’re hiring passionate builders to shape the future of industrial intelligence.
   

  

****Senior Scrum Master****
****Locations:****
 Indore, Madhya Pradesh / Pune, Maharashtra
   

  

****Work Arrangement:****
 Office\-based
   

  

****Role Type:****
 Full\-time
   

  

**About Ascentt**
 Ascentt is a technology consulting and AI services firm that partners with global enterprises to deliver complex data, AI, and digital transformation programs. Our teams work directly with enterprise client stakeholders on high\-visibility engagements where delivery discipline, transparency, and outcomes matter. We offer a collaborative environment, direct exposure to global clients, and the opportunity to shape how modern Agile delivery works on AI\-driven programs.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Senior Scrum Master at Ascentt, you will lead the Agile delivery of one cross\-functional Scrum team building technology and AI\-driven solutions for enterprise clients.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on Agile leadership role. The delivery environment entails enterprise\-scale programs, cross\-team dependencies, and direct engagement with client stakeholders. The seniority of this role lies in the judgment it requires, knowing when to coach, when to facilitate, when to challenge, and when to escalate.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who
 ****leans into problems, engages the right people, drives closure, challenges teams constructively, and operates comfortably with internal and client stakeholders.****
****Work Location \& Client Collaboration****
 This is an
 ****office\-based position****
 at Ascentt's Indore or Pune location. Regular presence in the office is required.
   

  

 Because Ascentt works with global enterprise clients, the Senior Scrum Master will need the flexibility to
 ****overlap with U.S. client working hours as needed****
 for Agile ceremonies, stakeholder discussions, planning sessions, and issue resolution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
****Agile Leadership \& Scrum Execution****
* Serve as Scrum Master for one cross\-functional Agile delivery team, leading sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies produce clear decisions, commitments, and actions — and that the team establishes and stays focused on clear sprint goals.
* Apply Scrum and Agile principles pragmatically, promoting transparency, accountability, and shared ownership while protecting the team from unnecessary disruption.


****Sprint \& Backlog Readiness****
* Partner with the Product Owner to maintain a healthy, prioritized, appropriately refined backlog.
* Surface unclear requirements, unresolved questions, dependencies, and readiness gaps before work enters a sprint.
* Facilitate sprint planning grounded in priorities, team capacity, and dependencies.


****Impediments, Risks \& Dependencies****
* Proactively identify impediments, risks, dependencies, and emerging delivery challenges, early enough for the team to manage their impact.
* Drive issues to resolution with clear ownership, actions, and follow\-through, bringing in the right people when decisions or support are needed beyond the team.
* Escalate significant impediments with clear context, impact, and required action.


****Delivery Visibility \& Predictability****
* Maintain transparency into sprint progress, capacity, backlog health, risks, and dependencies, and flag early when commitments are at risk.
* Use Agile metrics (predictability, carryover, cycle time, throughput) to to identify trends and drive team improvement.
* Give stakeholders appropriate visibility into delivery status.


****Coaching \& Continuous Improvement****
* Coach the team on Agile principles, accountability, and effective performance of their roles.
* Facilitate retrospectives that produce meaningful, followed\-through improvement actions, and address recurring problems at their root cause.
* Progressively builds the team's maturity and self\-organization so it depends less on the Scrum Master for routine execution.


****Stakeholder \& Cross\-Team Collaboration****
* Build effective relationships with Product Owners, technical leaders, and internal and client stakeholders; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly and proactively.
* Facilitate alignment between business and technical stakeholders, including difficult conversations, moving participants toward clear decisions.
* Coordinate with other Scrum Masters and teams where dependencies exist and contribute lessons learned to Ascentt's broader Agile delivery practice.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of overall experience in software development or technology delivery environments.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Scrum Master or Agile delivery leader for cross\-functional software or technology teams.
* Demonstrated experience facilitating the full set of Scrum ceremonies and applying Agile principles in real\-world delivery environments.
* Strong track record identifying and driving resolution of impediments, delivery risks, and cross\-team dependencies.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery metrics and their appropriate use in improving predictability and team effectiveness.
* Proficiency with Jira or comparable Agile work\-management tools.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience in distributed or global delivery environments, with flexibility to overlap with U.S. client hours as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, PMI\-ACP, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience with enterprise clients in a consulting environment.
* Exposure to AI, Generative AI, data, cloud, or other emerging\-technology delivery environments.
* Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or related industries.


**What Success Looks Like**
 A successful Senior Scrum Master creates an environment in which:
   

  

* Sprint goals are clear, and the team enters sprints with well\-understood, prepared work.
* Risks, dependencies, and impediments surface early, have clear owners, and are driven to resolution.
* Sprint commitments become increasingly realistic and predictable.
* Stakeholders have the visibility they need without unnecessary reporting overhead.
* Retrospectives lead to observable improvements, and recurring problems are fixed at the root.
* The team grows progressively more self\-organizing, collaborative, and accountable.


 Ultimately, the Senior Scrum Master's impact is visible in the team's ability to anticipate and resolve delivery challenges, make better decisions, and consistently deliver valuable outcomes.

**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**The Role** 
  

  

 We're looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer to join our College Pads team in Hyderabad, India.

You will be initially optimising the current College Pads platform and in the future transition to working on a AI first new platform. You'll partmer closely with Product and Engineering to experiment to learn fast, and iterate optimising user journeys for outstanding user experience and lead conversion.

This is a high\-ownership senior independent contributor role: you'll influence product direction within your domain, elevate design quality across initiatives, and help mature a growing global design practice.
   

  

 We're looking for a designer with strong experience in B2B2C products, ideally in lead\-based environments where acquisition, conversion, engagement, and monetization are tightly connected. You bring deep strength in UX research and experimentation, and you use data, customer insight, and sound judgment to shape solutions. You're curious about AI and emerging tools, however grounded in a problem\-first mindset and thoughtful about when they create real value.

* Drive outcomes, not just outputs: Design with a focus on acquisition, conversion, and engagement measuring success through real usage and impact
* Turn complexity into clarity: Shape multi\-sided experiences (students, universities, property managers) into simple, intuitive journeys
* Work fast and iteratively: Prototype, test, ship, and refine in tight cycles with direct user feedback
* Lead through discovery: Engage users continuously, define problems clearly, and validate solutions with evidence
* Operate AI\-first: Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and execution while staying grounded in real user problems
* Raise the bar: improve design quality, and contribute to a growing India and global design practice


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years designing complex digital products B2B2C or B2C

* Experience in experimentation and A/B testing
* Strong UX fundamentals across flows, systems, and interaction design
* Comfortable working in lean, fast\-paced teams with high ownership

* Experience using AI in design workflows or product experiences


*Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!*
  

  

**Reasons to join our Team:** 
  

  

 StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
   

  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20\+ years—a testament to our people\-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry\-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long\-Term Vision: We're not here for short\-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long\-term industry leadership.
* Z\-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z\-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.


 If you are excited about building game\-changing products in a high\-impact, collaborative environment—StarRez India is the place for you.
   

  

*We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.*

* You are customer\-oriented and can understand the complete business value chain seen from a customer perspective


**What We Offer**
 We offer a very exciting job in a flat, multi\-cultural and international department focusing on reaching world class results. To us, it is all about knowing the market and our customers, defining the right solutions and getting it done \- all in the best possible way. We would like you to participate in that mission.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Your primary location will be in Chennai, India
   

  

 Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 15th Aug 2026
   

  

 Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels.

 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 185 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.

**What We’re Looking For**
 We are seeking a motivated and creative Copywriter Intern / Freelancer who is passionate about storytelling, content creation, and crafting compelling brand narratives. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning ideas into impactful content and is excited to contribute to a variety of brands and campaigns across digital platforms.
   

  

**You Should Be**
* Creative: You bring fresh ideas, unique perspectives, and strong storytelling abilities.
* Skilled: You can write engaging, audience\-focused copy across multiple content formats.
* Adaptable: You can seamlessly switch between different brand voices, tones, and industries.
* Collaborative: You enjoy working closely with designers, video editors, strategists, and account managers to bring creative concepts to life.
* Enthusiastic: You are curious about trends, digital culture, and the evolving world of content and advertising.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Write engaging and impactful copy for social media posts across various platforms.
* Script Instagram Reels, short\-form videos, and social\-first content.
* Develop scripts for digital video commercials, brand films, and integrated campaigns.
* Create copy for static creatives, carousels and advertisements campaigns.
* Collaborate with the creative team to brainstorm content ideas, campaign concepts, and storytelling approaches.
* Adapt brand tone, voice, and messaging across diverse industries and target audiences.
* Support content strategy with fresh, trend\-aware, and culturally relevant writing.
* Work closely with designers, video editors, and account managers to ensure cohesive campaign execution.
* Conduct basic research on industry trends, competitors, and audience insights to strengthen content quality.


**Requirements**
* Strong writing and communication skills with a natural flair for storytelling.

* Interest in marketing, advertising, content creation, branding, and digital culture.
* Strong attention to detail, creativity, and conceptual thinking.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines efficiently.
* Eagerness to learn, accept feedback, and grow in a fast\-paced creative environment.
* Portfolio, writing samples, published content, or personal content projects will be considered a strong advantage.


**To Apply**
 Email us at
 **hr@urbantalkies.com** 
 with:
   

  

* Your resume
* A little about yourself, in your own words
* A short note telling us why we should hire you

description:

 Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in India. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visas for this position.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Participate in projects at life sciences companies designing and deploying Quality \& Manufacturing applications
* Support Functional Analysts in workshops and be part of customer discussions of the Vault Qualitysuite (Vault QMS, Vault QualityDocs, Vault Training)
* Quality/Content management solution design, prototyping, configuration, and documentation
* Solution and configuration of Veeva Vault Quality Suite per customer requirements, including workflows, document types, security, fields, page layouts, reports, dashboards, formatted output reports, and notifications
* Leveraging enablement of out\-of\-the\-box or best practices configuration approach to solution strategy
* Assessing the impact of change on the current configuration and working with key stakeholders to make informed decisions in a timely manner
* Represent Professional Services across multiple engagements and workstreams (e.g., solution design and configuration, data migration, systems integration, etc.)
* Ensure customer success from the beginning to the end of the engagement life cycle


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's Degree in Life science, computer science, or related degree
* Solid analytical and great interpersonal skills
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
* Strong attention to detail
* Highly organized
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements and willingness to "roll up your sleeves" to design and implement a solution
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements


****Nice to Have****
* Knowledge of Quality operations within the Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotech industry, and/or equivalent.


**Perks \& Benefits**
* Health \& wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break


 Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

title: Consultant, Managed Services- Google Cloud Platform
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
* Customer


 The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology\-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

**Level:** 
 Consultant Managed Service or equivalent
   

  

 Design and engineer next\-generation commerce experiences on Google Cloud, combining Universal Commerce Platform building blocks with emerging agentic commerce patterns — AI agents that browse catalogs, negotiate, decide, and transact on behalf of consumers and businesses. The role sits at the intersection of GCP, headless commerce, and Vertex AI / Gemini\-based agent stacks, supporting DF\&O AM\&C client engagements end to end from architecture through Operate .
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
* Architect commerce solutions on GCP across catalog, cart, checkout, fulfillment, and post\-purchase domains.
* Implement agentic commerce capabilities: agent orchestration, tool use, MCP / A2A integrations, and conversational shopping flows.
* Build and integrate APIs and microservices across commerce engines (commercetools, Shopify, SAP CC, or Google's Universal Commerce stack) and Google's commerce AI services — Vertex AI Search for Commerce, Recommendations AI, Discovery AI.
* Design event\-driven architectures using Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Functions, and Cloud Run.
* Integrate with Google's data and merchant ecosystem (Merchant Center, Shopping APIs, Product Studio).
* Partner with experience in design, frontend, and martech teams on agent\-driven customer journeys and personalization.
* Contribute to Operate runbooks, observability standards, and AI agent guardrails for production deployments.


**The team:**
 Our
 **Digital Foundry Operate \& Innovations** 
 (DFO\&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end\-to\-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever\-evolving digital landscape.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills**
* 3 \- 6 years building production solutions on Google Cloud Platform.
* Hands\-on with core GCP services: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Firestore, Spanner, Apigee.
* Experience with one or more commerce platforms (commerce tools, SAP Commerce Cloud, Shopify, BigCommerce, or Google's Universal Commerce stack).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI patterns: LLM orchestration, function calling, tool use, retrieval, MCP and A2A protocols.
* Strong API design (REST, GraphQL) and proficiency in Python, Node.js, or Java.
* Familiarity with Vertex AI, Gemini, and Agent Builder / Conversational Agents.
* GCP Professional Cloud Developer or Cloud Architect certification preferred.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Prior delivery experience on Vertex AI Search for Commerce or Recommendations AI.
* Exposure to retail, CPG, travel, hospitality, or financial services commerce.
* Experience with payment orchestration (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree).
* Familiarity with composable commerce and MACH architecture principles.


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Integration Consultant
description:
*This role sits in two worlds and needs to be equally comfortable in both. In the morning you might be in a scoping call with a General Counsel or Chief Compliance Officer, agreeing integration architecture. In the afternoon you are building it. We are not looking for someone who does one and delegates the other.*
**What You Will Do**
 — Lead client discovery and scoping sessions: understanding existing tech stacks, data flows, and pain points clearly enough to design a solution in the room
   

  

 — Build integrations end\-to\-end using n8n as the primary orchestration layer: workflows, webhooks, API connectors, error handling, retry logic
   

  

 — Connect our platform and client systems to the tools they already use: case management, contract platforms, and business systems as required
   

  

 — Own the integration documentation: what was built, why, and how to maintain it
   

  

 — Support clients post go\-live: not just hand off and move on
   

  

 — Feed implementation learnings back into the product team so we stop solving the same problems twice
   

  

**What We Need From You**
 — Genuine n8n expertise: you have built complex, production workflows, not just followed tutorials
   

  

 — Solid REST API knowledge: authentication, pagination, rate limiting, error handling: the full picture
   

  

 — The confidence to run a client meeting with senior stakeholders and take it somewhere useful
   

  

 — Strong written communication: your scoping documents and integration specs need to be clear enough that clients can sign off without a call to clarify
   

  

 — Enough technical breadth to work across JavaScript, Python, and SQL as situations demand
   

  

 — An understanding of data security basics: client data handling, access controls, and audit trails
   

  

**What Will Set You Apart**
 — Experience integrating with legal technology platforms: Thomson Reuters products particularly welcome
   

  

 — Prior consulting background: you know how to manage scope, flag risk early, and keep clients confident
   

  

 — Exposure to regulated industry implementations where data handling is the whole point, not an afterthought
   

  

 — Familiarity with Power Automate or Zapier as complementary tools alongside n8n
   

  

**HONEST CONTEXT**

 — We operate across UK, Europe, US, UAE, and India: some flexibility on working hours will be required

You will lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and highly available content management solutions while providing technical leadership throughout the platform lifecycle.

description:

 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**The Challenge**
 Due to rapid growth and an increased demand for our platform, OneTrust is seeking a
 **Technical Implementation Consultant** 
 . The Technical Implementation Consultant role is one of the key pieces of the OneTrust architecture. After the sales process, consultants are the key contact in driving and building the relationship, implementing the solution and managing the expectations of the customer. Technical Implementation Consultants work across the technical modules. As a Technical Implementation Consultant, you will be responsible for the customer relationship and will work directly with our customers to enhance their overall user experience with the OneTrust platform. The role is one of the most important as it is the bridge between OneTrust and the customer, helping the business grow by identifying product enhancements and relaying them between the customer and OneTrust Product teams.
   

  

**Your Mission**
**As a Technical Implementation Consultant, You Will**
* Own end\-to\-end technical implementation and support customer adoption from kick\-off through go\-live.
* Monitor and analyze the customer’s adoption of our solution features and functionality in order to provide leadership with an understanding of their overall business needs as they relate to our products and improve value realised.
* Provide assurance and oversight to customers implementing OneTrust’s platform regarding SaaS implementations including underlying hardware and software architectures.
* Triage, prioritise, and drive resolution for escalated technical issues.
* Proactively identify, assess, and communicate project risks, including but not limited to delivery timelines, scope changes, customer engagement, and technical constraints.
* Use your experience across a broad range of core technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript and APIs.
* Complete internal and project documentation (including configuration logs and functional specifications).
* Seek opportunities in day\-to\-day workflow to improve quality and efficiency from ideation to deployment.
* Document processes and workflows in shareable documents for future use and adoption.
* Work closely with UI/UX design, marketing, product management and engineering on project goals and requirements
* Be an advocate for our customers by representing their issues to Product Management and Software Engineering with a focus on steering the OneTrust roadmap.
* Provide strategic and tactical support for Sales, Professional Services, and Business Development.


 You will also act as system and regulatory best practice expert, drawing from a plethora of consulting experience to advise customers on optimization of privacy program. Act as the customer advocate. Seamlessly transition ownership and action plan back to involved teams. Show ownership of issues, engage customers, establish urgent priorities and implement resolution plan. Able to resolve simple to moderate issues with minimal management intervention. Ability to interpret and deliver on custom SOW customer projects.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Also**

* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to stakeholders, taking a consultative approach to client engagements.
* Apply prior SaaS implementation experience to drive successful outcomes.
* Demonstrate independent, professional communication tailored to audience expertise; participate in discovery discussions and deliver presentations during project meetings.
* Understand and proactively manage project timelines, scope, and dependencies; consistently deliver implementation tasks on time with high quality.


**You Are**
* A coachable and organized individual with strong communication and critical thinking skills who can understand the needs of the clients and navigate them to success.
* Able to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.
* Willing to travel 10 – 20%.


**Your Experience Includes**
* BA/BS OR MS in Computer Science, Electrical OR Computer Engineering, Web Design/Development, Engineering Management or Information Technology/Systems, with 2\-5 years of relevant experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, technical consulting or advanced degree in relevant field
* Experience working with HTTP, SSO, SSL certificates, networking, and API integrations
* Experience working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python
* Familiarity with Jira/Atlassian Suite
* Exposure to other systems such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe, Eloqua, and Marketo, ServiceNow
* Effective customer\-facing relationship building skills. Proven success in and genuine enthusiasm for working directly with customer(s)
* Proven ability to engage across corporate functions (Sales, Professional Services, Support, Customer Success and Product Management)
* Previous end\-to\-end implementation experience, ideally on a SAAS platform/product
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to chair meetings or host webinars
* Strategic and critical thinking, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities
* Ability to build relationships across stakeholders in marketing, sales, and engineering
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Strong entrepreneurial skills to excel in a complex and rapidly evolving SAAS environment
* Working knowledge of implementation practices including configuration, testing, and deployment processes


 Where we Work
   

  

 We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
   

  

 Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
   

  

 Resources
   

  

 Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
   

  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram


 Your Data

 **.** 
 You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

title: Certified Internet Consultant
description:
**Company Description** 
 Justdial is India’s leading local search and services platform, offering a wide range of solutions that simplify everyday tasks for users across the country. Established in 1996 as a phone\-based local directory, it has evolved into a digital ecosystem providing services such as bill payments, bookings, ordering essentials, and event\-related offerings via Web, App, and WAP. The company’s cloud\-based JD Omni product supports businesses with sales tracking, inventory, billing, promotions, and employee management. With offices in 11 cities, a team of over 10,000 employees, and 21 million business listings, Justdial serves all major cities in India and positions itself as a one\-stop destination for “Anything, Anytime, Anywhere.”
   

**Role Description** 
 The Certified Internet Consultant role at Justdial is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Jaipur. The consultant will meet and engage local business owners, understand their requirements, and advise them on Justdial’s online solutions and JD Omni offerings to enhance their digital presence and business performance. Daily activities include conducting sales presentations, explaining product features and benefits, onboarding new clients, and ensuring accurate listing of business information on the platform. The role involves providing ongoing customer support, training clients on using Justdial’s web and app tools, and maintaining strong relationships to drive renewals and upselling. The consultant will also collaborate with internal teams to share market feedback, resolve client issues, and contribute to regional growth targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Consulting and advisory skills to understand business needs and recommend suitable Justdial and JD Omni solutions.
* Customer Service and client relationship management skills to deliver responsive, high\-quality support and maintain long\-term partnerships.
* Sales skills, including prospecting, negotiation, and closing, with the ability to meet or exceed defined targets.
* Online Marketing knowledge to help businesses improve visibility and performance on digital platforms.
* Training skills to educate clients on product features, digital tools, and best practices for using Justdial services.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.
* Basic computer literacy and familiarity with internet\-based tools and mobile applications.
* Prior experience in field sales, consulting, or service\-based roles is preferred; experience with SMEs or local businesses is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: graduate degree in any discipline or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Ability to work on\-site in Jaipur, travel within the city for client meetings, and manage time effectively in a target\-driven environment.

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

 Software Solutions Engineering

 You are a recent graduate with a Master’s degree from an Engineering school and have some significant (around 2 years) experience (professional/internships, academic or personal projects such a GIT Hub, Meet Ups, etc.)

 You are recognized as a good team player

 You know Agile principles

title: Frontend Developer (Coimbatore)
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Frontend Developer
 



**Location:** 
 Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 



**Experience:** 
 2–4 years
 



  
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with 2–4 years of experience to build scalable, performant, and user\-friendly web applications. You'll work with modern technologies including React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Experience with AI agents and backend technologies (Node.js/Python) is a plus. The ideal candidate is passionate about clean code, responsive design, and staying current with frontend trends.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and maintain responsive, high\-performance web applications using React
* Write clean, maintainable code using TypeScript with strict type checking
* Build and optimize UI components using TanStack (React Query, React Table, etc.)
* Implement modern, accessible designs with Tailwind CSS
* Collaborate with backend developers and designers to translate requirements into code
* Conduct code reviews and contribute to improving code quality standards
* Debug and resolve frontend issues, optimize performance, and ensure cross\-browser compatibility
* Work with version control (Git) and follow CI/CD best practices
* Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives
* Stay updated with latest frontend technologies and best practices



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 2–4 years of professional frontend development experience
* Strong proficiency in React (hooks, state management, component lifecycle)
* Solid understanding of TypeScript (types, interfaces, generics)
* Experience with TanStack libraries (React Query, React Table, or similar)
* Proficiency in Tailwind CSS or similar utility\-first CSS frameworks
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
* Experience with Git version control
* Familiarity with REST APIs and API integration
* Understanding of responsive design and mobile\-first approach
* Good problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities
* Experience with debugging tools (browser DevTools, etc.)



  





**Good to Have (Optional)** 



* Experience with AI Agents or LLM integration in frontend applications
* Backend knowledge with Node.js or Python
* Experience with state management libraries (Redux, Zustand, Jotai, etc.)
* Knowledge of testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress)
* Experience with design systems or component libraries
* Familiarity with Next.js or other React frameworks
* Understanding of GraphQL
* Experience with web performance optimization
* Knowledge of accessibility (a11y) standards and WCAG compliance
* Experience with Storybook or similar documentation tools
* Familiarity with Docker or containerization
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams
* Portfolio or GitHub projects showcasing frontend work



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)

description:
**It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities, and more innovation beyond boundaries.**
 Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities, and grow your career.
   

  

 Since 2022, NAB Innovation Centre India has been strengthening NAB’s global capability from Gurugram, with continued expansion into Bengaluru.
   

  

 We were established as a centre for operations and technology excellence, helping NAB deliver faster, better and more personalised experiences to customers and colleagues.
   

  

**Our Purpose Remains Clear**
* Accelerate NAB’s current and future strategic priorities
* Strengthen emerging technology, engineering and automation capability
* Build sustainable operations at scale in India


 Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high\-performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.
   

  

**A Diverse And Inclusive Workplace Works Better For Everyone**
 Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It’s a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.
   

  

**More Focus On You**
 We’re committed to delivering a positive experience for our colleagues and a workplace you can be proud of. We support our colleagues to balance their careers and personal life through flexible working arrangements such as hybrid working and job sharing, and competitive financial and lifestyle benefits. We invest in our colleagues through world\-class development programs (Distinctive Leadership and Career Qualified in Banking), and empower you to learn, grow, and pursue exciting career opportunities.
   

  

**Join NAB India**
 This is your chance to join NAB India and, along with your experience and expertise to help shape an innovation\-driven organisation that focuses on making a positive impact in the lives of its customers, colleagues, and communities
   

  

 To know more about us, please click here
   

  

 To know more about NAB Global Innovation Centres, please click here
   

  

 We’re on LinkedIn: NAB Innovation Centre India

+ Click here to know \- What is the eLitmus pH test?

**Career That Gives You More**
* Your career at NAB is about more than money. It's about serving our customers well and helping our communities prosper.
* To enrich our Customer and Banker experience, the teams across Technology are transforming our core systems, creating modern back\-end services in a multi\-cloud environment, and uplifting our processes and technical practices.
* We are looking for talented engineers to deliver a range of technology applications and development services through design, development, programming, testing and maintenance of Technology solutions, aligned with business objectives.
* We invite you to apply for exciting careers across roles like Engineers with Programming skills.

* Proven analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated excellence in written and verbal communication.


**Benefits**

* Relocation Assistance as per company policy
* Hospitalization ( Family floater)
* Group Term Life Insurance
* Group Personal Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Online Medical Consultation


**Selection Process**

* Online Coding assessment will be based on the languages Python/Java/C\+\+ for Software Engineer
* Software Engineer role technical interview will be based on Java and Programming skills


**Note**

title: Software Engineer (Backend, 1-3 YOE)
description:
**Position Overview** 




 We are a seed\-funded startup focused on using state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies to revolutionize the credit industry. Our team consists of experts in machine learning and software engineers who have worked at top\-tier US tech companies like Apple, Amazon, etc , and we are passionate about using AI to improve access to credit information and due diligence for businesses. We have the product on the market, the first clients, and sufficient runway. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer with a strong foundation in Python and experience in backend development and data processing. The ideal candidate will have at least two years of professional experience in software development, with a significant portion dedicated to Python programming.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Backend Development:** 
 Build, maintain, and optimize backend systems using Python. Ensure the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of our data services.
* **Data Processing:** 
 Develop and maintain processes for handling large datasets, including data collection, storage, transformation, and analysis.
* **API Development:** 
 Design and implement APIs that enable seamless data retrieval and manipulation for frontend applications.
* **Collaboration and Integration:** 
 Work with cross\-functional teams to integrate backend services with other software systems and solutions within the company.
* **Performance Tuning:** 
 Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement optimizations to improve system efficiency.
* **Code Quality:** 
 Maintain high code standards, write clean, well\-documented, and testable code, and contribute to code reviews.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 2 years of professional software development experience with a focus on Python.
* Proven track record of backend development and creating efficient data processing pipelines.
* Experience with RESTful API design and development.
* Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases, as well as data modeling techniques.
* Knowledge of software best practices, like Test\-Driven Development (TDD) and Continuous Integration (CI).
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to work in a team environment.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.



  





**What We Offer** 



* An opportunity to work on challenging problems at the intersection of data and backend development.
* A dynamic environment that fosters professional growth and learning.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.

title: Mobile Architect (iOS & Android)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
 **Mobile Architect** 
 to lead the design, development, and implementation of our mobile applications across multiple platforms. This role requires a deep understanding of both cross\-platform and native mobile development, strong leadership skills, and a passion for building high\-quality, user\-friendly mobile experiences. You will be a key contributor to shaping our mobile strategy and driving innovation in our mobile products.
   

  

**Let’s Talk About Responsibilities**
* Architectural Design: Design and implement the overall architecture for our mobile applications, ensuring scalability, performance, maintainability, and security. This includes defining the technical stack, choosing appropriate frameworks and libraries, and establishing coding standards and best practices.
* Cross\-Platform Development: Lead the development of cross\-platform applications using frameworks like React Native, Flutter, or similar technologies, targeting both iOS and Android platforms.
* Native Development (iOS \& Android): Provide expertise and guidance on native iOS (Swift/Objective\-C) and Android (Kotlin/Java) development when needed for platform\-specific features or performance optimization.

title: HR Intern
description:
**HR Intern**

**Experience**

* Fresher to 6 months of experience
* Students pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field are encouraged to apply.

**Job Type**

* Internship (Full\-Time)

**Working Days**

* Monday to Friday

**Working Hours**

* 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM

**Stipend**

* As per company policy

**Job Location**

* Office\-Based

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic HR Intern to support our Human Resources department in day\-to\-day operations. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a willingness to learn, and a keen interest in recruitment, employee engagement, and HR operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

* Post job openings on job portals and social media platforms.
* Source candidates through various recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule interviews with hiring managers.
* Coordinate interview rounds and maintain interview schedules.
* Conduct initial HR screening calls.
* Follow up with candidates regarding interview status.

**Employee Onboarding**

* Prepare offer letters and joining documents.
* Collect and verify employee documentation.
* Assist in employee onboarding and orientation.
* Maintain employee records and personnel files.

**HR Operations**

* Update and maintain employee databases.
* Maintain attendance and leave records.
* Support payroll documentation.
* Prepare HR reports and MIS.
* Ensure employee files are organized and updated.

**Employee Engagement**

* Assist in organizing employee engagement activities.
* Support birthday, festival, and team events.
* Collect employee feedback and maintain engagement records.

**Documentation \& Compliance**

* Prepare HR letters, certificates, and employment documents.
* Ensure confidentiality of employee information.
* Maintain compliance\-related documentation.

**Administrative Support**

* Coordinate with different departments for manpower requirements.
* Manage HR emails and communications.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR reports.
* Perform other HR and administrative tasks assigned by the reporting manager.

**Required Skills**

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and Google Sheets.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to multitask and meet deadlines.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Good interpersonal and coordination skills.
* Professional behavior and confidentiality.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (completed or pursuing) in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of recruitment processes and HR practices.
* Familiarity with job portals and MS Office is an added advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of candidates sourced and screened.
* Interview scheduling accuracy.
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio.
* Employee documentation completion rate.
* Timely maintenance of HR records.
* Recruitment turnaround time.
* Daily HR activity reporting.
* Attendance and data accuracy.

**What You'll Learn**

* End\-to\-end recruitment process.
* HR operations and documentation.
* Employee onboarding and engagement.
* HRMS and recruitment tools.
* Communication and coordination skills.
* Corporate HR practices and compliance.

**Growth Opportunity**

Successful interns may be offered a full\-time position as an **HR Executive** based on performance, discipline, and business requirements.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
HR Executive / HR Manager

**Company:** IIT Planet  
**Industry:** Education / IIT\-JEE Preparation  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** \[Insert location]  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Salary:** \[Insert salary range]

Job Summary

IIT Planet is looking for an experienced and hands\-on HR professional to independently manage the complete employee lifecycle. The role includes hiring teachers, sales executives, counsellors, and support staff, along with payroll, employee relations, performance management, HR operations, and separation processes.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment and Hiring

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for teachers, sales executives, counsellors, HR, administration, and other operational roles.
* Understand manpower requirements and prepare appropriate job descriptions.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, recruitment agencies, and local networks.
* Screen applications, conduct initial interviews, coordinate technical or demo rounds, and negotiate salaries.
* Verify candidate documents, references, qualifications, and employment history.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, employment contracts, and joining documents.
* Maintain recruitment reports and ensure vacancies are filled within agreed timelines.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for frequently hired positions.

Onboarding and Employee Records

* Conduct onboarding and induction for new employees.
* Collect and verify identity, education, banking, tax, and previous\-employment documents.
* Create and maintain accurate physical and digital employee records.
* Explain company policies, responsibilities, performance expectations, and workplace standards.
* Manage confirmation, transfer, promotion, salary revision, and employment\-status documentation.

Payroll and Attendance

* Manage monthly payroll processing from start to finish.
* Verify attendance, leave, late arrivals, incentives, commissions, deductions, advances, and unpaid leave.
* Coordinate salary calculations for teaching, sales, and support teams.
* Prepare and verify payroll statements and salary slips.
* Coordinate statutory deductions and compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS, bonus, and gratuity, wherever applicable.
* Resolve employee payroll and attendance queries promptly.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of all compensation information.

HR Operations and Compliance

* Manage daily HR administration and ensure smooth implementation of HR policies.
* Develop and update policies relating to attendance, leave, conduct, performance, incentives, discipline, and separation.
* Maintain employee databases, leave records, attendance reports, payroll files, and statutory registers.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour and employment laws.
* Coordinate with management, finance, legal advisers, and external consultants when required.
* Prepare HR reports covering headcount, vacancies, attendance, attrition, payroll, and employee performance.

Performance and Employee Relations

* Establish measurable performance goals and KPIs for teachers, sales employees, counsellors, and support teams.
* Coordinate probation reviews, performance appraisals, promotions, salary revisions, and performance\-improvement plans.
* Monitor employee conduct, productivity, attendance, and workplace behaviour.
* Address employee complaints, conflicts, grievances, and disciplinary concerns fairly and confidentially.
* Support managers with coaching, feedback, warnings, and corrective\-action processes.
* Organize employee engagement, training, recognition, and retention initiatives.

Separation and Termination

* Manage resignations, notice periods, handovers, exit interviews, and employee clearance.
* Handle disciplinary action and termination processes professionally, consistently, and in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Conduct or coordinate fair investigations before recommending disciplinary action.
* Prepare warning letters, show\-cause notices, termination letters, relieving letters, and experience certificates.
* Coordinate full\-and\-final settlements, recovery of company property, access removal, and closure of employee records.
* Maintain complete and confidential documentation for every separation decision.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience managing recruitment, payroll, HR operations, and employee relations.
* Experience hiring teachers and sales professionals is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Indian payroll practices and employment compliance.
* Experience using job portals, HRMS, attendance systems, Excel, and Google Workspace.
* Strong interviewing, negotiation, documentation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive and confidential matters with maturity.
* Capable of working independently and coordinating directly with senior management.

Key Performance Indicators

* Time taken to fill open positions.
* Quality and retention of new hires.
* Payroll accuracy and on\-time salary processing.
* Accuracy of attendance and employee records.
* Employee turnover and absenteeism.
* Timely completion of appraisals and HR documentation.
* Compliance with company policies and applicable laws.

How to Apply

Send your updated résumé to **hr@iitplanet.com** with the subject line **“Application for HR Executive/Manager – IIT Planet.”**

Pay: ₹11,001\.51 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: HR Specialist
description:
HR Specialist
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**JOB RESPONSIBI** **L** **ITIES**

* Execute routine HR transactions including onboarding, offboarding, promotions, transfers, and benefits setup.
* Maintain employee records and ensure data accuracy in HRIS systems.
* Respond to employee and manager inquiries on HR policies, pay, benefits, leaves, performance management, and company guidelines via Workday Help/ServiceNow; escalate when required: escalate complex issues appropriately.
* Support internal audits and ensure compliance with employment laws and company policies.
* Contribute to process documentation, SOP updates, and knowledge base documentation to drive efficiency in a tiered service delivery model
* Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence and other HR functions to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Participate in projects and provide input from an operational perspective.
* Manage workload effectively, prioritizing based on business needs.
**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources , Business Administration, or related field.
* 3 years of experience in HR operations strong HR operations/Shared Services experience, preferably in a multinational environment.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday HCM and HR ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Workday Help). 
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work independently with moderate supervision.
* Demonstrates ethical behaviour and commitment to compliance.
**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.  

  



http://www.syneoshealth.com

title: IT Technician
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and responsible IT Technician to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support computer systems, network devices, CCTV systems, software, and other IT infrastructure. The candidate will provide technical assistance to users, resolve hardware and software issues, and ensure that all IT equipment operates securely and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and maintain desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, servers, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi devices, and other IT equipment.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, internet, and operating system problems.
* Provide technical support to users through phone, remote access, email, and on\-site visits.
* Install and configure Windows operating systems, drivers, antivirus software, office applications, and other business software.
* Configure and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, VLAN, IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, and basic routing.
* Install, configure, and maintain CCTV cameras, NVRs, DVRs, PoE switches, access\-control systems, and related surveillance equipment.
* Monitor network connectivity and coordinate with internet service providers for link\-related issues.
* Perform preventive maintenance of computers, network devices, UPS systems, and other IT equipment.
* Manage user accounts, passwords, permissions, shared folders, and system access.
* Maintain records of IT assets, equipment allocation, repairs, warranties, and software licences.
* Take regular backups and assist in restoring data when required.
* Follow cybersecurity practices, including antivirus updates, patch management, access control, and data protection.
* Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers or vendors.
* Prepare technical reports, service records, network diagrams, and troubleshooting documentation.
* Support IT deployment and maintenance activities at multiple project or client locations.
* Ensure compliance with organisational IT policies and safety procedures.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma, ITI, BCA, B.Sc. IT, B.Tech, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware, Windows operating systems, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and network cabling.
* Knowledge of CCTV, NVR, DVR, IP cameras, PoE, and surveillance systems will be preferred.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office, remote\-support tools, antivirus solutions, and backup systems.
* Ability to read technical manuals and follow installation procedures.

Required Skills

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of computer hardware and networking.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple service requests.
* Good communication and user\-support skills.
* Willingness to travel to different sites when required.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle urgent technical issues.
* Basic documentation and reporting skills.
* Attention to detail and a service\-oriented attitude.

Preferred Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, networking, CCTV, or field technical services.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge may also apply.
* Experience in multi\-site IT infrastructure, surveillance projects, or field support will be an advantage.

Employment Type

Full\-time

Work Location

Office and project sites, as required

Reporting To

Network Engineer, Project Manager

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short\-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real\-world experience. Qualifications
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a customer\-focused mindset and the ability to interact professionally with employees at all levels.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with HR software (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors) is a plus.
* Enthusiastic, proactive, and eager to learn about HR practices, employee engagement strategies, and organizational development.

Job Information
  
  

About Us
  
  

Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.
  
  

​
  
  

Why Join ByteDance
  
  

Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life \- a mission we work towards every day.
  
  

​
  
  

As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.
  
  

​
  
  

Diversity \& Inclusion
  
  

​
  
  

ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.
  
  

​
  
  

Trust \& Safety at ByteDance
  
  

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every\-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis.
  
  

​
  
  

​
  
  

ByteDance recognises that keeping our platform safe for the ByteDance communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining.
  
  

​
  
  

​
  
  

We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence\-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person\-centred, innovative and integrated approach.

title: Talent Attraction
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------


This role plays a central part in localizing and activating the employment value proposition (EVP) for the India market, ensuring core brand messages resonate with the local talent landscape while maintaining consistency with the enterprise employment brand strategy. This individual will lead initiatives across employer branding, recruitment marketing, candidate experience, employee recognition, and early careers to support the U.S. Bancorp India GCC growth and long\-term talent pipeline.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Localize and activate the global EVP for the India market, ensuring core brand messages are adapted to resonate with local talent while staying consistent with the enterprise employment brand strategy.
* Conduct local talent market research to understand candidate motivators, cultural nuances, and competitive employer positioning, leveraging employee focus groups, pulse surveys, and market data to inform EVP messaging and content.
* Develop and execute a localized employer branding strategy that positions U.S. Bancorp India as an employer of choice in India's competitive GCC landscape, including branded content, employee testimonials, and social media campaigns tailored to platforms such as LinkedIn, Naukri, and Glassdoor.
* Partner with India\-based leadership, HR, and communications teams to embed the EVP across all employee lifecycle touchpoints, from job descriptions and recruitment marketing to onboarding, internal communications, and career development materials.
* Build an employee advocacy and storytelling program that activates real employee voices in India, showcasing authentic career journeys, global impact stories, and the "founding member" experience to attract both lateral and early\-career talent.
* Design and implement recruitment marketing campaigns that attract high\-quality talent and enhance the end\-to\-end candidate experience, including engagement, communication, and feedback loops across active and passive talent.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition teams to improve pipeline quality, conversion metrics, and offer\-to\-join outcomes.
* Develop and execute an early careers/university talent attraction strategy for the India site, including campus recruiting programs, university partnerships, and internship or graduate rotational pipelines that build a sustainable pipeline of intern and full\-time candidates aligned to GCC hiring priorities.
* Build relationships and lead campus engagement with top\-tier engineering, business, and technology institutions to position U.S. Bancorp India as a preferred employer through career fairs, hackathons, innovation challenges, and on\-campus brand activations.
* Design early careers employer brand content and campaigns that speak to Gen Z and early\-career talent motivators — including career growth visibility, mentorship, global exposure, learning opportunities, and purpose\-driven work — and support structured onboarding, mentorship, and development pathways that drive first\-year retention.
* Partner with HR and India site leadership to activate the employee recognition platform, incorporating everyday recognition, work anniversaries, and celebrations tied to local cultural moments.
* Collaborate with global recognition program owners to ensure India\-specific efforts integrate with enterprise\-wide frameworks while allowing meaningful local customization, developing frameworks and best practices to answer questions and provide training opportunities.
* Monitor recognition quality and program usage and “coach” for appropriate use, communicating with team members at all levels as needed.
* Drive initiatives focused on employee engagement, culture building, and retention, and support DEI\-driven programs through brand storytelling and communication strategies.
* Lead development of content, storytelling, and communication strategies across digital and offline channels, partnering with global Marketing and Communications teams to amplify employer brand visibility and build thought leadership in India.
* Partner with senior leaders, HRBPs, cross\-functional teams, and external vendors to align priorities and ensure consistent execution.
* Evaluate and measure program success through insights, analytics, and metrics — including engagement, hiring outcomes, retention trends, campus conversion, and recognition participation — reporting results to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Five (5\) or more years of related experience in employer branding, talent marketing, recruitment, HR communications, or program management with proven ability to deliver results

**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Experience in GCC setup, high\-growth, or transformation environments, with proven ability to build and scale employer branding strategies
* Significant experience in employer branding, recruitment marketing, and reputation management within the India talent market
* Demonstrated ability to localize global brand strategies while maintaining enterprise alignment
* Experience designing early careers and campus recruiting programs, including university partnerships and brand activations
* Experience designing employee recognition programs that drive engagement and retention
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functionally and build collaborative partnerships across the organization
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to track and interpret hiring, engagement, and brand metrics to drive decisions
* Ability to adapt, be flexible, and pivot quickly while managing multiple projects in an ambiguous, fast\-paced environment
* Innovative, resourceful, and solutions\-oriented; actively seeks opportunities to continuously improve programs and candidate experience
* Deep understanding of social media and talent channels relevant to the India market (LinkedIn, Naukri, Glassdoor, etc.)
* Strong organizational, interpersonal, and team\-building skills — excellent written and verbal communication, including presentation skills and strong attention to detail
* PC/Microsoft skills including intermediate Outlook, SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; working knowledge of Workday reporting, metrics, and analytics


If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.
