title: Data Engineer I, Amazon
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about data and code? Does the prospect of dealing with mission\-critical data excite you? Do you want to build data engineering solutions that process a broad range of business and customer data? Do you want to continuously improve the systems that enable annual worldwide revenue of hundreds of billions of dollars? If so, then the eCommerce Services (eCS) team is for you!
   

  

 In eCommerce Services (eCS), we build systems that span the full range of eCommerce functionality, from Privacy, Identity, Purchase Experience and Ordering to Shipping, Tax and Financial integration. eCommerce Services manages several aspects of the customer life cycle, starting from account creation and sign in, to placing items in the shopping cart, proceeding through checkout, order processing, managing order history and post\-fulfillment actions such as refunds and tax invoices. eCS services determine sales tax and shipping charges, and we ensure the privacy of our customers. Our mission is to provide a commerce foundation that accelerates business innovation and delivers a secure, available, performant, and reliable shopping experience to Amazon’s customers.
   

  

 The goal of the eCS Data Engineering and Analytics team is to provide high quality, on\-time reports to Amazon business teams, enabling them to expand globally at scale. Our team has a direct impact on retail CX, a key component that runs our Amazon fly wheel.
   

  

 As a Data Engineer, you will own the architecture of DW solutions for the Enterprise using multiple platforms. You would have the opportunity to lead the design, creation and management of extremely large datasets working backwards from business use cases. You will use your strong business and communication skills to be able to work with business analysts and engineers to determine how best to design the data warehouse for reporting and analytics. You will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable ETL processes in the data warehouse platform to support the rapidly growing and dynamic business demand for data and use it to deliver the data as service which will have an immediate influence on day\-to\-day decision making.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, implement, and support a platform providing ad\-hoc access to large data sets
* Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources
* Implement data structures using best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and SQL, Redshift, and OLAP technologies
* Model data and metadata for ad\-hoc and pre\-built reporting
* Interface with business customers, gathering requirements and delivering complete reporting solutions
* Build robust and scalable data integration (ETL) pipelines using SQL, Python and Spark.
* Build and deliver high quality data sets to support business analyst, data scientists, and customer reporting needs.
* Continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self\-service support for customers


**About The Team**
 The eCS Data Engineering and Analytics team are data experts that build and manage the data environment, generate insights, and develop solutions to enable data\-driven decision making for eCS Organisation. The team’s key focus areas are gathering data requirements, setting up \& owning business metrics, data integration, building dashboards \& scorecards, and generating actionable insights for eCS stakeholders.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with SQL
* Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with big data processing technology (e.g., Hadoop or ApacheSpark), data warehouse technical architecture, infrastructure components, ETL, and reporting/analytic tools and environments

 Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6\.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
   

  

 At Greenlight, we're here to make the day\-to\-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Data Engineer** 
 to join our Data Platform team to partner with our product and business stakeholders across risk, operations, and other domains. We are looking for someone who thrives in taking on complex data infrastructure problems with the initiative, problem\-solving, and curiosity needed to build reliable and scalable solutions. This role will focus on building robust data pipelines and engineering foundations by ingesting data from disparate sources, ensuring data quality and consistency, and enabling better business decisions through reliable data infrastructure across core product areas.
   

  

 This is the perfect opportunity for an individual passionate about data engineering, who has the drive to solve complex technical problems and has the ability to grow alongside our team and our company. The ideal candidate can quickly identify data quality issues and bottlenecks, develop creative engineering solutions, and demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate technical decisions to stakeholders. We are seeking someone who is comfortable collaborating directly with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and strategically architect and implement data solutions — especially when the path forward isn't fully defined. This will include data pipeline development, data modeling, orchestration design, infrastructure automation, and data quality monitoring.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing:**
* Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines using Airflow to orchestrate data workflows that ingest, transform, and deliver data from various sources into Snowflake and Databricks.
* Designing and implementing data models in Snowflake that support analytics, reporting, and ML use cases with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Developing infrastructure as code using Terraform to automate and manage cloud resources in AWS, ensuring consistent and reproducible deployments.
* Monitoring data pipeline health and implementing data quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of data as business needs evolve.
* Optimizing data processing workflows to improve performance, reduce costs, and handle growing data volumes efficiently.
* Troubleshooting and resolving data pipeline issues, working through ambiguity to get to the root cause and implementing long\-term fixes.
* Bridging gaps between data and the business by working with cross\-functional teams across the US and India office to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
* Creating comprehensive documentation on data pipelines, data models, and infrastructure, keeping documentation up to date and facilitating knowledge transfer across the team.


**What You Should Bring:**
* 2\+ years of data engineering experience with strong technical skills and the ability to architect scalable data solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Python for data processing, automation, and building data pipelines.
* Proficiency with workflow orchestration tools, preferably Airflow, including DAG development, task dependencies, and monitoring.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses like Snowflake, including performance optimization and data modeling.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, IAM, etc.), and understanding of cloud\-based data architectures.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with data analysts, analytics engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
* An ownership mentality – this engineer will be responsible for the reliability and performance of their data pipelines and expected to fully understand data flows, dependencies, and their implications on downstream users.
* A proactive mindset. While work is assigned, engineers are expected to independently drive their work forward, ask thoughtful questions, and bring structure to ambiguous technical problems.


**Nice To Have:**
* Experience with dbt for transformation logic and analytics engineering workflows integrated with data pipelines.
* Familiarity with Databricks for large\-scale data processing, including Spark optimization and Delta Lake.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform for managing cloud resources and data infrastructure.
* Knowledge of data modeling concepts (e.g., dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions).
* Experience with CI/CD practices for data pipelines and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience with streaming data and real\-time processing frameworks


****Who We Are:****
 It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.
   

  

 Greenlight is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on age, race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Wholesale
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Wholesale India Private Limited (AWIPL) is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer I to build the data foundation that supports our product, business, and operational decisions.
   

  

 AWIPL works across wholesale and business\-to\-business commerce, including pricing and promotions, demand planning, buying, inventory management, fulfillment, returns, liquidation, vendor experience, and distribution. These programs generate data across multiple systems and business processes. The Business Intelligence Engineer will convert this data into reliable metrics, automated reports, dashboards, and actionable insights.
   

  

 In this role, you will work with Product, Business, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to understand business questions and translate them into scalable business intelligence solutions. You will use SQL, data visualization tools, and scripting languages to build datasets, automate recurring reports, investigate performance gaps, and measure the results of product launches and operational changes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will have strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to explain data clearly. You will be comfortable working with large datasets, identifying data\-quality issues, and reconciling differences between business and technical definitions. You will learn AWIPL’s end\-to\-end business processes and help teams use consistent, trusted information to make decisions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Build and maintain SQL datasets, reports, dashboards, and recurring business\-review mechanisms for AWIPL programs.
   

  

 Develop metrics across selection, pricing, promotions, forecasting, buying, inventory, fulfillment, returns, liquidation, vendor experience, and distribution.
   

  

 Work with stakeholders to document metric definitions, business rules, data sources, ownership, and refresh schedules.
   

  

 Automate manual data extraction, reconciliation, and reporting processes.
   

  

 Analyze business and operational performance, identify trends and anomalies, and conduct root\-cause analysis.
   

  

 Establish data\-quality checks and investigate discrepancies across source systems, dashboards, and financial or operational reports.
   

  

 Support product launches by defining success metrics, establishing baselines, validating instrumentation, and measuring post\-launch results.
   

  

 Support user acceptance testing by validating data flows, business rules, and expected outputs.
   

  

 Develop self\-service dashboards that allow stakeholders to monitor performance by product, vendor, category, location, program, and other relevant dimensions.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About Kestra**
 Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.
   

  

 Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission critical workloads at scale. The open source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a rapidly growing global community.
   

  

 In March 2026, we closed a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with participation from Alven, ISAI, and Axeleo, backed by founders from Datadog, dbt Labs, and Hugging Face.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We're looking for a QA Engineer based in India or Europe to ensure the quality and reliability of Kestra's platform across both the open source and Enterprise editions.
   

  

 A key part of this role involves working directly with customer support tickets: understanding reported issues, reproducing them in local or staging environments, and verifying fixes before they ship. You'll be the bridge between what customers experience and what the engineering team delivers.
   

  

 This is a fully remote position. We're hiring from India and Europe for timezone alignment with the broader team.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Review and analyze customer support tickets to understand reported issues, extract reproduction steps, and translate problems reported by customers into actionable bug reports for the engineering team.
* Reproduce bugs reported by customers across different environments and configurations, ensuring the engineering team has the context they need to fix issues efficiently.
* Design, write, and maintain test plans and test cases covering both the open source platform and Enterprise Edition features.
* Perform manual and exploratory testing for new features and regression testing for existing functionality across each release cycle.
* Collaborate with engineers to define acceptance criteria, identify edge cases, and validate fixes before release.
* Contribute to building and improving automated test coverage where applicable.
* Track and report on quality metrics, test coverage, and recurring issue patterns to help the team prioritize improvements.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* Experience in software QA with a strong foundation in both manual and automated testing methodologies.
* Ability to read and interpret customer support tickets, often with incomplete information, and systematically reproduce issues. This is central to the role.
* Knowledge of the basics of Linux. You're comfortable navigating the command line, managing files and processes, and working in a Linux environment.
* Hands on experience with Claude Code for everyday engineering and testing work.
* Familiarity with infrastructure and orchestration concepts: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, or workflow automation tools. You'll need this context to test effectively.
* Comfortable working with APIs, reading logs, and navigating distributed systems to trace issues.
* Experience writing automated tests (for instance, in Java, Python, or TypeScript) and working with test frameworks.
* Strong written communication in English. You'll collaborate with a globally distributed team and document issues clearly.
* Self directed and detail oriented. You can prioritize across incoming support issues and planned test cycles without heavy oversight.


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Past experience in a QA role that involved direct interaction with issues reported by customers or support escalations.
* Experience with open source software or B2B SaaS platforms.
* Familiarity with orchestration or workflow tools (Airflow, n8n, Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
* Experience with Playwright and agent\-browser for browser based and automated testing.
* Experience with performance testing or load testing for distributed systems.
* Knowledge of Java (Kestra's core is written in Java).


 What You Get
   

  

* Real ownership in a globally distributed, technical team.
* Direct exposure to product strategy and company priorities.
* A product used for mission critical workloads, not demos.
* Competitive compensation, equity, and health insurance.

title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
Automation \& Manual Test Engineer
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India \|
 **Company:** 
 OneCounsel \|
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time \|
 **Onsite/Hybrid** 




 About OneCounsel
 



 OneCounsel is building an AI\-native legal practice management platform for personal injury law firms in the United States. Think "TurboTax for PI Law" — combining AI\-powered document extraction, intelligent case valuation, prescriptive workflows, and conversational AI agents to transform how attorneys manage cases from first contact through settlement.
 



 The Opportunity
 



 We're looking for an Automation \& Manual Test Engineer who takes quality personally. You will be the last line of defence between our engineers and PI attorneys who depend on OneCounsel to manage cases worth hundreds of thousands of dollars. On a HIPAA\-regulated, SOC 2\-audited platform, a missed bug is not just a regression — it is a compliance event, a malpractice risk, or a data breach.
 



 This is a rare chance to:
 


* Own the end\-to\-end quality bar — from reviewing tickets in sprint planning to signing off on production deployments
* Build a test automation suite across the full stack: pytest (backend), Vitest \+ React Testing Library (frontend), Playwright (E2E), k6 (load)
* Drive coverage from the current 49%/69% baseline to the 80/70/80 CI\-enforced thresholds
* Catch authorization bypasses, PHI leaks, multi\-tenant data exposure, and financial miscalculations before they reach attorneys
* Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with a small, senior engineering team that treats tests as a first\-class deliverable
* Shape the testing strategy for AI agent outputs, streaming UIs, and event\-driven pipelines — territory most QA playbooks have never visited



 What You'll Do
 



 Manual \& Exploratory Testing
 


* Execute structured test cases and exploratory sessions across case management, intake wizard, evidence upload, party management, financial/lien ledger, and template letter generation
* Test role\-based access control across four personas (Attorney, Case Manager, Paralegal, Ops Manager) — verify every UI action respects Cedar/AVP authorization
* Validate PHI handling: confirm sensitive fields are masked in event payloads, PDFs, and API responses in line with HIPAA requirements
* Perform regression testing on every sprint release and maintain a living regression checklist tied to CI gates
* Test responsive behaviour across desktop and tablet breakpoints in the Nordic design system (Next.js 15 / shadcn/ui / Tailwind v4\)
* File detailed, reproducible bug reports in Jira with environment context, reproduction steps, expected vs. actual, and severity classification



 Test Automation — Frontend
 


* Write and maintain Vitest \+ React Testing Library unit tests for hooks, utility functions, Zod schemas, and UI components targeting 80% statement/function coverage
* Use Mock Service Worker (MSW) to mock API responses in component tests — keep tests deterministic and fast without hitting the network
* Write Playwright E2E tests for critical user flows: intake wizard (8 steps), case creation, party CRUD, document upload, and case phase transitions
* Assert that loading skeletons, error boundaries, empty states, and toast notifications fire correctly under simulated latency and error conditions
* Verify multi\-step form validation (Zod schemas), optimistic updates with rollback, and Zustand store persistence across page reloads



 Test Automation — Backend
 


* Write pytest unit tests for FastAPI routers and service classes covering success paths, validation errors, 4xx/5xx responses, and @require\_permission decorator enforcement
* Write integration tests that hit the real Aurora PostgreSQL database (via SSM tunnel) to verify Row\-Level Security policies, enum constraints, cascading deletes, and cross\-tenant data isolation
* Test EventBridge event publishing: verify CaseCreated and PhaseChanged events carry the correct payload shape with PHI fields masked
* Assert response envelope format ({"data": ..., "meta": {...}}) and cursor pagination behaviour across all list endpoints
* Run mutation testing (mutmut) on intake scoring and gate logic to verify tests actually catch injected bugs, not just execute lines



 Performance \& Load Testing
 


* Design and run k6 load test scenarios for case list, intake submission, and document upload endpoints
* Establish p95/p99 latency baselines and flag regressions in CI before they reach production
* Identify database N\+1 patterns, slow queries, and Redis cache miss rates from CloudWatch metrics during load runs



 CI/CD \& Quality Gates
 


* Own the CI coverage gate: enforce 80/70/80 thresholds in GitHub Actions for the web build and 75%\+ for the API build
* Publish per\-PR coverage delta comments (e.g. "This PR changes coverage: 69% → 71% (\+2%)") with file\-level breakdowns for changed files
* Maintain the .coverage\-baseline.json ratchet mechanism — no PR may decrease a file's coverage below its committed baseline
* Participate in sprint planning and story reviews to catch untestable designs early; add acceptance criteria to Jira stories before development begins
* Triage flaky tests, own the test suite health dashboard, and keep CI green as the default state



 Who You Are
 



 Required Skills
 


* 2–5 years of software testing experience, including both manual testing and test automation
* Hands\-on experience writing automated tests in Python (pytest) and/or JavaScript/TypeScript (Jest, Vitest, or equivalent)
* Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for end\-to\-end browser testing
* Solid understanding of REST API testing — comfortable using Postman, curl, or code\-based clients to validate response shapes, status codes, and error formats
* Familiarity with SQL — able to write queries to verify database state, check constraint violations, and trace data through service layers
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines — able to read a failing GitHub Actions job and trace it to the root cause
* Strong analytical mindset — able to decompose a feature into a test matrix, identify boundary conditions, and reason precisely about what "correct" means
* Clear written communication — bug reports that a developer can reproduce without a meeting
* Ability to work independently and navigate a Turborepo monorepo with multiple services and applications



 Preferred Skills
 


* Experience testing HIPAA\-regulated, SOC 2, or other compliance\-heavy SaaS products — understanding of PHI, audit logging, and data residency requirements
* Familiarity with React Testing Library and Mock Service Worker (MSW) for component\-level testing in React/Next.js applications
* Experience with performance and load testing tools (k6, Locust, JMeter, or equivalent)
* Exposure to role\-based or attribute\-based access control systems — ability to design test matrices that probe RBAC/ABAC permission boundaries
* Familiarity with mutation testing tools (mutmut for Python, Stryker for TypeScript) to measure test effectiveness beyond coverage percentages
* Basic AWS knowledge — able to read CloudWatch logs, trace a request through ALB access logs, and understand ECS task failures
* Exposure to event\-driven architectures — understanding how to verify that the right events are published with the right payloads
* Experience testing AI\-generated outputs or LLM\-based features — able to design assertions for non\-deterministic, streaming, or structured AI responses
* Familiarity with legal\-tech, health\-tech, or financial SaaS domain requirements



 Soft Skills \& Mindset
 


* Risk\-driven — you prioritise tests by consequence (a PHI leak outweighs a label truncation), not by coverage delta
* Adversarial — you think like a curious attacker when probing authorization and data isolation boundaries
* Detail\-oriented — you notice the off\-by\-one in a statute\-of\-limitations countdown and the missing toast on a failed mutation
* Preventive — you catch ambiguous requirements in sprint planning, not in the regression cycle
* Collaborative — developers want you in their corner, not across the table; you make quality a shared value, not a gate
* Systematic — you maintain test plans and coverage baselines as living documents, not one\-off artefacts



 Our Stack — Quick Reference
 


* **Frontend:** 
 Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Zustand, Framer Motion
* **Backend:** 
 FastAPI (Python 3\.12\+), SQLAlchemy 2\.0 async, Alembic, Pydantic v2
* **Auth \& Authorization:** 
 Amazon Cognito, JWT middleware, Cedar/Amazon Verified Permissions (ABAC)
* **Database:** 
 Aurora PostgreSQL 16 (Serverless v2, RLS), Redis 7\.1 (ElastiCache)
* **AI \& Agents:** 
 Anthropic Claude, LangGraph, LangChain, Amazon Bedrock, Neptune Analytics, OpenSearch
* **AWS:** 
 ECS Fargate, ALB, EventBridge, SQS, Step Functions, Textract, SES, S3, CloudFront, CloudWatch
* **Testing:** 
 pytest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, k6, mutmut, Stryker, MSW
* **Infra:** 
 Terraform, GitHub Actions, Turborepo, pnpm workspaces, Docker



 Why Join OneCounsel?
 


* High\-impact founding\-team role — your sign\-off is the last gate before attorneys across the US see a new feature
* Own quality end\-to\-end — you set the bar, not just tick boxes; build the automation suite from scratch on a greenfield codebase
* Novel testing territory — AI agent outputs, streaming UIs, event\-driven pipelines, and compliance\-heavy data flows that most QA playbooks have not mapped
* Modern, well\-architected codebase — opinionated design system, strong typing, CI gates, and clean conventions
* Hybrid/flexible work from Hyderabad with async collaboration with the US\-based founder
* Equity participation in a fast\-growing legal\-tech company
* Continuous learning — cutting\-edge LLMs, agent frameworks, and AWS\-native architectures

 No two field service organizations are alike…

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.

title: MIS and Operations Support Intern
description:
**About the role**

Gatti Chutney is a Bengaluru\-style premium South Indian QSR with three outlets in Pune, a Central Kitchen and a Warehouse. This role sits with our IT \& MIS function and keeps our daily data running — pulling data from our POS and inventory systems, cleaning it, generating the daily reports management relies on, and chasing down errors at the source.

You do not need prior experience in inventory, ERP or analytics. You will be trained and handheld on all of it. What we need is someone reliable, careful with detail, and comfortable doing the same job well every single day.

**What you will do**

**Daily data \& reporting**

* Download daily data from our POS and inventory systems on a fixed schedule.
* Run our existing reporting scripts to generate the daily reports (training provided — no coding background required).
* Clean and correct closing stock, wastage and consumption data before reports are generated.
* Identify data\-entry errors, get them corrected by the concerned outlet or department, and re\-run clean reports.
* Maintain and update master data in the ERP as required.

**Coordination**

* Follow up with outlet teams and the Central Kitchen to collect missing data and get entry errors fixed.
* Send a short end\-of\-day update on what ran, what was corrected, and what is still pending.

**IT \& vendor coordination (support role)**

* Log IT issues (internet, CCTV, printers, systems) raised by outlets.
* Coordinate with vendors: raise the issue, get quotations, compile a comparison, follow up until the issue is closed.
* You are not expected to fix technical problems yourself — your job is to make sure nothing sits unresolved. The IT \& MIS Manager guides you and handles anything technical.

**What we are looking for**

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel: filters, sorting, VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, basic IF formulas. This will be tested at the interview.
* Strong attention to detail — the job is catching things that are wrong.
* Consistency and discipline. This is daily work with fixed timelines, not project work.
* Willingness to follow up repeatedly with people until a task is closed.
* Clear written and spoken communication (English and Hindi; Marathi an advantage).
* Comfortable being taught and taking correction.

**What you get out of this internship**

* **Real inventory and cost concepts, taught properly.** PO, GRN, variance, MOQ, yield, consumption, stock transfer — how they actually work in a live multi\-outlet food business, not from a textbook.
* **Hands\-on ERP and POS experience.** Working daily inside the systems that run a real business, including master data ownership.
* **Excel to a working professional standard.** You will use it every day on real data, with someone correcting you.
* **A full view of how a restaurant business runs.** Central Kitchen, warehouse, three outlets, purchase to consumption — most people take years to see the whole chain.
* **Direct exposure to management.** Small team, flat structure. Your daily output is read by the founder and management, not buried three levels down.
* **Training and structure, not “figure it out.”** Written SOPs, a defined daily routine, and a manager who handholds you through the first months.
* **A certificate and a reference** on completion, and a genuine shot at a full\-time role based on how you perform.

*Be clear about what this is not: this is disciplined daily execution work — the same core tasks, done accurately, every day. If you want variety and project work from day one, this will frustrate you. If you want to learn a business from the inside by being genuinely reliable, this is a strong start.*

**Eligibility**

Graduate or final\-year student in any stream. Freshers welcome. Candidates with Excel\-heavy internship or project experience preferred.

title: IOT& Software Developer
description:
**Company Description** 




 Enter HOOKABA \- where your LED wearables become a canvas for your emotions, connecting your inner and outer worlds! At HOOKABA, we believe fashion goes beyond your choice of clothing and accessories; it's connected deeply to your self\-expression, reflecting who you are and what you stand for. With our Innovative Designs and Premium Materials, express yourself in style wherever life takes you.
 



**About the role** 




 Hookaba is looking for a hands\-on IoT \& Software Developer who is comfortable working at the intersection of hardware and software. You’ll design, build, and deploy connected devices and the software that powers them — from wiring up sensors on a Raspberry Pi to writing clean Python services and managing Linux\-based systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys prototyping, debugging on real hardware, and seeing their code run in the physical world.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain IoT solutions using Raspberry Pi and other single\-board computers or microcontrollers such as Arduino and ESP32\.
* Write, test, and deploy Python applications and scripts for device control, data acquisition, automation, and local processing.
* Interface with sensors, actuators, and peripherals using GPIO, I2C, SPI, UART, MQTT, HTTP/REST APIs, WebSockets, and related communication protocols.
* Set up, configure, and administer Linux environments including Raspberry Pi OS, Ubuntu/Debian, networking, systemd services, cron jobs, and shell scripts.
* Build dashboards or simple monitoring UIs using tools such as Grafana, Node\-RED, or lightweight web frontends, and store sensor data in SQLite, MySQL/PostgreSQL, or time\-series databases.
* Debug hardware\-software integration issues with logs, multimeters, logic analyzers, circuit diagrams, datasheets, and careful test procedures.
* Document code, wiring diagrams, deployment procedures, and collaborate with hardware, product, and QA teams to move prototypes toward production.



**Required skills \& qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or a related field.
* 0–4 years of experience in IoT, embedded systems, or software development; strong academic, hobby, or personal projects count.
* Strong proficiency in Python, including libraries such as RPi.GPIO, gpiozero, paho\-mqtt, requests, Flask, or FastAPI.
* Hands\-on experience with Raspberry Pi: OS setup, GPIO programming, peripheral interfacing, SSH/headless operation, and device troubleshooting.
* Solid working knowledge of Linux command line, bash scripting, package management, networking basics, services, and scheduled tasks.
* Good understanding of electronics fundamentals: voltage, current, resistors, transistors, relays, sensors, power supply basics, and reading schematics.
* Familiarity with Git and the ability to troubleshoot across the full stack — from hardware wiring to application code.



**Good to have** 



* Experience with ESP32/ESP8266, Arduino, STM32, C/C\+\+ embedded programming, PCB tools such as KiCad/Eagle/EasyEDA, or cloud IoT platforms.
* Exposure to Docker on edge devices, Wi\-Fi/BLE/LoRa/Zigbee/GSM modules, OTA updates, device fleet management, or edge AI with OpenCV/TensorFlow Lite.
* Frontend basics in HTML, CSS, or JavaScript for building lightweight monitoring dashboards.



**What we offer** 



* Opportunity to work on end\-to\-end IoT products — from hardware prototypes to cloud\-connected systems.
* Fast learning curve, real ownership from day one, mentorship from senior engineers, and a collaborative team culture.
* Access to lab equipment, dev kits, hardware budgets for prototyping, flexible work support, and competitive compensation based on experience.



  





**Please do not apply here if you are looking for fancy corporate office, organized way of working** 









**But please apply** 








* If you are looking to make an impact
* If you are willing to work directly with Founder
* If you are willing to invest your time and energy today for hopeful exponential growth tomorrow
* Ability to handle high\-pressure situations and manage time efficiently solutions clearly.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Our expertise lies in designing and developing next\-generation autonomous mobile robots and drones, intended to push the boundaries of innovation across markets.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Project Engineer – Software
   

  

**About The Role**
 The
 **Project Engineer – Software** 
 is a cross\-functional engineering role responsible for bridging
 **industrial engineering standards, software systems, and project delivery** 
 across ERIC Robotics’ portfolio of robotic products.
   

  

 The role will work closely with the
 **CTO, Team Lead – Software, and Project Management Office (PMO)** 
 to establish disciplined software engineering practices, contribute to system architecture, optimise communication and data acquisition systems, and support structured project execution.
   

  

 This position requires a combination of
 **technical depth, engineering discipline, project coordination, documentation, and strong cross\-functional communication** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Industrial Standards and Engineering Practices
* Define, document, and implement software engineering standards aligned with applicable industrial, quality, and safety requirements.
* Establish coding standards, code review processes, version control practices, testing requirements, and CI/CD guidelines across the software team.
* Support periodic reviews and compliance audits to identify gaps in software engineering practices.
* Coordinate corrective actions and track identified gaps to closure.
* Maintain a structured and accessible repository of applicable standards, engineering guidelines, development practices, and reference documents.
* Promote consistent engineering practices across software development, integration, testing, and deployment activities.
* System Design and Software Architecture
* Contribute to and review high\-level software architecture for new and existing robotic platforms.
* Prepare and maintain system design documentation, including architecture diagrams, interface specifications, and data\-flow models.
* Evaluate architectural trade\-offs related to modularity, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and real\-time performance.
* Document technical decisions and provide recommendations with appropriate engineering rationale.
* Ensure architectural decisions consider safety, maintainability, system integration, and the long\-term product roadmap.
* Communication and Data Acquisition Optimisation
* Analyse and optimise communication protocols and middleware, including ROS2, DDS, IPC, EtherCAT, MQTT, CAN, and other relevant technologies.
* Develop strategies to reduce latency, improve communication reliability, and maintain data integrity across robotic systems.
* Support the evaluation and selection of hardware interfaces, middleware, networking technologies, and communication frameworks.
* Benchmark communication and data acquisition performance under representative operating conditions.
* Prepare data\-backed performance and optimisation reports for technical leadership.
* Identify communication bottlenecks, data\-loss risks, synchronisation issues, and system\-level performance constraints.
* Project Planning and Management Support
* Support the Team Lead – Software and PMO in sprint planning, milestone definition, resource estimation, dependency management, and risk tracking.
* Maintain relevant project artefacts, including work breakdown structures, technical schedules, dependency maps, and technical trackers.
* Identify technical blockers and dependencies at an early stage and communicate them to relevant stakeholders.
* Support the development and tracking of mitigation plans for identified technical risks.
* Track software delivery against agreed technical scope, milestones, and project requirements.
* Provide structured and data\-driven project status updates to the CTO and relevant stakeholders.
* Technical Communication and Knowledge Dissemination
* Support the introduction and evaluation of new technologies, frameworks, tools, and engineering methodologies within the software team.
* Prepare and deliver structured technical presentations, workshops, briefing notes, and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Maintain team\-facing documentation, including onboarding guides, architecture overviews, engineering guidelines, and lessons\-learned registers.
* Translate complex technical information into clear documentation for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Promote continuous learning, technical documentation, and proactive knowledge sharing across engineering functions.


**Requirements**
 Educational Qualification
   

  

* B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related engineering discipline.
* Strong understanding of software engineering principles and their application within robotics, embedded, or industrial automation systems.


 Technical Skills – Must Have
   

  

* 3–6 years of hands\-on software development experience in robotics, embedded systems, industrial automation, or related domains.
* Working knowledge of ROS / ROS2\.
* Understanding of real\-time and industrial communication technologies such as CAN, EtherCAT, MQTT, DDS, and IPC.
* Experience in software/system architecture design and technical documentation.
* Ability to prepare architecture diagrams, interface definitions, data\-flow diagrams, and system design documents.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle, coding standards, code reviews, version control, testing, and release practices.
* Familiarity with Git, Jenkins, Docker, CI/CD, and automated testing frameworks.
* Strong analytical, written, verbal, and technical communication skills.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in a Project Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Architecture, or Systems Integration role within robotics, automation, or industrial systems.
* Familiarity with industrial standards and safety\-critical software development practices.
* Exposure to functional safety standards and engineering compliance processes.
* Experience with communication and data acquisition optimisation in real\-time robotic systems.
* Familiarity with project management methodologies, sprint planning, technical scheduling, resource estimation, and risk management.
* Experience working across Software, Electronics, Mechanical, Testing, and Project Management teams.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Systems thinking
* Software architecture and engineering discipline
* Technical problem\-solving
* Industrial standards awareness
* Project planning and coordination

 Work Requirements

* Willingness to support system integration, testing, field trials, and deployment activities when required.
* Ability to manage multiple technical priorities across different robotic products and projects.
* Flexibility to work according to project, integration, testing, and deployment requirements.
* Willingness to travel to project or customer locations when technical support or system validation is required.


**Benefits**

title: Server
description:
Job DescriptionJob Title

**Server – Bakery cum Food Court**

Department

Operations – Bakery \& Food Court

Reporting To

Bakery Manager

Position Summary

The Server is responsible for providing prompt, courteous, and efficient customer service in the bakery and food court. The role includes serving food and beverages, assisting customers with menu selection, maintaining cleanliness of the dining area, coordinating with the kitchen and billing counter, and ensuring a pleasant dining experience while adhering to food safety and hygiene standards.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Service

* Welcome customers politely and guide them to available seating where applicable.
* Present menus and explain food and beverage options.
* Take customer orders accurately and communicate them to the kitchen or production team.
* Serve food and beverages promptly and professionally.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by responding to requests and resolving minor concerns promptly.
* Handle customer complaints courteously and escalate unresolved issues to the Supervisor.

Food \& Beverage Service

* Ensure correct serving portions and presentation before serving.
* Verify orders before delivery to customers.
* Serve takeaway and dine\-in customers efficiently.
* Assist customers with special requests, subject to management approval.

Dining Area Maintenance

* Clean and sanitize tables, chairs, trays, and dining areas before and after customer use.
* Arrange tables and seating neatly.
* Refill tissue papers, condiments, drinking water, and other customer service items.
* Maintain cleanliness throughout operating hours.

Coordination

* Coordinate effectively with the kitchen, bakery, billing counter, and housekeeping staff.
* Inform the kitchen immediately regarding special customer requests or order modifications.
* Ensure timely delivery of customer orders.

Hygiene \& Food Safety

* Follow personal hygiene and grooming standards at all times.
* Wear the prescribed uniform and PPE.
* Maintain cleanliness while handling food.
* Follow company food safety practices and hygiene procedures.
* Report any food quality concerns immediately to the Supervisor.

Billing Support

* Assist customers at the billing counter during peak hours if required.
* Verify bills against customer orders before serving.
* Support cashiers by coordinating customer order delivery.

Stock \& Supplies

* Monitor service items such as tissues, disposable items, sauces, and cutlery.
* Inform the Supervisor when stocks require replenishment.
* Handle serving equipment carefully to prevent damage.

Operational Support

* Assist in opening and closing activities of the outlet.
* Help in arranging displays, counters, and dining areas.
* Support promotional activities and product sampling as instructed.
* Perform other duties assigned by the Supervisor to ensure smooth outlet operations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Customer satisfaction and feedback.
* Order accuracy.
* Average service time.
* Table turnover efficiency.
* Dining area cleanliness.
* Compliance with hygiene standards.
* Attendance and punctuality.
* Teamwork and cooperation.
* Customer complaint resolution.
* Adherence to SOPs.

Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent customer service skills.
* Good communication skills.
* Pleasant personality and positive attitude.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Teamwork and coordination.
* Basic understanding of food service practices.
* Attention to cleanliness and hygiene.
* Time management.
* Problem\-solving ability.
* Professional appearance and grooming.

Educational Qualification

* SSLC / Plus Two preferred.
* Certificate in Hotel Management or Food \& Beverage Service is an added advantage.

Experience

* **0–2 years** of experience in a bakery, café, restaurant, food court, or hotel.
* Freshers with good communication skills and a customer\-oriented attitude may also be considered.

Working Conditions

* Rotational shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
* Standing for extended periods.
* Fast\-paced customer service environment.
* Frequent interaction with customers and kitchen staff.

Key Attributes

* Customer\-focused attitude.
* Courteous and respectful behavior.
* Energetic and enthusiastic.
* Well\-groomed and disciplined.
* Honest and reliable.
* Willingness to learn.
* Flexible to perform multiple operational tasks.
* Strong commitment to quality service and teamwork.

Pay: From ₹14,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

title: Assistant / Deputy Manager – AFR Export Operations
description:
**ABOUT AIR FREIGHT OPERATIONS**


The Air Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing the import and export of goods by air. Their primary objective is to create and maintain efficient processes, guaranteeing the seamless movement of goods by collaborating with Airline partners, Procurement and Capacity management and network offices, vendors, customs brokers, ultimately contributing to profitability.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**


As an integral part of the Air Freight Operations Export Team, this role encompasses optimizing and enhancing the export of goods by air in alignment with organization’s goal. The key responsibilities include ensuring efficient and compliant export processes, collaborating with airline partners and network offices, and prioritizing customer satisfaction. The role also involves actively contributing to the organization's profitability goals through effective operational execution and adherence to regulatory standards.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Operational Excellence**


* Develop and enhance operational processes to ensure consistent volume growth.
* Procure and utilize optimal airline capacity.
* Take charge of warehouse operations, ensuring seamless coordination between the warehouse and gateway.
* Manage end\-to\-end shipment processes from pick\-up to delivery, ensuring accurate file execution, timely invoicing, and dispatch as per SOP.
* Follow CW1 Best Practices, including milestone updating and effective utilization of CW1 tools.
* Accurately book costs and revenue, maintaining operational hygiene for a healthy P \& L.
* Be Proactive and Ensure Timestamp for Completeness \& Timeliness
* Handle carrier engagement to design solutions, improve profitability, and skillfully address claims, disputes, and customer complaints.
* Manage Complaints, Claims, Compliments \- be responsive and available.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.
* Drive the implementation of sustainable environmental practices within the air freight operations, contributing to corporate social responsibility goals.

  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Manage customer relationships and address grievances.
* Oversee overall billing quality and timeliness.
* Oversee end to end process for a specific set of customers from booking to delivery.
* Manage relationships with multiple carriers, vendors, customs brokers, and network partners.

  

**Customer and Network Support**


* Register complaints related to all export shipments.
* Execute and support day\-to\-day export operations deliverables.
* Reconcile and resolve network issues.
* Communicate frequently with sales and support functions.

  

**COMPETENCIES**


**Functional Competencies**


* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.

**Behavioral Competencies**


* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**


**Must Have**


* Bachelor’s degree
* 2\-3 years of experience in the logistics, transport, airline or BPO industry for Executive/ Sr. Executive.
* 3\-4 years’ experience in the logistics, transport, airline or BPO industry for AM/DM.
* Basic problem\-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.
* Efficiently manage tasks to meet deadlines and priorities.

**Preferred**


* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* Completed Cargo Basic and Dangerous Goods courses.

  

**Qualified freshers are welcome.**

description:

Our mission at Powersonic is to help power the products of the future and make everyone fall in love with great hardware, great engineering, and great design. This mission is super exciting, but there’s still a lot to do — and that’s exactly where you come in!

You will be responsible for supporting day\-to\-day accounting operations, maintaining accurate financial records, processing invoices, reconciling accounts, and assisting with financial reporting to ensure smooth and efficient finance operations.

**You will:**

* Generate, review, and email customer invoices accurately and on time.
* Maintain proper documentation and filing of invoices and financial records.
* Prepare periodic financial reports and assist in internal financial assessments.

* Review supplier invoices and reconcile supplier statements.

**Coordinate with:**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

* Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.

* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

**Why you'll love working with us:**

* Grow your career in a quality\-driven and fast\-growing manufacturing organization.

description:
**UX Designer(Fresher/Entry\-Level)**

Experience: 0\-6 Months

Stipend: 5\-6k  
Employment Type: Full\-time

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **UX Designer Intern** who is passionate about creating meaningful user experiences. **Preferably from a reputed design/HCI institute (e.g., NID, IIT\-IDC, NIFT, MIT\-ID, Srishti or equivalent), with a strong focus on UX research, interaction/design, and documentation.**  
The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in qualitative \& quantitative research methods, a fair understanding of UI patterns and design systems, and the ability to work with Figma for collaborative design tasks…

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the team in conducting **user research** (qualitative and quantitative) including surveys, interviews, and usability testing.
* Create and maintain **structured documentation** such as research reports, journey maps, personas, and design specifications.
* Assist in defining **user flows, wireframes**, and **interaction patterns.**
* Contribute to **design systems in Figma**, ensuring consistency across projects.
* Collaborate with senior designers, product managers, and developers to transform insights into intuitive designs.
* Apply **UX best practices**, **accessibility standards, and usability principles** in design decisions.
* Stay updated with **emerging UX trends, tools, and UI patterns.**

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Degree in **Design/HCI/Psychology**; candidates from **reputed institutes (e.g., NID, IIT\-IDC, NIFT, MIT\-ID, Srishti or equivalent)** preferred.
* **0–6 months** of experience in UX/UI Design, including internships, academic projects, capstone projects, or relevant hands\-on experience.
* Strong understanding of **UX processes** (user research, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing).
* Good command of **documentation and reporting** skills.
* Knowledge of **qualitative and quantitative** **research methodologies.**
* Fair understanding of **UI patterns** and modern design frameworks.
* Familiarity with **Figma** and **design systems.**
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* A portfolio (academic or project\-based) showcasing **UX work** and **thought process**.

**Good To Have**

* Exposure to real\-world projects, internships, or capstone projects in UX/UI design.
* Awareness of front\-end basics to collaborate effectively with developers.
* Interest in data\-driven design decisions and usability analytics.

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on exposure to **end\-to\-end UX projects.**
* Mentorship from senior designers and opportunities to **grow your skills quickly.**
* A collaborative, **user\-first work environment**.
* Competitive stipend/compensation and career growth pathways.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹6,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have awareness of AI tools in design (e.g., prompts for ideation, asset generation, plugin usage)?
* Do you have basic UX research exposure (user interviews, surveys, usability tests, or heuristic reviews)?
* Do you have familiarity with responsive design principles?
* Do you have a portfolio that showcases your UX work?
* Do you keep yourself updated with the latest UX trends, tools, and design practices?
* Do you have experience creating wireframes and user flows for web or mobile?
* Do you have hands\-on experience in Figma (frames, auto\-layout, components/variants)?
* Do you have an understanding of basic UX process (problem → research → IA/wireframes → prototype → test → iterate)?
* Do you have experience preparing prototype flows in Figma (interactive prototypes)?
* Do you have a degree in Design/HCI/Psychology or equivalent practical UX experience with a portfolio?
* Do you have 0–6 Months of relevant UX experience (incl. internships)?
